mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_compl: This will greatly aid me, thank you.
mission.properties|o.great_escape: Infiltrate the gremlin prison, free the captured Knights and stage an escape
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_1a: Welcome to our advanced training hall. Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like some directions?
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro4_1a: I'm going to stay here for now and locate any other Knights that have crashed in the area.  I'll meet you at the Rescue Camp to the north. \n\nAnd should you encounter anything really dangerous, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!

exchange.properties|m.fee: For every trade, the energy seller pays the {0}% trading fee from the crowns.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_8a: Yes, it seems that these sprites have mastered the ability to focus their powers on skills that protect their knight. Given that and their appearance I've dubbed them 'seraphynx.'
helptips.properties|m.atg_crowns: CROWNS are used to buy items and pay for other services.

mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_1a: This is {0} of the Skylark.  I read you loud and clear Kora.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Warmaster Seerus is crazy\!  I should escape to Emberlight.

conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We need you to get inside and take out those cannons\!
item.properties|f.volcanic_iron: An extraordinary metal imbued with the blazing energy of magma.
pvp.properties|m.bribe_reward_subject: King Krogmo reward earned in the Coliseum.

mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r3: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_3a: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap. \n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_7: Now that you know about the Forge, would you like to give it a look?
item.properties|f.spiral_demo_helm: A sturdy helm designed for use by explosively-inclined knights.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_3a:
What?\! You're still here?\! 

This artifact is mine\!  You miserable knights will never have its power\! 

I'll just have to destroy you myself\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_go: A festive fall snipe that will explore its surroundings.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_14: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
item.properties|f.frost_sword: This sword is as cold as ice, and it's willing to sacrifice your love, in addition to any monsters that happen to get in your way.
conversation.properties|m.rescued_strang: Hello little one.  You will find there are many dangers in this new world but also many opportunities for the adventurous and brave\!  A fellow of yours awaits you just up the path.  We will undoubtedly see each other again.  Farewell for now\!
uplink.properties|m.wildwoods_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we've detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within this forest.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

This forest is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area.  Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible. 

Good luck\!
mission.properties|m.best_of_beast_1a: Hello {0}, good to see you still standing.  While normally not the concern of a Chief Biotech, I specifically requested the opportunity to inform you about the dangers that lie ahead for you in Tier 3 of the Clockworks.  Can't have you winding up dead as a result of some junior Biotech's misinformation.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: I'm saying that I have a lot of reading to do now.  The fight is over, that's all. \n\nPlease, head back to Haven and let everyone know things are ok.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_11a: I'd like you to give me the tour once more.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
helptips.properties|m.tg_pots: Some objects can be picked up and used or even thrown across the room. Try throwing a pot at that switch.
item.properties|f.gremlin_helm: A special helmet handcrafted by gremlin smiths to shield from the harshest of environs. This one has been modified to fit a knight.
item.properties|f.supply_deluxe_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This deluxe pack has enough supplies to last an entire squad of Knights one week.
item.properties|f.glowing_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. The heat within burns bright enough to light a darkened room.
mission.properties|o.rise_or_fall: Test your might with a slimy showdown in the Battle Arena
item.properties|f.woven_pathfinder_armor: A flexible suit of armor built for mobility and interlaced with slime fibers to protect against prickly and thorny foes.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2d: I've got no other questions, I'll be off.
item.properties|f.cosmic_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
mission.properties|b.the_flickering_flam: After your victory in Firestorm Citadel, the nature sprites of the great Spirit Mother finally began to make headway in battling the cursed flames engulfing the charred remains of Almire. A recent flare-up has impeded that progress, hinting at some lingering malevolent force that continues to fuel the fires. Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
item.properties|f.token_krogmo: A coin issued by the great King Krogmo to participants in his Coliseum.  It can be exchanged for prizes from the Coliseum Rewards Supervisor.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_tall_pur: A tall, elegant street lamp that emits a purple glow with a gentle hiss.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_b631f6: Power up a derelict Mecha Knight.
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_b: One of those mechanical monsters got me.  The cursed thing's claws tore right through my armor\!
mission.properties|b.toy_soldiers: Recon Knights are reporting much greater numbers of mecha knights in the first stratum of the Clockworks and have discovered a mecha knight production facility close to Haven. \n\nMecha knights are believed to be gremlin-engineered sentries of the construct family that share many of the capabilities of a Spiral Knight.  Proceed with caution when seeking out the production center and then shut it down for good\!
mission.properties|o.guardians_of_cradle: Join Spiral HQ and discuss what to do next

mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_5a: You don't understand, do you? You simply don't have a choice.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: You'll be alchemizing amazing items in no time\!  In fact, here are a couple of recipes to get you started.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_9a: Where do I find accessory tickets?
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_heav: Hello {0}, I'm Izola, a knight who utilizes gear fit for a squad guardian.  The recipes I have for you produce highly defensive armor and hard-hitting weapons. \n\nHeavy weapons require precise timing to use effectively and the gear tends to slow you down some.  But what you sacrifice in usability is returned in sheer power.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad can depend upon to stay alive and face even the fiercest of monsters.
item.properties|f.polar_day_wolf_hood: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending day patrols.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
item.properties|f.static_edge: A modified Proto Sword capable of generating a low-intensity electrical charge.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_3: You will find ore deposits in all levels of the Clockworks, and you must attack them in order to break them down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
item.properties|f.ultra_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
chat.properties|m.usage_salute: {0} [player name]\nCauses your tech knight to salute.

conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Well, that's why I'm not just telling everybody back at Haven about it. This little puppy may be a little too peppy for your average knight, especially when those razor disks come flying back at you\!\n\nBut I figured you'd probably get a kick out of it\!
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_8: Yes indeed\!  That's because every time you transmute an item through alchemy, there is a chance you can get one of several Unique Variants that makes your item much more powerful\!

conversation.properties|m.lab_knight6_1a: We're not taking any chances with this artifact you found, {0}. One day the gremlins might be back for it.  Be on your guard\!

conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_b: Did I leave my calibur back at the Arsenal Station...?

item.properties|f.polar_twilight_wolf_ho: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. It is said that the polar twilight is a wonderous sight to behold.
mission.properties|o.ancient_generator: Explore the Ancient Generator and restore power to the Rescue Camp before night falls\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_1a: Listen up, Rangers\!  Grab your scarves and sharpened swords because where we're going isn't going to include a warm welcome\!  Our scouts report that Amu-Sol is a frozen wasteland filled with fiends and hungry beasts.  This fiendish city seems to be spreading its icy chill throughout the Clockworks and if we don't get in there and figure out why, it's going to be a long winter here on Cradle. \n\nLet's ride, Rangers\!

dungeon.properties|m.confirm_boot: Are you sure you want to remove {0} from the party?
item.properties|f.warmaster_bomb_2: A refined version of the shadowy bomb that Warmaster Seerus engineered with the sole purpose of eliminating other gremlins that stood in his way.
dungeon.properties|m.ancient_generator_d: Beneath the Rescue Camp is a massive energy source, capable of powering the elevator to Haven if only it could be harnessed.
item.properties|f.sacred_ghost_helm: A haunting helm for those who are gunning for ghosts.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_1a: Thanks for your help earlier. Stay safe\!
item.properties|f.trojan_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a trojan.  It's so convincing, your friends just might stab you in the back\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_11a: Well, that about covers the basics of the Bazaar.  It's a really fantastic place to find just about anything you need. \n\nDo you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
item.properties|f.wolver_mask: A simple mask made from wolver pelt.

item.properties|f.power_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.padded_hunting_cap: An upgraded helm for hunters that is lined with soft, stimulating padding.
mission.properties|r.shadow_knows_2a: Yes, I see that we're already back to-
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_3: In town, you can access the Forge at any time.  In the Clockworks, you can access it by using an Arsenal Station.
item.properties|f.bechamel_room: A trendy room where Bechamel can add or remove Accessories from your favorite equipment.
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_2_1: Well done, {0}\!  That was quite a fireworks show\!  Thanks to you we've been able to clear that accursed landing zone and move our base of operations up to inner gates\!
conversation.properties|m.impostoclaus_2: Such bravery, such pluck\! Yes, perhaps with some luck you stand a chance against the terrible fiends that mean to destroy Winterfest dreams. \n\nSo note the addition of a Winterfest mission, take up your sword and I will grant you rewards\!
item.properties|f.dead_gold: A coin placed into the hands of the dead before burial, granting them fare for the long journey ahead.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_1a: Surprise\! Looks like you took the bait. That's good, because I needed test subjects for my latest invention.
item.properties|f.furni_floormonitors: These durable monitors will activate when being stood on. It's not really clear who thought this was a good idea.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_2c: How do I obtain more energy?
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I am here to listen. Let it all out.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_6a: I'm curious... what do you think is behind their masks? Wait, no, I don't want to know.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_hood: A warm hood, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r9: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
dungeon.properties|m.vanaduke_desc: Within the throne room of the citadel Lord Vanaduke stands waiting to mount a final defense against any who manage to breach his citadel's defenses.
mission.properties|b.axes_of_evil: A gremlin logging operation has been discovered in levels known as the 'Jigsaw Valley.'  These strangely carved islands are home to an even stranger species of twisting trees that gremlins seem to be determined to completely wipe out. \n\nSpiral HQ believes that gremlins are using the lumber from this operation as resources for the development of Project R and needs you to enter the Jigsaw Valley and shut it down.
mission.properties|b.occurance_at_owlite:
An unlikely source of intel has surfaced from the residents of Moorcroft Manor.  A few of the spookats that call it home contacted one of our visiting Recon Knights and provided details of the negative energy mass that has appeared above the Core. 

Calling it 'a place of burning hatred' and 'a prison for dark souls' they say that you can read all about it in 'one of those weird Owlite books' in an Owlite keep they pinpointed. 

If what they claim is true Spiral HQ could gain valuable intel from investigating the Owlite keep.  Just remember that these Owlite structures have all proven to be swarming with the lost souls of countless undead monsters.  Prepare accordingly.
item.properties|f.searing_edge: A light blade that sets foes ablaze as it slashes. The technology that keeps the hilt from catching fire is more advanced than the sword itself.
item.properties|f.catalyzer: An advanced alchemical armament adapted from Gremlin mining and demolition devices. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
chat.properties|m.usage_fire: Usage\: /{0} name attr value attr value...\nFires an effect in the scene.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_3a: Yes, at this point you must begin forming an arsenal that protects you against special damage types. \n\nYour current missions will have you facing monsters with piercing damage attacks.  Thus, you must begin acquiring helmets, armor and shields that defend against piercing damage.
item.properties|f.token_cake: A slice of cake that serves as a trophy from victory over a horde of Creep Cakes.  Head Chef Biscotti affirms that both these trophies and the incident that created them never officially occurred.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_3a: I'm all ears Kora, tell me about energy\!
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_2: Mount Krampus is the home of the Grinchlin faction and their allies. They are a very stingy lot and won't drop any loot themselves. All their treasures are stored in the shelters you'll find up the mountain.
item.properties|f.nodeslime_helm: A menacing mask of malice made from obliterated ominous ooze.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: {0}, this is almost certainly a trap and I can't ask you to come with me, but I'm going in there. If there's even a chance that Rulen and the other Alpha Squad members are alive I need to try and find them.
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last: Ah yes, my squad.  A good bunch... strong and determined.  I'm not sure I really fit in to be honest, was always more of a reader\!  They should be fine without me I would imagine.
mission.properties|m.honor_duty_2a: I've read your report of the Core, it's fascinating.  What an impossible structure and to think that the Alpha Squad might actually still be alive but... inside that thing is just incredible. \n\nI understand that Lieutenant Vaelyn has already led a team to the Core terminal and is establishing a base of operations for research.  This is of great value to all Spiral Knights and we have you to thank\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: So far, we haven't recovered Seerus's body, but there's no way anyone could have survived that explosion.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_b: Don't forget your shield, it will save your life\!
support.properties|m.option_200_0: We have chat filters in place to remove offensive words. If you have disabled the chat filter then you should not be filing complaints against players for using those offensive words. To enable chat filters instead click here.
auction.properties|e.no_preview: Sorry, this item cannot be previewed with your current equipment.
conversation.properties|m.guard_laborato: I'm sorry, {0}, you are not authorized to enter the lab yet.
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_shield: Prime protection for pretenders to the jelly throne.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r3: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.dragon_scale_mail: Mythical armor crafted from the scales of a creature of legend.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_mail: It requires extreme temperatures to forge this fine armor made from the scales of rare Clockworks beasts.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_3a: Whew, well that was much faster with you lending a hand, {0}. Listen, if you ever need a guided tour around the bazaar, just come talk to me. I can tell you anything you need to know about the shops and services here. \n\nHave a look around\! I'm sure you'll find plenty of interesting items. Thanks again\!
item.properties|f.khorovod: A low-tech, but nonetheless well-made sword whose brutal strikes can stun unsuspecting enemies. Wielding it makes you feel like dancing.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest2_r9: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
item.properties|f.personal_color: Once used, this item will permanently change your Knight's personal color to the specified color.
item.properties|f.armor_arms: An accessory that can be attached to the arms of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_3: Then use them with honor and let them protect you from the fury of the countless foes you will soon face.  The Core that we seek, there's something truly dreadful about it.  I know that it may very well be what gets us home, but I can't shake this feeling that we've been thinking about it all wrong.
item.properties|f.slumber_smogger: An alchemical bomb that fogs an area with a sleep agent.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Careful, those Gremlins have lined the place with barbed wire.
mission.properties|r.eye_of_needle_4a: I take it the only way to the Core is through the Firestorm Citadel?
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_4a: Vatel here will sell you a selection of recipes as well as personal color changers and other items.
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_mail: This gelatinous gear combines the sturdiness of stone with the piercing protection of sticky goo. It's a wonder that you managed to beat up the jelly this is made out of.
mission.properties|m.intro_prestige: Prestige Missions are bonus missions offered to you daily. Completing Prestige Missions earns you prestige.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_2a: Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage correct?
mission.properties|b.p_r9_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_3a: They seem friendly. In fact they seem to behave just like the battle sprites I know. Only difference is they, uh, well, look like dragons.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft2_r9: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_1a: Well met, {0}. It is good to see you once more and under such auspicious terms.
mission.properties|o.choose_your_sprite: Talk to Morlin and choose a battle sprite as your companion
auction.properties|m.listing_tip: The listing fee is refunded upon sale; a fee of {0}% of the sale price will be taken.
item.properties|f.freeze_raider_tunic: Raid fast, raid warm in this furry coat.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_a4e946: Pay a visit to Moorcraft Manor.
chat.properties|m.usage_drain: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nDrains a player (yourself by default) of all mist energy.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: I love getting out in the field.
item.properties|f.prize_box_aerodynamic: Contains unique aerodynamic costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.tempered_calibur: A Calibur reforged and tempered by the most advanced techniques available to weaponsmiths of the Spiral Order.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: None know for sure. Tinkinzar not seen for many many years. Crimson Order carries out Tinkinzar's plans for Cradle. Emberlight was blight on master plan because built by outcasts. Haven probably the same, founded by non-gremlins. Not part of plan\!
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_warden_: An insulated hood that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The full coverage mask makes it ideal for scanning the horizon during polar twilight.
mission.properties|r.target_acquired_1a: I understand that Spiral HQ has uncovered the nature of Project R.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We've broken through their defenses.  Now they're cornered\!
mission.properties|m.alchemy_mastery_3a: At 4 and 5 star level, gear offers the best protection you can find and weapons pack the biggest punch.  If you want to stay alive where you're heading, you need to start building an arsenal of 4 and 5 star gear. \n\nAnd remember- as items reach 5 star they typically can branch even more than before.  Your combat options are about to really open up.  Plan your arsenal with care.
dungeon.properties|m.goahead_title: Go on ahead of your party?
item.properties|f.divine_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Then scour the Clockworks for those wretched kats and destroy them\! Even if they ate the books you will be able to recover the Ancient Pages. These pages can be given to Montague in exchange for rewards. Help us and we'll help you\! \n\nBlack kats can be found randomly when encountering spookats in Tier 2 and Tier 3 (Arcade Gates and Missions). There is also a daily Prestige Mission that likely leads to a black kat nest.
conversation.properties|m.gh_bechamel_1: Greetings {0}, what can I help you with?
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3c: Energy can only be obtained by purchase with a real money transaction or for trade via the Exchange. To purchase or trade for energy, simply open the Supply Depot and click the 'Get Energy' button.

projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_mouse_move: Mouse used for targeting, attacking, movement and menu navigation

item.properties|f.shivermist_buster: Originally used to flash freeze perishable supplies, the Shivermist Buster is far more satisfying when used to flash freeze monsters in their tracks.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_3a: Exactly, and they're worse now.  And the same goes for the undead.  You'll find that howlitzers become particularly bothersome with their enhanced firing and homing capabilities. \n\nLastly, prepare for fiend and undead monsters to potentially deal pure shadow damage.  As always, choose the right gear for the job should you want to live long enough to hear from me again.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
helptips.properties|m.unlock: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Silver Key.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_end: Seems like you have a good grasp on the basics. I think you're ready to join the rest of the recruits in the Sparrow Gate. There you will learn how to work as a party. There's a lot of recruits out there depending on you now. Great job\!
item.properties|f.spiral_demo_suit: Sturdy armor designed for use by explosively-inclined knights.
projectx.properties|e.cant_loadout: That loadout can't be used here.
mission.properties|b.guardians_of_cradle: You have been invited to attend a meeting with several members of Spiral HQ to discuss what to do next about the Core and the threat of the Swarm. Join them in the Hall of Heroes to learn about Operations Missions.
town.properties|m.rescue_camp_desc: The Rescue Camp serves as a refuge for newly dropped Spiral Knights. It offers a few creature comforts as well as a training facility to prepare recruits for their journey to Haven.
dungeon.properties|m.vip_tos:
This C.U.B.E. Club Membership Agreement constitutes a binding legal document between the undersigned (the "knight"), Golden Casino Holdings LLC (the "Casino"), and the entire slime community ("slimes").

 I. General Terms and Conditions
  1. Membership in the C.U.B.E. Club is for personal use only and can not be transferred to other knights, Devilites, or other Clockwork creatures.
  2. Selling access to your ability to spin is prohibited.
  3. Keep your arms and legs inside the Casino at all times.
  4. Please do not drop items into the core.
 II. Description of Benefits
  1. Benefits are varied and may be changed at any time.
  2. Lounge access is not guaranteed and limited by availability.
  3. Buffalo Wings are not included.
  4. All disputes will be arbitrated by the Casino floor manager and all decisions are final.
 III. Winnings, Payments, and Fees
  1. Winnings may be paid in Golden Slime Coins at the discretion of the Casino floor manager.
  2. No additional fees are collected at this time.
 IV. Promotional Awards
  1. Sale promotions\: Reduced prices for members, if any, will be displayed plainly in the shop interface.
  2. The Gift Shop reserves the right to modify, alter, discontinue or terminate these promotions at any time for any reason whatsoever without notice to the end users. No whiners.
 V. Restrictions and Conditions of Use
  1. As a condition of your use of the club services, you agree not to use club facilities or interfaces for any purpose that is unlawful or prohibited by the terms, conditions, and notices included in this Membership Agreement or any relevant Licence Agreement, or anything generally regarded as uncouth by the slimes.
  2. The Spiral Knights Terms of Service supersedes these terms where applicable.
  3. The knight agrees to all terms and conditions enumerated here, and those not enumerated here. The slimes may add new conditions at any time that require complete retroactive compliance.
 VI. Termination of Account
  1. The Casino has the right to terminate your membership for violating any terms or conditions, precise or vague, enumerated herein or generated at the time of infraction. You've been warned.
 VII. Disclaimer of Warranty; Limitation of Liability
  1. Your use of the Casino is at your sole risk. You click it, you bought it.
  2. The Casino nor the general slime community shall not be liable in contract, tort, negligence or otherwise for any loss or damage whatsoever arising from or in any way connected with your use of the Casino.
 VIII. General
  1. This Membership Agreement is governed by the laws of Haven and the laws of Cradle. You hereby irrevocably consent to submit to the jurisdictions of the Courts of Cradle and Haven.
  2. This agreement was written by a few slimes with little grasp of legal language beyond what they saw when watching A Few Good Men. Thus, any parts that don't make sense are usually blamed on the other guy. Any good parts left over are still good. They don't go bad just because we screwed up on the other badder parts. There's a word for that concept and the fact that we don't know it is one of the bad parts.

mission.properties|r.true_champion_1a: It's good to know you care, Kora.
item.properties|f.sudaruska: A rugged weapon for the knight who is more than willing to trade style and panache for ridiculous amounts of blunt force trauma.
mission.properties|e.good_unavailable: Sorry, that item is no longer available.

conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_2b: Do the gremlins have a leader?
item.properties|f.raider_helm: A pristine raider helmet, save for a few dings.
mission.properties|r.go_shopping_6a: I'd like you to give me the tour once more.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_2: I've heard Spiral HQ has lined up for you some missions befitting a true Champion.  But in order to become one, you'll need the right gear. \n\nI am entrusting you with the tools you will need to become such a Champion.  With these recipes, you can craft the highest caliber of gear of the Spiral Order.  With it you can finally wear the armor of the Azure Guardian, wield the might of the Leviathan Blade, and face anything in the protection of the Aegis.

helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_2: The room ahead will give you a chance to try out using vials. Simply press the number key (1 through 5) to the corresponding pickup in your belt at the top of the screen. Doing so will load a vial. Press attack to throw it.
craft.properties|e.existing_multislot: This item has an accessory that blocks a location required by the new accessory. Check carefully, and remove the accessories in the way.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_1:
The Hall of Heroes is where knights go to receive their Star Certification allowing them to access deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Each certification ensures a knight meets the star level required to deal with challenges in the upcoming missions. 

The Hall of Heroes also allows knights the opportunity to speak to veteran knights and discover their loadouts, even offering the opportunity to purchase recipes for these loadouts. 

Visit the Hall of Heroes and receive your 2 Star Certification in order to obtain access to missions within deeper levels of the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.rigadoon: A stunning saber that will leave your opponent quite off their guard.
help.properties|m.tier_2_monster: Monsters split their damage between NORMAL and one other special damage type (PIERCING, ELEMENTAL or SHADOW).\nMonsters utilize STATUS EFFECTS more often. Equip armor with FIRE, FREEZE, SHOCK or POISON resistance\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We were studying that meteorite when those lichens appeared\!
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I am ready to choose my battle sprite.
item.properties|f.super_freeze_barrier: Surrounds you with potent icy orbs that can freeze hostiles in their tracks
item.properties|f.brigandine: A very practical suit of armor coupled with a knitted jacket.
item.properties|f.celestial_nav_helm: A special helm built to commemorate Isoran spacefarers of old.  With this equipped, you can see a clear path across the night sky to countless worlds beyond.
item.properties|f.winter_onesie: The perfect pajamas for passing out presents or patiently waiting for Impostoclaus' presence.
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_3: Without the power of the rest of the sprites, water will never flow through this realm. It requires a focus link with the Spirit Mother to bring even the smallest of drops of water into such an oppressive world. The master of this realm has seen to it that the flames surrounding him will always burn.
item.properties|f.sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with the power to repel the various afflictions that knights might encounter in the line of duty.
item.properties|f.helm_back: An accessory that can be attached to the back of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
design.properties|e.room_already_placed: That room has already been installed at another location.
item.properties|f.trojan_horseshoe: A jet black horseshoe. It appears relatively harmless.
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts_short: If you are hurt, use Hearts to heal yourself\!
exchange.properties|i.mini_sell: Instantly sell energy for crowns at the energy exchange.
guildhelp.properties|l.treasury_console: The Guild Treasury can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|f.primal_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The plates used in its construction provide some protection against the elements of fire and freeze.
item.properties|f.dark_thorn_shield: A gloomy guard that gives one's sword strikes a supernatural savagery.
item.properties|f.zee_core: A pungent mass pulled from a slimy assailant. Its aroma is an excellent remedy for insomnia, as well as nighttime sniffling and sneezing.
helptips.properties|t.parma_recon_2: Recon Module\: Entrance to the Core
item.properties|f.exp_west_3f: An expansion that adds two rooms and a small overlook to the western side of the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_4a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a charge attack, so make sure to outmaneuver monsters while charging\!
helptips.properties|m.loading4: Rare monsters offering unique items roam the Clockworks. Have you discovered any yet?
mission.properties|b.darkest_depths: Having defeated the Roarmulus Twins and recovered the Alpha Squad recon module, it's time to check in with Intel Agent Kora to get a report on the analysis of the module and information about your new access to some of the deepest depths of the Clockworks.
mission.properties|o.occurance_at_owlite: Locate the ancient tome within the haunted Owlite keep
mission.properties|b.p_r7_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_2a: Strangers like Quillion here sell you weapons and armor.  Each one specializes in a particular kind of item, so talk to them and find out what they carry. They're not very chatty, but they always have a fresh stock of items every day\! \n\nJust be sure that you've reached the appropriate rank to equip an item\!
item.properties|f.mandolin: A spike-shredding, high-capacity, overclocked double disk launcher.  Experimental spike energy seems drawn to orbit itself... and drawn back toward the launcher with extra potency\!
item.properties|f.primal_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it you can sense the natural energy within waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.boater: A stylish skimmer to sport at summer soirees.
item.properties|f.exp_east_1f: An expansion that adds two rooms to the eastern side of the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.ronin_gasa: A lost straw cap once belonging to a lordless swordmaster.
item.properties|m.sprite_material_and_fo: Can be fed to Battle Sprites or used to craft Battle Sprite food.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
item.properties|f.shako: A ceremonial cap worn by knights during highly prestigious occasions.
item.properties|f.owlite_wand: They say the wand chooses the wizard, so don't let this one see your cute friend.
item.properties|f.vitasuit_deluxe: Four out of five Spiral medics recommend this armor for everyday use. The fifth was crushed by a Tortodrone.
item.properties|f.grey_owlite_shield: A resplendent replica of the shield thought to have been issued to the most eminent of Owlite wizards. Wielding it fills you with righteous vengeance.
item.properties|f.grand_tortoise: A shield empowered by the limitless fury of a tortodrone. The very plates of this colossal carapace shake as the unstable energy within waits to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.ash_agni: When this bomb has left the battlefield in ashes, then, and only then, will your enemies have permission to die.
conversation.properties|m.atg_greeter_2a: To the West, you will learn about useful items found in the Clockworks. To the North, you will learn about a variety of block types and doors. To the East, you will find an array of traps and hazards as well as a combat room to practice defense against training cubes.  Don't worry, we have taken precautions to make sure the cubes are perfectly harmless\!
item.properties|f.winterfest_coat: A supremely soft and seasonally stylish suit that radiates with wondrous Winterfest cheer. It tells everyone that when it comes to the holidays, you mean business.
logon.properties|m.no_new_free_account: You cannot create any more free accounts from this computer.
helptips.properties|m.tut_dash: Evade damage from monster attacks by pressing [[DODGE]].
conversation.properties|m.gh_bechamel_2: Please examine the statue previews carefully\!  I sometimes have trouble fashioning some accessories, like auras and special items, into statue form.  There are no refunds, so be sure you like what you see before purchasing\!
item.properties|f.jelly_shield: A strange looking shield created from jelly matter. Like many slime monsters themselves, it provides the user with exceptional defense against piercing damage.
item.properties|f.guild_storage: Permanently adds Member Storage, Veteran Storage and Officer Storage options to Guild Command Console. Storages allow guild members of sufficient rank to exchange unbound items with other guild members.
item.properties|f.box_elite_trinket: Contains various elite, five-star trinkets and a Trinket Slot Upgrade. Items are randomly chosen. No key is required to open.
chat.properties|m.no_such_gift: {0} has no gifts of that type.
item.properties|f.style_kit: {0}  This item will be destroyed, but you will be able to re-apply this modifier to your knight using the style kit.
mission.properties|o.in_cold_blood: Prevent the lost squad from becoming dinner to a lounge of lethal lizards
mission.properties|m.pioneers_1a: Hello {0}, I hope you're doing well.  Something has come up that will require you to face your greatest challenge yet. \n\nI have an order from Spiral HQ that comes from Captain Ozlo himself.  You have been selected as one of the Knights to actively search for traces of the Alpha Squad.
helptips.properties|m.tut_welcome: We have picked up your distress signal, recruit. Your first objective is to reach Haven, where we have created an outpost. You're likely a little woozy from the crash, so I'll guide you through the basics. The road may be dangerous, so ready your sword and keep your wits about you. Good luck\!
mission.properties|b.sewer_stash: It seems that the Ironclaw Munitions Factory is not the only place gremlins are storing high-powered weaponry.  Intel suggests that once manufactured, weapons are moved out of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory and stored in secret weapon caches throughout the Clockworks. \n\nOne of these caches has been uncovered in one of the Clockwork's wasteworks systems.  It's likely not going to be pretty reaching it, but eliminating the weapons stored in these wasteworks could result in far fewer casualties in the future.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2b: What sort of challenges await me in the final gate?
item.properties|f.shrouded_crest: Blackened, cursed, and hidden from sight. Thrice-damned herald of an ill-fated soul.
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_rit: 'With great practice and tender care, with an eternal heart and mind so pure\: sharpen the stone, sturdy the chain, welcome the night, drink the Cup of Kings.'
logon.properties|m.steam_invalid_ticket: Invalid Steam UserID Ticket. Try logging out, quitting Steam completely and trying again.
item.properties|f.fowl_cloak: A simple feathered cloak. Adorn yourself in down and get down for the new year.
sprites.properties|d.golden_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal piercing damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Seraphynx, Maskeraith
projectx.properties|m.equipmentlocked: EQUIPMENT LOCKED\: Equipment can be changed in towns or at Arsenal Stations.
guild.properties|m.no_open_halls: There are no open Guild Halls
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: Gremlins of Emberlight thank you for stopping this threat.
item.properties|f.slumber_smogger_mkii: A Slumber Smogger modified to disperse sleepy smog over a wider range.
item.properties|f.winter_pullover: A not-so-stylish sweater for the snowy season. The perfect pullover to embarass your family and guildmates alike.
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: User is in a restricted country.
item.properties|f.deadly_charcoaler: This gallant grill is guaranteed to char your competition.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_5: It is time you entered the Hall of Heroes once more.  Having been fully Star Certified and successfully completed so many missions that have ensured the survival of the Spiral Knights on Cradle, Spiral HQ is preparing you for the high rank of Vanguard.
dungeon.properties|m.sleeper_sanctuary: The Sanctuary|A Calm in the Storm
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_10a: You can find accessory tickets inside lockboxes or at the Auction House if another Knight happens to be selling them.
item.properties|f.dragon_scale: An armored scale from what was thought to be an extinct creature. It reflects light with an otherworldly sheen.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1a: Sure, show me the shops. (Follow Tylen)
helptips.properties|m.tg1_welcome: Welcome to the Training Grounds, recruit. In this derelict section of the Clockworks you'll find areas we have built in order to train you in the fine art of not dying a horrible death. So pay attention to these helpful tips, ready your weapon, and get moving\!
pvp.properties|e.late_playagain: You are too late to play again.
item.properties|f.plated_shade_helm: A helm of fiendish fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they creep in camoflauged corners.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: The rest of us thought we weren't going to make it. But then...then the light surrounded us and we were safe. We've taken to calling it The Sleeper. We aren't sure what it is exactly, but it needs our help. This world was created to protect it but somehow The Swarm breached the Core and has been feeding on the energy and growing like a leech ever since.
mission.properties|o.reporting_duty: Report to Lieutenant Feron in the Haven Arcade
item.properties|f.wild_shell: A shield alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. It's tough enough to dull a jelly barb on impact.
item.properties|f.harlequin_suit: A costume for those who juggle, tumble, or have the gift of mischief.
item.properties|f.vial_stun_super: An ornate glass vial containing shimmering flash pellets. It can be used to inflict enemies with Stun.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be too stupefied to give chase\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_mineraltec: Don't mind Hubert, he's been de-spiked.
craft.properties|m.empty: You have not yet learned any recipes.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 4 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r7: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.blazebrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a concentrated high-temperature explosion that is harmless to knights.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_mat_01: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|r.mission_crimso: Thanks for the intel. I'll check it out.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_bl: A short torch filled with bizarre blue fire.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_pier: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
conversation.properties|m.core_tech_3: Fresh air?  Warmth?  These depths are not an environment that many of us can stand much longer, but the Lieutenant insists that we keep at it, that maybe the surge of power from the next gate will provide us with the answer that we need. \n\nYou certainly can't argue that our Lieutenant isn't committed.  I don't think I've ever seen her close her eyes let alone sleep.
conversation.properties|m.rc_soil_1a: I'm collecting geological samples for Spiral HQ. So far my tests are identifying hundreds of unique soil samples within every inch of the ground below our feet. This can't be possible, I must have miscalculated...
item.properties|f.iron_slug: Only the most frightening of foes can withstand the crippling paralysis caused by the magnum force of the Iron Slug's sudden impact. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
pvp.properties|m.super_brawl-info: Super Brawl is a fantastic, free-for-all fight for up to eight knights\! You will be awarded points for defeating other contestants and lose points for being defeated. The contestant with the most points at the end of the five-minute round wins\!
item.properties|f.black_kat_raiment: A reclaimed raiment that is brimming with dark energy. It is said to resemble the great Kat Tribe hero, Margrel, the one who opened The Book of Grey Feathers and brought about the Kataclysm. It brings great misfortune to anyone who dares to wear it.
item.properties|f.valestone_shard: A shard of Valestone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: To think, all this could have been unleashed on Haven...
conversation.properties|r.monsterboost_s: And... Anomalie is signing off on this?
item.properties|f.firotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of napalm at an increased rate.
mission.properties|r.search_continues_1a: Thank you, Lieutenant. Any more information with regard to the Alpha Squad?
support.properties|m.transfer_item: Transfered item "{0}" from knightId\:{1} to knightId\:{2}. (count \= {3})
item.properties|f.armor_fallen: A cursed suit of armor once worn by a celestial being cast down from paradise.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: B-beware...they...they are everywhere...in the shadows...\!
projectx.properties|e.too_young: You must be at least 13 to play Spiral Knights.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_2a: Yes, we nature sprites are the rain, the root, and the soil. But you are not like us. You are like the ones below.
item.properties|f.vial_shock_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_4a: When a battle sprite is issued to a knight, a 'bond' is written into the sprite's code to support the knight no matter the circumstances.  They will never leave your side\! \n\nUnfortunately, the cargo crates holding the Skylark's cache of battle sprites fell deep into the Clockworks after the crash.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_2cfcea: Complete a Tier 3 expedition without having to revive.
board.properties|m.gate_closed: Sorry, that gate is no longer open.
