item.properties|f.cosmic_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikedata_: What might the gremlins be doing with all of these spikes?
projectx.properties|m.offer_steam_conver: Offer to convert to Steam account
global.properties|e.internal_error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_3: These shelters will offer you two choices\: exit the mountain and claim some Grinchlin treasure, or press on further up the mountain. \n\nShould you press on, you pass on the loot in that shelter, but will find even more treasures at the next shelter.
mission.properties|r.advanced_alchemy_3a: Thanks Bosco\!  I'll gather some recipes and get crafting\!
mission.properties|b.breaking_in_recruit: After braving the depths of Firestorm Citadel, Spiral HQ believes you have earned a much deserved break. As a newly anointed Vanguard of the Spiral Knights, Lieutenant Feron believes you are the perfect candidate for training a group of raw recruits how to survive the dangers of this world. Your mission is to link up with the recruits on the surface of Cradle and help them survive their first tour of duty.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_1a:
Alright Rangers, listen up - we've got orders to infiltrate a gremlin bioweapons facility lead by a member of their 'Crimson Order,' known as 'Herex.'  This is just a fancy way of saying that one of the craziest of the crazy gremlins likes to load his gun with unconventional bullets. 

We don't know what he has cooking down there so arm yourself and don't forget to wear a mask. If Herex is anything like Seerus you're liable to catch more than a cold down there. 

Let's ride, Rangers\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_instruct_1a: Greetings, recruit.  Always good to see another knight make it to the Rescue Camp.  I imagine you're looking to prepare for your journey to Haven.  A good place to start is the gate here into the Clockworks.  Simply approach the control panel at the north end of the lift and press the action button ([[?ACTION]]).\n\nAny questions?
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_11b: I think I've got it Bechamel, thanks\!
mission.properties|b.elemental_my_dear: Biotech Hahn has agreed to inform you about the monsters in the Clockworks that inflict elemental damage.  Contact him via comlink and hear what he has to say.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_danger:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

On behalf of Impostoclaus, Spiral HQ has located the base of operations of the nefarious Grinchlins. It's time to take the fight to them and end their Winterfest terrorism once and for all. But it won't be an easy task. 

Those who accept this mission must climb Mount Krampus, a perilous trek filled with Grinchlin ambushes and icy deathtraps. Along the way you will find shelters that allow you to collect Grinchlin treasures and escape the mountain, or press on toward the summit for even greater rewards\! Just be warned\: Grinchlins and their allies are a stingy lot and will not drop ANY loot. All the treasures to be found on Mount Krampus are at the shelters. And should you pass on them for greater rewards ahead, you risk losing everything if you fail\! 

Some say that on the very summit of Mount Krampus lies a stash of Grinchlin loot that may contain treasures none have ever seen before...
item.properties|f.spiral_culet: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_64d528: Deposit a single mineral into a gate.
item.properties|f.deadshot_mantle: A poncho for a pale rider with sights set on taking down the bad, ugly, undead denizens of the dark.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_2a:
You're eager, that's good.  Your current mission is to reach the town of Haven where Spiral HQ has set up base.  Spend the time you need within the Rescue Camp to prepare yourself for your journey to come. 

Make use of any traveling merchants as well as the knowledge of other knights in the camp to learn how to survive in this new world.  I will contact you again once you reach Haven. 

Good luck to you.
item.properties|f.spiral_round_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_devot: 'Wrap thy self in my embrace and succumb to my infinite love. Let your breath drift from you like candle smoke, dreaming deeper and deeper still.'
item.properties|f.twisted_spine_cone: An enhanced Spine Cone that will thrash opponents with thorns and bury them in brambles.
projectx.properties|m.check_email: Check your email in the Uplink panel.
mission.properties|b.pioneers: After the crash of the Skylark, Captain Ozlo selected an elite squad of Spiral Knights to be the first to enter the Clockworks.  They were never seen again.  Contact Intel Agent Kora and learn how you will play a role in solving this mystery.
helptips.properties|m.candlestick_keep: Beware the horrible Grimalkins that lurk in the dark\!  These cursed wraiths cannot be destroyed and the only thing they truly fear is the light of the enchanted candles.  Light them with embers and take refuge in their shining embrace.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
helptips.properties|m.loading6: If you become poisoned you will not be able to heal yourself. Avoid taking too much damage until it wears off.
item.properties|f.exp_center_4f: An expansion that adds a small central room to the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_1a: Hello {0}, and congratulations in rising to the rank of Champion.  Allow me to say that in my experience working with you that you are truly deserving of such a title.  It is because of you that so many knights have returned to the surface safely and that we know so much more about the Clockworks.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_c: Can you believe this?  This entire chasm is filled with a giant machine of some kind.  It seems to go down forever. \n\nI wonder if the entire planet is like this?
item.properties|f.winmillion: An ornate blade that propels bolts of energy outward with every swing. Inexperienced users have been known to cut themselves when first practicing with it.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 2 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_helm: A reliable helmet that'll come in handy when the heat is on.
item.properties|f.deadly_shard_bomb: A large chunk of Crimsonite primed with a potent explosive. No more depleted Crimsonite here\: this bomb's made with the good stuff\! Or the bad stuff, if you happen to be the target.
conversation.properties|m.tier_done: Well met, {0}.  Having achieved the required rank, you are authorized to explore deeper depths of the Clockworks.  Good luck to you.
uplink.properties|e.no_gift_self: You can't send a gift to yourself.
item.properties|f.stranger_hat: A hat once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  It seems to have small, colorful feathers hiding in every seam.
mission.properties|m.alien_ooze_1a: I have nothing to say yet, but it involves Beast Bells. (DEV-ONLY)
pvp.properties|m.love_reupload_layer: Uploading a new file for the selected level. Other layers may be updated\!
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_1a: {0}\! I hear they've selected you to save the day, eh?  Well, before you get all 'hero' on me and go marching off into the darkness below why don't you and I go head on over to the other side of the camp and teach a few of the monsters that tore up this camp last night a lesson?
item.properties|f.barbarous_thorn_blade: A mythical blade that lashes out with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. Those who wield it claim to feel the fiery stare of the beast upon them whenever they close their eyes.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: I'm sorry, you missed Happy Hour by a minute. Next time.
item.properties|f.frenzy_avenger_helm: A helm worn by heavenly guardians who watch over a kingdom hidden atop a wind-swept mountain.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_nature_sprit: A spirit of Nature willing to wander rather than follow the guide of the Spirit Mother.
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_or: A short, elegant street lamp that emits an orange glow with a gentle hiss.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_3: A ceremonial sword issued to Champions of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of fiend and undead family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'best free lecture yet' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
mission.properties|o.shopping_again_b: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
mission.properties|o.laboratory_visit: Visit the Lab and meet with Biotech Morlin
item.properties|f.coin_bonus_upgrade_1: Once used, this upgrade will increase Coins earned in Coliseum games by 1 for 24 hours.  You may have up to 6 Krogmo Coin Boosters active at any time.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_red: A Spiral-issued light source typically installed in dangerous areas.
item.properties|f.polar_twilight_wolf_co: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. It is said that the polar twilight is a wonderous sight to behold.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: Well, we now know there were massive citadels housing Almire's armed forces and great estates for its noble houses. It must have been quite a sight to see. We assume the rest of the kingdom is still a smoldering ruin somewhere. It is possible that some of it might have survived...though given the anecdotal evidence we think it is unlikely at best.
item.properties|f.dark_ember: A mote of burning energy salvaged from Lord Vanaduke's throne room. It slowly smolders with a sinister intensity, creating an almost hypnotic trance when gazed upon for any length of time.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r6: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|b.p_toxic_plant_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has uncovered a gremlin bioweapons facility deep within the Clockworks. It is believed that this facility belongs to a member of the Crimson Order known only as 'Herex.' The Recon Rangers have been tasked with infiltrating the facility and uncovering the nature of Herex's bioweapons before they are put to use.
auction.properties|m.no_search: Your search did not match any auctions.
item.properties|f.neutralizer: You'd be surprised at the number of practical applications to be had from two substances that, when combined, leave quite literally nothing in their wake. Neutralizer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
item.properties|f.fiery_vaporizer_mkii: A Fiery Vaporizer modified to disperse combustible material over a wider range.
item.properties|f.bronze_bolt: A simple bronze bolt found everywhere throughout the Clockworks.
helptips.properties|m.terminal_1: Welcome traveler, this is a Clockwork Terminal. Take a moment to rest and change your gear. \n\nUse the elevator either to return to Haven or delve into a more dangerous stratum of the Clockworks.
logon.properties|m.version_mismatch_auto: Your client needs to be updated. It will automatically update in just a moment.
mission.properties|o.sewer_stash: Destroy the gremlin war machines hidden in the wasteworks
item.properties|f.dark_chaingun: A machine gun capable of firing a barrage of searing, shadow bolts.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeexplo: One of them lobbed a spike at me\!
item.properties|f.prize_box: Contains unique {0} costumes and accessories. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.vial_poison: A glass vial containing debilitating toxins. It can be used to inflict enemies with Poison.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and wither the attack power of your foes\!
dungeon.properties|m.final_test_desc: The final gate available at the Rescue Camp, this gate crosses the chasm and leads into Haven. There is no going back once completed.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_2_6a: What have they become this time?
item.properties|f.sacred_hazard_helm: A hardy helm to help those hunting for slimes.
item.properties|f.prize_box_colossal: Contains various unique costumes and accessories to celebrate the Year of the Horse\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.raging_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used rage to carve whole worlds from stone.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_1: Vials are one type of pickup. When thrown they release the alchemical agents within creating an elemental explosion. You can give them a try in the next room.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_16: Another tour? No problem, follow me\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_edge: A sinister sword made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. Simply holding it makes you somehow feel guilty of an unknown crime.
item.properties|f.volcanic_salamander_ma: A Salamander Mask reinforced with volcanic iron. In the field it can be used as a makeshift coffee pot, so long as you don't mind coffee that tastes a little like lizard.
mission.properties|r.true_champion_3a: If there's a way, we'll find it.
guild.properties|log.upkeep_default: Upkeep not paid\! Guild Hall is in default.
sprites.properties|d.vengeful_quills: Each time a quilled target is hit, another quill is fired from the target to the next available target.
mission.properties|o.new_threat: Confront a dangerous new threat to Haven
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_1_1: Well met, {0}\! Glad to see Spiral HQ sent us some reinforcements, and not a moment too soon\! Our backs are against the wall and we need your help\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_monster: I'm either here celebrating or downing my sorrows.
mission.properties|b.built_to_destroy:
Once known to Spiral HQ as 'Project R,' the Roarmulus Twins have been identified as a gremlin-engineered weapon of tremendous power built with the sole purpose of destroying Haven.  Stored deep within the heart of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory, this weapon is not only protected by hordes of shock-powered constructs and gremlins, but the factory is a highly dangerous, explosive hazard itself\! 

In addition to shutting down the Roarmulus Twins, Spiral HQ would like you to recover the Alpha Squad recon module that is believed to be located somewhere within the factory. 

It is highly recommended that you form a full squad before deploying.
support.properties|m.option_200_1: Be aware that what you consider offensive and personal may not generally be considered offensive. So please consider carefully if everyone would find that chat offensive. If you have read and understood all this and still wish to send the complaint then click here.
helptips.properties|m.activate_grim_gate: The Grim Gate will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Moorcroft Manor.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
item.properties|m.add_more_bonuses: Add more fire crystals to unlock chances for bonuses\!
item.properties|f.storm_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to ride the lightning into battle.
chat.properties|m.unknown_flag: Unknown flag {0}. Use /help toggle to list flags.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
exchange.properties|m.coins_remainder_po: You have been refunded {0} crowns as the result of an energy trade taking place for less than your posted buy price.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_5a: Done here?  Yes, though there's just one more thing I wish to add.
item.properties|f.vog_cub_cap: A thick hat that smells heavily of barbecue. Barbecued what? Don't ask.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_2d: On second thought, I've got some adventuring to do. Bye\!
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_2a: Thanks\! I'm off to explore now.
item.properties|f.ocarina_slime: Call up a companion cube to complete your conquest.
mission.properties|m.arsenal_knight_1a: You can use the Arsenal Station behind me to change your gear. Once you head down into the Clockworks you will only be able to swap out your equipped gear at an Arsenal Station like this one, so it's best to be prepared\!
social.properties|m.pvp_played: become the new Coliseum Champion, having played {0} games of {1} in the past 7 days\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_shield_1: Let's get one essential survival tool out of the way right now- your shield. Hold [[DEFEND]] to defend with your shield. While defending you will completely withstand most damage from all sides. The gun puppies in the next hallway shouldn't be a problem to get past so long as you defend as you run through.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite: (This appears to be the Owlite tome that the spookats said describe the place above the Core.  Its pages are very worn and only portions of the original text can be deciphered.)
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s: Hey\!  I hear you're the one bringin' in all these spikes?
help.properties|m.monster_beast: Deal PIERCING - Weak to PIERCING - Strong against ELEMENTAL
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: The Swarm keeps growing stronger while The Sleeper grows weaker. Without us, all of us, The Swarm will win. Once, the gremlins were in charge of maintaining Cradle's defenses. But they had their own plans. We need to be Cradle's champions now. \n\nIt's our sacrifice.
item.properties|f.wild_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.nightshade: A hazardous herb that's bad for most beasts, but tasty to a teeming variety of toxic creatures.
mission.properties|o.p_fiend_test_t1: Help us test this new content.
item.properties|f.ancient_plate_shield: An antique shield whose origins have been lost to the passing of time.
mission.properties|o.operation_crimson_h: Join Lieutenant Feron in a siege of the Grand Arsenal of Warmaster Seerus.
helptips.properties|m.shop: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to browse vendor goods.
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_power: Usage\: /{0} skill power value\nUpdates a sprite skill's power value.
item.properties|f.slime_key: A slippery key that can only open a Slime Lockbox.  Once used, the key is destroyed.
exchange.properties|m.billing_duplicate: Your credit card is starting to smoke from overuse. Please let it rest for just a few minutes and try again.
item.properties|f.plate_shield: A heavy iron shield adept at deflecting impacts that would otherwise leave you stunned.
item.properties|f.luminite_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.faust: A powerful, cursed sword forged in the Underworld. Its powerful charge attacks can sometimes curse the one that wields it.
mission.properties|m.intro_arcade_locked: Complete Rank Missions to gain access to Arcade Missions\!
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_3: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 4 Star gear and receive certification
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro3_1a: Glad to see you in one piece as well, Rhendon.  Where are the other survivors?
item.properties|f.almire_chair: A chiseled chair as ancient as Almire's ailing aristocrats.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_2_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 3 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
helptips.properties|m.p_dz_schematic_hei: Unauthorized access of our schematics library detected. Security team dispatched. Lockdown commenced.
pvp.properties|m.love_unapprove_confirm: Are you sure? You will be able to make changes again, but the approval process will be started over.
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r4: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_2a: Great\!  Now a quick lesson on charge attacks. \n\nCharge attacks can be performed with any weapon by holding down the ATTACK button and waiting for the charge aura to reach maximum charge.  You can still move around while charging\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_campguard_: I'm here keeping watch.  You never know when monsters might attack.
item.properties|f.powderkeg: Careful, this thing could go off like a metaphorical powder keg.
item.properties|f.wild_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.ice_queen_crown: A regal crown resembling that of the ever-frigid Ice Queen.  In addition to providing great defense, it is said to dramatically boost one's ego and create a cold detachment from those around them.
conversation.properties|m.rc_greet2_3a:
Our scans have located an ancient generator below this camp.  It should be sending power to the surface, but something seems to be diverting it. 

We need you to go investigate the ancient generator and divert power back to the surface.  But you'll need to be ready- it's completely uncharted territory and teeming with monsters. 

Rhendon said he wanted to meet up with you before you take on this mission.  Why don't you see him first?
item.properties|f.furni_bench_manor: An exquisite bench, perfect for perching in plush repose.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_4a: As a Defender, you can now undertake missions in Tier 3 of the Clockworks.  These are the deepest and most dangerous depths of the Clockworks, delve any further and you will reach the Core itself. \n\nPerhaps if you make it that far, you can locate the Alpha Squad, I just don't know.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
helptips.properties|m.party_locked_warni: WARNING\! Upon using this elevator your party will be locked for the remainder of the mission.
item.properties|f.fusion_blaster: An enhanced elemental blaster designed to banish creatures that lurk in the shadows.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A scaled-down model of the Royal Jelly. He'd probably be flattered by it if he hadn't already been flattened.
item.properties|f.angelic_raiment: A beautiful suit of armor that constantly shines as if illuminated by the sun.
item.properties|f.storm_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so skilled, he could cut through lightning as it struck the ground.
conversation.properties|m.npc_onwatch_b: I know they will come back.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r9: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Parma\! Your Scout\! You're alive\! Where are you\!? We need to get you back to Haven.
item.properties|f.rock_salt: A small amount of Clockworks mineral that's been infused with absolutely nothing. It hungrily draws at nearby essences and flavors, making it a staple in cooking, and the bane of jellies everywhere.
item.properties|f.toxic_vaporizer: An alchemical bomb that produces a noxious cloud of toxins.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_7a: (You sense great pride coming from the fallen knight, but he says no more and stares off into the distance towards a lifetime that only he sees.)
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_3b:
Additionally, HR is still waiting on the requested updated org chart. Please note that 'All fall under the freezing corruption of the great Maulos' is not an acceptable description of current executive hierarchy. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp
item.properties|f.cryotech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of extremely low temperature material at an increased rate.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_weap_2: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_6a:
Wow, this thing is a massive tower of everfrost.  I've only ever seen little handfuls of the stuff, nothing close to what we're seeing here. 

The intel we've collected so far suggests that fiends utilize large deposits of the stuff to trap the souls of the lost within it, like some kind of icy prison. 

It would seem that Maulos, that horrible arch-fiend you just took down, had a different use in mind and was actually destroying this everfrost to unleash swarms of angry, frozen souls into the Clockworks.  Had he finished the job, well, I don't even want to think about how many sweaters we would all be needing right now...
mission.properties|m.another_trace_3a: The energy signature is coming from somewhere in the Royal Jelly Palace and we need you to investigate.  Royal Jellies are very territorial so you might have to get past its lair in order to reach your objective. Be wary though, a Royal Jelly surrounds itself with plenty of protection.  You will likely face significant resistance as you investigate the palace.
item.properties|f.mega_tundrus: An upgraded tundrus that takes no prisoners, except when it does and then the prison is made of ice. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
item.properties|f.shadow_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful shadow bullets that split multiple times on impact.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.frostbreaker_shield: A Proto Shield modified to provide some protection against freeze.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_4: Good luck to you then.  Shadow Lairs will be the greatest challenge you will face yet.
sprites.properties|d.bristle: Increases the number of quills fired and their sticking duration.
guild.properties|i.member_storage: Community item storage for members and above.
mission.properties|o.monstrous_research_: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Don't worry about Feron, he'll be healed up in no time.
helptips.properties|m.atg_ublocks: Some blocks cannot be destroyed by normal attacks.
item.properties|f.spiraltail_mask: A simple simian mask made to celebrate the new year. Your sly shenanigans are sure to become a spectacle.
item.properties|f.power_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_4a: Yes, I feel the same way.  We owe it to them to put an end to this gremlin threat as quickly as possible. \n\nI've lined up several missions for you that will take you to locations where gremlins seem to be gathering resources for Project R.  Your briefing should explain everything.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeknigh: Wild energy spikes down in the Clockworks.
logon.properties|m.non_public_server: The game is not currently open to the public.
item.properties|f.wildfire: An elite handgun that can offer a tremendous surprise for the enemy on the battlefield as its small charges of energy transform into raging wildfires. Wildfire shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.slime_slasher: A sturdy shovel modified to dole out a little extra damage to slime family monsters.
item.properties|f.holiday_hat_snow: A holiday hat so festive, snow falls above it\!  Fortunately for the wearer, the hat itself is super warm.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_8a: I assume you've named them as well?
mission.properties|o.high_temperature_ho: Rescue the captured knights within the fiery Deconstruction Zone
chat.properties|m.usage_level: Usage\: /{0} (weapon armor helmet shield) [level]\nSets the equipment to that level.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_elem: Greetings {0}, I'm Archilus, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high elemental damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the elemental attacks of constructs and gremlins. \n\nElemental resistant armor and shields are adapted from Owlite technology.  Though the Owlites themselves no longer exist, their amazing elemental mastery lives on in this gear.
mission.properties|o.whipping_mishandlin: Deliver the supplies to the research team within the fiendish city of Sol' Fork
dungeon.properties|m.dark_city_desc: This once bustling city from an advanced world is now home to innumerable fiends from the Underworld. Under the light of the moon they burn their dark sigils into the ground, summoning more of their cohorts for reasons yet unknown.
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.

mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_4a:
Re\: Re\: Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

I've contacted Internal Affairs regarding the recent theft of an everfrost pillar and the 'disappearance' of nearly 1,000 devilite data entry associates, as I believe it to be directly related to your recently denied resource allocation request. 

Disciplinary action will be required.  Additionally, please fill out the attached Personal Improvement Plan and return it as soon as possible.
mission.properties|b.weight_of_darkness:
It is speculated that all fiends within the Clockworks crossed over from a dimension known as the Underworld.  While how they crossed over and what their motives are on Cradle is unclear, data collected from fiendish cities seems to indicate that they are now stranded on Cradle, much like us. 

The undead on the other hand remain a mystery.  Why spirits return to the material realm is unknown, though it is clear that many of the spirits within the Clockworks have come from other worlds.  Given how hostile these creatures can be, the only way to obtain useful data is through direct interactions, like combat. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you collect combat data for the powerful fiend and undead monsters in Tier 3 of the Clockworks in order to better understand the nature of these creatures. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with shadow resistant gear with elemental and piercing damage weapons\!

mission.properties|b.silent_legion:
Guardian Knight Arkus was one of the finest warriors serving the Spiral Knights until some time shortly after the crash.  As one of the first to search for the Alpha Squad, Arkus's own squad perished in a grisly battle with a horde of dust zombies.  Since then, Arkus has blamed himself for their loss, saying that he betrayed his Guardian's Oath to protect his squad. 

Arkus now journeys into the Clockworks alone, never risking the loss of another squad and we believe, somehow trying to find the squad he once lost.  As these expeditions began to appear self-destructive, Spiral HQ issued him a direct order to cease. 

Arkus ignored these orders and has gone deep into the Clockworks and not returned.  Not wanting to lose the last member of his squad, Spiral HQ is asking you to pursue him to his last known whereabouts, some kind of mysterious statuary at depth 26.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.

mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the master of munitions of the gremlin's Crimson Order.  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.

mission.properties|b.operation_crimson_h:
Warmaster Seerus is the evil master of munitions within the gremlin's all-powerful Crimson Order  Thought to be the true mastermind behind the Roarmulus Twins and countless other gremlin weapons, he is the Crimson Order's creator and supplier for their diabolical engines of war. 

Recon Knights under the command of Lieutenant Feron recently discovered Seerus's 'Grand Arsenal,' his development center and storage facility for all his weaponry.  Now, Feron himself is leading several squads of knights directly into the Grand Arsenal, with the intention of weeding out Seerus and destroying his war machines. 

Met with heavy resistance, Feron's squads require reinforcements and Spiral HQ is sending you in to assist.

conversation.properties|m.mon_pocket_1:
Greetings\! I'm Nonna with the Emberlight Adoption Agency\! 

We at the Emberlight Adoption Agency collect baby monsters that have managed to become lost in the darkest depths of the Clockworks.  No longer having a home or any means of caring for themselves, we try to find these needy monsters a good home\! 

By purchasing one of these adorable 'monster pockets' you can carry around a baby monster of your very own\! 

The Emberlight Adoption Agency will visit Haven from time to time, and you never know what we will have to offer\!

conversation.properties|m.fc_court_2: I am a sprite, a force of nature summoned to this realm to extinguish the unnatural fire that is consuming it. But Vanaduke discovered and imprisoned us. I managed to escape, but the other sprites remain in his custody.\n\nNow none may proceed beyond the court as columns of shadow fire block all exits. Shadow fire can only be extinguished with the water that flows from these spirit wells. The water is the purest found in all of nature, flowing directly from the springs within the realm of the Spirit Mother herself.
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_s:
We got enough that Anomalie let me mess around with a few. 

See, I had this handgun chassis from an old import.  Cool little launcher, but impossible to get parts for, especially the ammo. 

Well, with a little wrenching and a little creative misapplication of thermodynamics, I converted it into a pretty peppy little Spike Slicer\!
item.properties|f.snarbolax_cap: A shadowy cap made from the hide of a sinister Snarbolax.  Even looking at it too closely is dangerous.

Welcome to the Dark Harvest Festival\!  This annual celebration honors the undead with festive masks, delicious treats and dangerous tricks\!

To participate, explore the Clockworks and try to find the legendary 'Punkin King.'  This ghoulish gourd gives out candy to visitors.  You can exchange the candy to the traders here in the Haven Town Square for monster masks\!

Should you prefer the direct approach, or just need a few more, our vendor will sell you candy as well.

mission.properties|m.tortodrone_1a:
[All] Important Employee Reminder\: 

An ID Card is required to access the staging area. Properly presenting the ID Card will consume it to power the Grim Gate. Remember\: "When you Use it, you Lose it." 

ID Cards not used in this manner ("lost, broken, or misplaced") will need to be reissued by HR. The cost for a card replacement will be deducted from your next paycheck and a black mark will be added to your employee file. Don't let this happen to you. Don't lose your ID Card. 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp

But I suppose that won't be a problem. \n\nPlease, just head on back to Haven.  Let my squad know that I'm ok and that I'm safe.
item.properties|f.haze_bomb_mkii: A Haze Bomb modified to disperse noxious chemicals over a wider range.
item.properties|f.scale_helm: A helm crafted from the scales of a slithering beast.
conversation.properties|m.atg_guard: Greetings\!  Beyond this door you will find the advanced training hall. As a Spiral Knight, you are free to use it to practice your skills and learn more about the Clockworks.
support.properties|m.option_206_0: If there is no doubt this was personal information then please click here to file the complaint.
projectx.properties|e.not_enough_appetit: Not enough appetite to consume this item.
mission.properties|m.occurance_at_owlite:
...This world has seen few greater tragedies than the fall of the great Kingdom of Almire.  Once a vibrant, beautiful realm of lush forests and sweeping plains... 

...neighboring kingdoms declared war... 

...seeking the power needed to turn the tide, Lord Vanaduke of Almire fled into the mountains...
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_2a: Yikes, are those the sprites or some kind of phantom?
item.properties|f.drakon_pod: A sprite pod containing a level 1 Drakon Battle Sprite. \n\nThe Drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on raw, offensive power.
uplink.properties|m.ironclaw_start:
Intel Agent Kora here, we have intercepted gremlin transmissions from this facility that indicate they are building some kind of weapon to destroy Haven\!  It is your mission to infiltrate the facility, destroy this weapon and save Haven from destruction\! 

Known only as 'Project Roarmulus,' it is said to be impenetrable from standard attacks.  You will have to find a way to break whatever armor it is using.  Intel suggests this weapon is located deep within the facility. 

But getting to it won't be easy.  You will find that gremlins have little care for a safe work environment as live rockets seem to be fired every which way at all times.  However you should be able to utilize the 'polarity walls' you will find in testing environments to block the oncoming rockets.  Look for a purple and gold switch to toggle them. 

We've also detected another Recon Module of the Alpha Squad somewhere in this factory.  Retrieve it if you can\! 

Good luck\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of dark matter.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_2: The Forge uses the heat stored in your gear and combines it with the power of Fire Crystals to unlock its new potential.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_8a: Just one last shop to visit and then we're done. I've saved the best for last.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: It's even more beautiful down here\!
chat.properties|m.unknown_item: Unknown equipment {0}. Use /help level to list equipment.
conversation.properties|m.hav_clock_2a: I will share with you what I know, little one.
pvp.properties|m.start_delayed: Your {0} game has been delayed. Waiting for more players...
item.properties|f.furni_gaslamp_short_pu: A short, elegant street lamp that emits a purple glow with a gentle hiss.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_goldkey: Gold keys are another type of lift object. Pick them up and use them on gold doors. For every gold door you find in a level, there is always a gold key somewhere.
item.properties|f.prize_box_extraordinar: Contains various unique costumes and items sure to revitalize your vigor and bring the pep back into your stride\!  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: Well met\! When I heard they were sending you {0}, I didn't believe it. THE Vanquisher of Vanaduke\! It's an honor to be reporting to you.
item.properties|f.owlite_feather: A small feather plucked from an Owlite, said to be a mythical race of great magician birds.
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_3: Thanks {0}, I appreciate it.  And do me a favour, please don't mention this little 'incident' to Spiral HQ...
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_3: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This final, perfected design is truly befitting the Grand Arsenal of the great Warmaster Seerus.
social.properties|m.they_already_played: {0} has already completed this mission today.
support.properties|m.option_4_0: If your complaint was for offensive chat, harassment by player etc. then this would be a good time to ignore {0}, so you're never bothered by them again. Playing a game is about having fun, don't let other players ruin this.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
projectx.properties|m.confirm_logoff: Are you sure you want to logoff?
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_1a: Hail, knight. You must be {0}, Rhendon radioed us and said you were on your way. Come with us, the Rescue Camp is just ahead.
pvp.properties|m.start_soon: Your {0} game will be starting soon...
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Reinforcements from Spiral HQ at last\!
guildhelp.properties|m.record_info: The Guild Record logs important recent activity within the guild, such as donations to the Guild Treasury, deposits to and withdrawals from the various Guild Storages, and promotions, additions or departures of guild members. They allow higher-ranked guild members to track who is donating or taking a lot from the guild, and act accordingly.
item.properties|f.cracked_crystal: A rare, crystallized formation of heat used to forge higher levels of weapons and gear. Though cracked, it still glows ever so faintly.
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_3: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  This perfect recreation bears the terrible likeness of Seerus himself, serving as a dark memento of Operation Crimson Hammer.
item.properties|f.lockdown_striker_shiel: A speed-enhancing device used by Strikers, the hard-hitting shock troopers of the Spiral Order.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_ora: A tall torch filled with otherworldly orange fire.
item.properties|f.firotech_alchemer: An alchemical handgun that fires bullets of liquid flames that split on impact.
item.properties|f.winterfest_tree: A spectacularly spiraling tree decorated in the spirit of Winterfest. Folklore states that Impostoclaus leaves presents for those that have been nice throughout the year while those that have been naughty find their presents filled with jelly. Some believe this is the only reason that chromalisks are hostile.
item.properties|f.eye_pack_shapely: Contains three shapely eyes for your style kit\: Triangle, Square, and Hexagon.
item.properties|f.torto_skull: A cavernous, musty helm made from the remains of a Tortodrone- a reminder that sometimes it pays to not stick your neck out.
chat.properties|m.talk_self: Talking to yourself is a sign of insanity.
item.properties|f.replica_mask: A plastic {0} mask made to celebrate the Dark Harvest Festival. It's not well made and eventually falls apart.
item.properties|f.quicksilver_mail: A fine set of mail made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
item.properties|f.dark_matter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in Dark Matter. Since its original discovery, Dark Matter has been put to a variety of uses, from powering Spiral technology, to rearranging Gremlins on a subatomic level.
support.properties|m.item_recovered_mess: Spiral Knights support has recovered your item or items. Click below to claim.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_securi: Please check that the CVC or CVV security code is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
helptips.properties|m.recon: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to activate Recon Module.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: From the tomes we have recovered, we've learned that Firestorm Citadel was once part of a much larger kingdom known as Almire thousands of years ago. Although it was bordered by other aggressive nations, Almire was renowned for the martial prowess of its many legions. These legions kept the kingdom safe for many years. Alas, they weren't enough.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_1: Hello there, {0}\!  My name is Bosco and I'm here to give you a rundown on the basics of alchemy. \n\nIt's pretty simple stuff really, thanks to these Alchemy Stations.  They do all the heavy lifting for ya\!
helptips.properties|m.tg_shield: Press [[DEFEND]] to raise your shield and block attacks.
uplink.properties|e.already_received: That knight cannot receive another gift of this type.
item.properties|f.toy_soldier_cap: Standard issue for recruits who can march, salute, and occasionally fall off shelves.
arena.properties|m.revive_desc: Use a Spark of Life to revive early and gain an edge in battle.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_2a: The inhabitants native of Haven are called 'Strangers.' You can't miss them- they're the towering, cloaked figures with masks. Despite their intimidating appearance, they have been extremely helpful to us and mostly keep to themselves. The odd, little birds in town certainly seem to like them anyway\!
item.properties|f.night_cap_pith: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer a restorative night of sleep.
item.properties|f.galactic_guardian_vest: Wearing this stunningly stellar vest allows you to guide others to safety in even the darkest corners of space.
item.properties|m.use_harness: Use this item to add the {0} as an available harness for your battle sprites? \n\nOnce installed, all sprites capable of using this harness can select it via your sprite manager. This action cannot be undone.
item.properties|f.frenzy_crusader_helm: A helm worn by mythical soldiers who are said to fight with such a frenzy they create whirlwinds in their wake.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_a: I just need to rest a bit before moving on.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_8a: Perhaps gremlins are trying to steal our technology?
item.properties|f.nodeslime_sword: This calloused carving crusher cascades fury upon fatigued foes.
item.properties|f.heavy_dark_matter_bomb: A solid chunk of Dark Matter with an explosive surprise inside. Gremlins hate surprises.
chat.properties|m.usage_party: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all party members.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: But I come to warn you\!  Crimson Order not stop with Roarmulus Project.  Crimson Order desperate to destroy all enemies. Tall ones, little ones, and outcasts.  All enemies to Crimson Order\!
item.properties|f.obsidian_mantle_of_sig: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: Spiral HQ wants us to haul these minerals back up to Haven.
item.properties|f.advanced_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. This orb is exceptional and can be used to craft very powerful items.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Not all, but most of them are believed to have been directly manufactured from gremlin design, yes.  We think that most were originally engineered during the building of the Clockworks.  Some remain under gremlin control, others have gone rogue and the rest have become something else entirely.
dungeon.properties|m.revive_member: Revive using a Spark of Life ({0})
item.properties|f.fireburst_brandish: An upgraded Brandish infused with the elemental essence of fire.
mission.properties|b.p_winterfest_r3: It is during each and every Winterfest, that a faction of green-furred gremlins make quite a mess, in the town of Emberlight. These 'grinchlins' as they are called, stop at nothing until they've hauled, each and every present from the town of Emberlight. \n\nAnd so Impostoclaus has asked the Spiral Knights, to take up their arms and fight, the monsters that threaten the town of Emberlight. So grab a present and answer his call\! Ensure that a merry Winterfest is had by all, in the town of Emberlight.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|f.arcane_salamander_mask: A Salamander Mask imbued with magical power.  It is thought to be made from the familiars of powerful witches.
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_shield: A thick shield made from the remains of particularly ill-mannered slimes. It is durable, light, and delightfully berry-flavored.
item.properties|f.plague_needle: Knights are divided on whether this gun's bolts pierce and then poison, or poison and then pierce. To the unlucky target, this distinction is irrelevant.
item.properties|f.prize_box_ancient: Contains various unique items fashioned in the ancient, veiled homeland of the tortodrones. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: A liberated set of schematics showing off the complete spec and scale of Project Roarmulus.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_weap_3: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
prologue.properties|m.preface1: The Morai Wars have brought us to the brink of extinction.
town.properties|m.haven_desc: A peaceful town that is home to the Strangers. These salvagers offer the Spiral Knights sanctuary in return for the treasures that they acquire while investigating the Clockworks. Haven is also heavily populated with snipes, bulbous little birds with a curious means of locomotion.
item.properties|f.rageous_plate_mail: A legendary suit of armor said to imbue the wearer with the rage of the titans.
lottery.properties|m.lottery_award_multi: Congratulations to all {0} winners of {1} in the Birdsong Trading Co. giveaway\!
helptips.properties|m.energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to spend energy on this device.
item.properties|f.capsule_health: A small capsule that restores a small amount of health. An adventurer's best friend\!
mission.properties|o.weight_of_darkness: Prove your valor against a legion of supreme shadow monsters
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_expira: Please check that the expiration date is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
item.properties|f.flawed_snowball: A hard-packed snowball that is unfortunately too flawed for use in alchemy. It would be best to simply throw it away... at someone's head.
conversation.properties|m.fc_greeter_1: Heed my warning traveler; this is a dangerous and terrible realm. You stand before the gates of the Firestorm Citadel, the former heart of the great kingdom of Almire, now a dominion twisted by fire and malice.\n\nLeave this place if you want to live.
guild.properties|log.env_changed: Changed the environment to {0} for {1} crowns, replacing {2}.
item.properties|f.down_puffer: A puffy, downy jacket. Superior insulation is provided by snipe down feathers. (No snipes were harmed making this jacket, feathers were gathered non-intrusively from free-roaming snipes.)
craft.properties|m.confirm_unbind_heat: Unbinding will remove all heat from the item. Are you sure?
item.properties|f.sealed_sword: A mysterious sword of great untapped potential. It hums with raw power.
help.properties|m.controls_options: You can change your current control scheme from the Options menu.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_2a: Behold\! The Sparkcaster 9000 Deluxe\! A triumph in gremlin engineering\!
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
sprites.properties|d.concussive_firebolt: Adds a chance for a powerful stun to the firebolt.
shop.properties|m.cart_vitapod_adjusted: You may only equip one best vitapod\: cart adjusted.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: The drakon sounds like the battle sprite for me\!
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Enter the price, in crowns, that you are willing to pay.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_3: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.silver_solstice_ring: An enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its sparkling silver luster shines brightest during the winter months.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_msg_standar: This is a regularly scheduled maintenance reboot. It will be available as soon as possible.
logon.properties|m.converted_to_steam: This account has been converted to Steam.  Select Use Steam Account to log on.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
chat.properties|m.usage_sprite_level: Usage\: /{0} [level]\nSets the battle sprite to that level.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_5a: Then let's get started.  Now that you've stopped the immediate threat to Haven, Spiral HQ is hoping to pick up the trail of the Artifact. It won't be easy. Fortunately I've got some missions lined up for you that will be invaluable for your survival in the dark depths you are about to face. Good luck to you, {0}.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_169085: Defeat Lord Vanaduke in the heart of the Firestorm Citadel.
conversation.properties|m.npc_captainkni: Use the environment to your advantage\!
help.properties|m.support_5: For additional help options, please head to our official Support Page.
item.properties|f.scalding_hot_cocoa: A singeing splash of sweet destruction awaits any foe that goes for this mug before it's had a chance to cool.
item.properties|f.gunpuppy_helm: A helm handcrafted from salvaged Gun Puppy parts.
item.properties|f.plated_sentinel_armor: A suit of armor reinforced with gremlin plating to defend against a range of dangerous elements.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_12: Vanguard, eh?  The Rangers are always looking for skilled knights like you, {0}.  After all this pomp is done, come see me if you want to laugh in the face of death and danger once more\!
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_4a: There's one last thing- it seems you won't be the first knight to have entered the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.  We've detected another Alpha Squad recon module somewhere within the factory.  Please attempt to recover it.  I hope that analysis proves that Euclid's squad made it out of there alive...
projectx.properties|m.display_failure:
We were unable to initialize the game's graphical display. Please take the following steps to ensure compatibility\:
  • Visit the technical support forum for up-to-date information and suggestions.
  • Make sure your system satisfies the game's minimum requirements.
  • Update your video drivers.
  • Ensure that hardware video acceleration is fully enabled.
item.properties|f.waste_module: A small receptacle that once collected refuse from a device built to wreak havoc. Now, it just plain reeks.
mission.properties|m.laboratory_visit_2a: Ah, that's right, you're a new recruit.  Most knights encounter their first sprite on the battlefield.  Chances are you've not had the opportunity to see one yet. \n\nAllow me to explain...
item.properties|f.rogue_lite: Be a guiding light or a glowing spark, charging forward to leave your mark. Universally venerated, procedurally re-generated, you'll never be lost in the dark.
global.properties|m.idled_out: You have been disconnected due to idleness.
mission.properties|m.intro_rank: Rank Missions are the main campaign of Spiral Knights. Completing Rank Missions earns you rewards and allows you to achieve higher ranks as a Spiral Knight.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_6a: Something has happened\!  That door just popped up behind you like a trap\! \n\nDefend yourself, {0}\!
item.properties|f.stop_sign: A strange shield capable of stopping many status attacks from harming the user. However it has an unnatural power that causes the user to come to a halt when behind it.
item.properties|f.divine_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_7a: Brinks is the Token Trader, issuing certain items to Knights in exchange for tokens that can be collected within the Clockworks.  Tokens can be found in treasure blocks, issued as mission rewards or found when defeating special boss monsters.
support.properties|m.subheader_step207:
Scamming is when a player is trying to trick you into doing something you shouldn't do. Examples\:
- This could be trying to reveal your account name or password.
- Wanting to trade accounts with you.
- Claiming to be a Game Master or a friend of yours and trying take advantage of that.
There are many other ways to scam.
item.properties|f.frenzy_warrior_helm: A helm worn by a fabled sword master so fast, his frenzy alone could fell armies before they rose against him.
item.properties|f.furni_drawer_spiral: A small set of drawers filled with a variety of important items.
helptips.properties|m.party_nosplit_warn: WARNING\! You may not split your party during this mission.
item.properties|f.reset_star: A special sprite food that resets applied skill points and reverts any ultimate skill selection.
conversation.properties|r.arc_leader_2: If we could somehow harness that power...
item.properties|f.wild_buster: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the fierce energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r9: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
item.properties|f.cursed_idol: A small, stone statue carved into the form of one of the thousands of arch fiends of the Underworld. The shadowy surface color seems to move and shift like smoke.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_6b: Once you've applied all your skill points and achieved a very high level with your sprite, you will begin to select your 'ultimate skills.' Ultimate skills are improved versions of your sprite skills. Each sprite skill has two options for an ultimate skill.
conversation.properties|m.hav_greeter_1a: Welcome to Haven, little one. Please join your friends in procuring shinies from the Clockworks. Shinies are always appreciated by the Strangers.
conversation.properties|r.hunter_1a: I've seen my share of danger, and I like it.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_helm: A hardy helm handcrafted by Gremlin smiths to protect a Mecha Knight's control unit. With the control unit removed it fits a knight remarkably well.
item.properties|f.furni_library_lectern_: A podium displaying a magical tome filled with arcane symbols, esoteric formulae, and few particularly rude doodles.
sprites.properties|d.cover: Increases the size and duration of the angelic aura.
item.properties|f.nameless_poncho: A nameless poncho worn by a nameless hero of legend.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_2a: Missions range from dangerous combat engagements to talking to certain people, such as myself.  By completing missions, you'll earn progress towards new ranks, which will in turn give you access to increasingly powerful gear.  Greta informed me that you'll be tackling our power supply problem in the Ancient Generator?
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_2: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing at least 3 Star gear and receive certification
chat.properties|m.ident_set: Your forum identity has been set to this knight.
dungeon.properties|m.rc_bomb_training_de: Just beyond the perimeter of the Rescue Camp is a field of ruined equipment and overrun defenses.  The surviving knights abandoned this area after a series of deadly attacks during the night.
item.properties|f.skelly_shield: A bedeviled buckler best used for blocking bad energy.
item.properties|f.prize_box_owlite: Contains unique Owlite costumes and accessories, recreated from the latest archaeological evidence. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.hall_of_heroes_4: Visit the Hall of Heroes wearing 5 Star gear and receive certification
mission.properties|b.p_r7_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.twicer_slicer: Slicer prototype Mk II.  They say a little bit of knowledge is a dangerous thing, so that's exactly how much knowledge we have about the mysterious spikes we're slicing up and launching out here.
guild.properties|i.buy_expansions: Purchase more space for the Guild Hall. Increases upkeep.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3b: While the path is dangerous, you will not be traveling very deep, so the monsters you encounter should be easy enough to handle. However, scouts have been reporting increased gremlin activity in the area since we set up camp, so watch out.
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_1a: {0}, you defeated the Roarmulus Twins and saved Haven\!  On behalf of the Strangers and all the Spiral Knights in Haven, thank you\!  I can see why you have been promoted to Defender, you are truly deserving of such an honor.
item.properties|f.mega_magnus: An upgraded Magnus powerful enough to take a monster's head clean off. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5a: I'd like to go over your energy tutorial one more time.
mission.properties|o.ending_in_fire: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|m.tortodrone_hav: Tucked away inside a mysterious garden we found a strange portal that HQ is calling a Grim Gate. From what we were able to decode you will need a key of sorts to open it. Spiral HQ thinks the glyphs we spotted the Fiends carrying might have something to do with opening the gate.
sprites.properties|d.crystal_harness: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal elemental damage. \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Seraphynx
item.properties|f.volcanic_demo_helm: A cutting-edge helm reinforced with volcanic iron and designed for use with high-temperature explosives.
item.properties|f.token_vanaduke: A seal from the lost kingdom of Almire, proof that the keeper braved the ever-burning abyss known as the Firestorm Citadel.
mission.properties|o.the_collector: Save the sprites and the researchers from the Collector
item.properties|f.heavy_gear: A weighted gear that previously assisted in the operation of an enormous machine.
item.properties|f.deadly_candy_poker: A toothache will be the least of their worries when you're armed with this perforating present.
item.properties|f.rename_knight: Allows you to choose a new name for your knight. This item is destroyed once used.
conversation.properties|r.rc_virgil_2a: Why is this walkway here then?
item.properties|f.voltaic_tempest: This high-tech, high voltage device is not recommended for use in water, around water, or near people thinking about water. To be safe, you probably shouldn't look at it, either.
item.properties|f.emberbreak_helm: A Spiral Helm modified to provide additional protection against fire, at the expense of freeze and shock resistance.
item.properties|f.furni_chair_manor: An exquisite chair, cunningly crafted for cozy comfort.
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: Did you come from the chasm?  How?
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogmas: Who sent you infernal, iron assassins?  Was it Herex? It matters not. There are ways of finding out...
projectx.properties|i.compatibility_mode: May prevent graphical glitches and boost performance for some\nsystems, but reduces graphical quality.
item.properties|f.jelly_mail: A squishy set of armor made from slippery slimes that simply oozes with style.
mission.properties|f.p_tip: Prestige Badges are displayed next to your knight name.  They are automatically awarded when enough prestige is acquired.
sprites.properties|d.dark_veil: Increases the defensive power of the shadow cloak.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_6: That jelly palace...what an odd place. Also, I wonder what that strange device you found inside the palace was? It didn't appear to be made by the likes of jellies.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_6a: They look like dragons from fairy tales.
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_1a: Sure Konway, I'll head right over.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
mission.properties|o.target_acquired: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_space: Sorry, names may not contain more than two spaces.
pvp.properties|m.watch_nogames: No games of this type are currently available to watch.
chat.properties|m.rank_set: Your rank has been set to {0}-{1}.
item.properties|f.metal_sonic_mask: A sinister looking mask crafted by a mechanical genius whose ability is said to rival that of even the greatest gremlin Gear Sages.
conversation.properties|n.rfc_dungeon_2a: I was imprisoned here over a thousand years ago for speaking out against my liege lord, sentenced to be here for a lifetime as my punishment.  When the fires overtook the citadel even in my passing I did not find freedom.  My soul is bound to these cursed stones.
mission.properties|b.shadow_beast:
Spiral HQ has detected a recon module left by the Alpha Squad somewhere within the Gloaming Wildwoods.  It is your mission to locate and retrieve the module. 

The Gloaming Wildwoods is home to packs of wild beasts that have proven deadly for squads in the past. Because of this, Tech Knights have placed Beast Bells throughout the area. Striking them should stun any beasts caught within the sound wave they produce. 

Be advised that Recon Knights have reported the presence of a terrible beast the likes which we have not seen before stalking this forest.  Known as 'the Snarbolax,' it appears as a shadowy mass of fangs and claws and seems completely immune to our weaponry.  Should you encounter it, try and find a means of escape as fast as possible.
conversation.properties|m.casino_klepto_: I'm not the Kleptolisk you're looking for.
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_helm: A sturdy Cobalt Helm with upgraded internal systems and external reinforcement.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r9: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
item.properties|f.buccaneer_broadsider: A fearsome firearm fitted with a flintlock. The vintage mechanism's reliability has been enhanced with a bit of gremlin know-how.
conversation.properties|m.hav_entryknigh: You should get inside the town walls.  It's not safe out here.
item.properties|f.ranger_signal_flare: A flare that signals a nearby Recon Ranger to provide support fire
mission.properties|b.p_r4_min: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is always seeking to further his research on the mysterious minerals that are found in the Clockworks.  The experiments he conducts on his available samples tend to result in their disintegration.  Because of this he's always in need of brave knights to delve into the Clockworks to procure more for samples for him.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_4a: Uh, I think these sprites are studying these old books. I didn't even know they could read\! \n\nAnyway, I'll stay here and protect these sprites. I see more empty transport crates; not good. You go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
item.properties|f.humbug_hazer: This cantankerous contraption is guaranteed to make anyone but the most curmudgeonly humbug sick to their stomach.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_1_7a: Cradle is growing more mysterious by the day.
mission.properties|o.the_flickering_flam: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_4_2: With the Biotechs' help, I should be on the mend and fit for duty again in no time.  {0}, I can't stress enough how important this victory is for all Spiral Knights.  You've helped us deal a mighty blow to the Crimson Order by destroying their Grand Arsenal. \n\nThanks to you, gremlin forces will not have any more of these massive war machines for some time. And with our Technicians studying what is available in Seerus's personal quarters we may end up gaining valuable insights into gremlin technology or even the location of the rest of the Crimson Order\!
item.properties|f.biohazard: Be sure to check your armor's seals thoroughly before engaging in the operation of this weapon, or you may end up as miserable as your foes. Biohazard bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
chat.properties|m.not_in_party: You are not in a party.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_shade_: A helm of fire retardant fabric interlaced with dark matter to conceal its wearer while they hide in heated hallways.
item.properties|f.angelic_helmet: A beautiful costume designed exclusively for great heads.
item.properties|f.scythe: An old farmers tool, retired for the season, this blade also excels at reaping your foes.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_5a: I'll stay here and protect these sprites. Some of these sprite transport crates are empty. I think someone or something is after them. \n\nYou go on ahead and clear the area of hostiles so that a rescue squad can arrive safely.
projectx.properties|i.cull_transients: Prevents display of some off-screen graphics effects\npossibly speeding up graphical performance, but may\ncause some effects not to appear.
item.properties|f.mighty_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you can feel the unstable energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
item.properties|f.beast_basher: A powerful pick modified to add an extra helping of hurt to beast family monsters.
chat.properties|m.usage_grant_gift: Usage\: /{0} <account name> name attr value attr value...\nGrants a gift to the identified account.
mission.properties|b.spark_roar:
An exceptionally high concentration of constructs has been found guarding an area of the Clockworks that Spiral HQ suspects could be a Crimson Order hideout. Unlike other monsters, constructs don't seem capable of reproducing on their own, meaning that any time one is deconstructed, it's a permanent dent in their numbers. It will be a worthwhile task regardless of Crimson Order influence or not. 

Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter these levels, investigate the possible hideout, and eliminate the construct threat. 

It is highly recommended that you equip yourself with elemental resistant gear with elemental and shadow damage weapons\!
item.properties|f.venom_veiler: The ultimate in toxic dispersal devices, the Venom Veiler can be used to destroy pests on crops. Failing that, it can also be used to destroy crops.
item.properties|f.spiral_draped_armor: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.prize_box_stranger: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Stranger style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
uplink.properties|m.autoprune: Note\: Mail is automatically deleted 30 days after sent date.
mission.properties|b.hall_of_heroes_3: In order to venture even deeper within the Clockworks you must visit the Hall of Heroes and speak to Lieutenant Barrus to receive your 4 Star Certification.
mission.properties|m.cwt_mintut_3: Attack a mineral column in order to break it down into a size you can carry. You can only pick up one at a time, but you can swap them by picking up another. Look for the biggest, shiniest one you can find. They are the most valuable.
social.properties|m.unfriended: You are no longer friends with {0}.
chat.properties|m.usage_team: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message privately to your team.
item.properties|f.veteran_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Veteran rank and up.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_gamepad: Gamepad used for targeting, attacking, movement, advanced commands and quickslots
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_gremlin: Gremlin construction sites often contain valuable schematics of gremlin structures and even weaponry.  Once obtained by Spiral HQ, they provide rare insights into gremlin engineering. \n\nGremlin schematics are typically stored in terminals somewhere on site.  These terminals are locked down and heavily guarded.  Once you draw the attention of one gremlin, expect the entire crew to come after you\!
uplink.properties|m.detached_accessory: Spiral Knights had a change and the attached accessory was removed from your {0}.\n\nApologies.
item.properties|f.gremlonium: A highly advanced compound created by gremlin engineers to power their most devious machines.  It constantly emits an unsettling hissing sound.
item.properties|f.almire_tapestry: A tailored tapestry emblazoned with the elevated emblem of Almire.
item.properties|f.virulent_catalyzer: The incorporation of Spiral technology has given this harrowing handgun a powerfully poisonous payload. Catalyzer bullets envelop the enemy in an energy field that explodes after taking damage.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Without you?  No, I'm here to bring you back.
item.properties|f.chapeau_rose: An aged, feathered hat that once belonged to a Knight of the Rose, a sacred order of brave and especially dashing heroes whose numerous adventures are the subject of many folk tales. The Knights of the Rose were said to be peerless fencers, believing that their blades were like the flowers of their name\: a delicate thing of beauty that hides a vicious sting.
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_helm: A cerulean hued helm for those who want to wreck some robos.
item.properties|f.prize_box_gourmet: Contains various unique costumes and weapons used by battle chefs. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
guild.properties|m.confirm_leave: Are you sure you no longer want to be a member of {0}?
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_ema: We have saved the offending email already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
item.properties|f.furni_library_bookstac: A loose pile of miscellaneous texts, ranging from cookbooks to eldritch codexes scribbled in unintelligible script.
helptips.properties|m.back_to_haven: This path will take you back to Haven if you are not able to enter the Fiend's Grim Gate.
mission.properties|o.p_apocrea_r9: Investigate the area of the Clockworks where several knights have gone missing.
item.properties|f.impostoclaus_hat: A fabulously festive Winterfest hat that makes the wearer look like the great spirit of Winterfest, Impostoclaus. Glorp\! Glorp\! Glorp\!
mission.properties|o.p_ghost_machine_r7: Join Desna's Recon Rangers in discovering the source of the distress call within the derelict facility.
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r7: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|f.enamorock: A strange stone that makes you have warm and fuzzy feelings inside just by holding it.
item.properties|f.piggy_banker: A small volatile bank that is sure to burn a hole in your enemies' pockets.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_6a: Bombs are special in that they have no standard attack.  A bomb can ONLY be used as a CHARGE ATTACK, so make sure to evade monsters while charging\! \n\nFeel free to give it a try.  Just remember to equip it at that arsenal station up ahead.
uplink.properties|m.auction_incomplete: We're sorry, but the item you tried to sell was not sold.\n\nTip for sellers\: Always sell shiny items that everyone wants at super good prices.
help.properties|m.support_2: If you're lost or having trouble, our Game Masters can help\! They can be contacted by filing a support request.
helptips.properties|m.bramble: Some areas are overgrown with bramble that will hurt you if you run through it\!
item.properties|f.power_mitt: A must have in every kitchen. The comfortable fit and heavyweight silverweave surface are great for handling high heat. Now you're cooking with power\!
projectx.properties|m.mission_imf: Recover the recon module in the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
uplink.properties|m.auction_complete:
Your item sold\!
+{0} (Final sale)
-{2} (Final sale price fee)
+{1} (Refunded listing fee)

Thank you for using the Haven Auction House, your shinies are always appreciated.
item.properties|f.sacred_wraith_helm: A honed helm for those who are gunning for gremlins.
helptips.properties|m.atg_cblocks: Hit a CRYSTAL BLOCK to destroy other crystal blocks of the same color.
conversation.properties|r.tortodrone_hav: Thanks for the tip\! I'll track down those glyphs.
