item.properties|f.heavenly_iron_armor: A powerful suit of armor said to be crafted from angelic shields.  It retains many divine properties celestial beings possess but lacks their weakness to fire.
mission.properties|o.chilled_to_bone: Investigate the shadowy remains of the Candlestick Keep
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_9a: If so, we must prevent further damage.  Now please, there are yet more sprites to be rescued.  And who knows what we'll discover when we get there\!
social.properties|m.autofriend_single_ma: Your {0} friend {1} just started playing Spiral Knights as {2}\! Unfortunately, that knight already has a full friend list, so you were unable to be auto-friended.
pvp.properties|m.lockdown-info: Battle for domination of control points utilizing special class mods that completely alter your Knight's abilities\!  Lockdown participants can be divided by tier or play an open match. Check today's game modes\!
item.properties|f.red_shard: A shard of Crimsonite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
projectx.properties|m.instance_will_shut: You cannot enter this place because it will be refreshed soon.
mission.properties|o.shadowplay: Discover the source of the disturbance in Firestorm Citadel
conversation.properties|m.rc_injured_a: Last night terrible monsters attacked us in the darkness.  It was utter chaos. With no power for the turrets we couldn't defend ourselves. \n\nSo many brave Knights lost...
item.properties|f.proto_duelist: A six-shot firearm preferred by the marksmen of Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
item.properties|f.plate_helm: A heavy duty helm suited for heavy combat.
item.properties|f.garden_snipes_room: A peaceful garden home to a number of Snipes. Perfect for both relaxing and spinning wildly in place.
mission.properties|b.p_apocrea_r6: Several capable knights have gone missing in a seemingly normal area of the Clockwork Tunnels. Spiral HQ suspects foul play and has assigned you to investigate the level.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_cowl: A magnificently crafted cowl said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Scraith, first to scale the walls of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks.
guild.properties|m.confirm_demote: Are you sure you want to demote {0} to {1}?
dungeon.properties|m.emberlight_desc: A village of outcasts, Emberlight serves as a refuge for gremlins who were banished from the Great Colony. Now they live humble lives, selling wares and repairs to passing travelers, always fearful that one day the gremlin king Tinkinzar would see fit to wipe them out entirely.
mission.properties|m.shocking_sentient_s: Eeeek\! No no no\! B-but it's not ready yet...\!  I guess I have no choice\! \n\nSparkcaster Deluxe....activate\!
item.properties|f.padded_cap: A one size fits all light helm that is typically worn by gunslingers.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_4a: Hah\! You'll never reach me in my 'Room of Invincibility'\! You'll be trapped in that control room forever\! ...Erm, wait. I might have overlooked something...
conversation.properties|m.hav_grem_2a: My knowledge is yours, little one.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_12b: Wonderful\!  I'm glad I could help you out.  Good luck and remember that I'll always be here to keep your armor looking unique\!
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: A magnificently preserved royal seal of the lost kingdom of Almire. It probably belongs in a museum.
helptips.properties|m.danger_module: Warning\! The path beyond this point is far more dangerous than what you would expect on this level. By entering you will not be able to turn back until you complete the challenges within.\n\nHowever, should you manage to come out victorious you will be rewarded for your bravery. Enter at your own risk\!
social.properties|m.already_invited: {0} has already been invited to your party.
exchange.properties|m.billing_error: Your payment could not be processed due to a stray snipe in the gears. Fear not\! Your card has not been charged, and maintenance gremlins have been dispatched to repair the problem. Please try again later.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_2a: You, curious traveler, stand in the Obsidian Nexus, realm of the Apocrea. You will likely never see the sun again.
conversation.properties|m.lab_harness_1a: I'm Riley, Morlin's assistant.  I'm in the process of inventing a way to enhance our battle sprites even further.  Check back later once you've acquired a permanently-bonded sprite.
item.properties|f.voltaic_radical_suit: A suit said to be replicated by a sentient mechaknight. It comes with a synthetic skinsuit that pulses with an electric energy.
conversation.properties|r.atg_guard: Thanks\! I'll go see what's inside.
support.properties|m.option_210_1: If you're sure the other options didn't cover your complaint, and you're sure the player broke our Terms of Service, then please enter a short explanation here for what your complaint is.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of moonstone
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeknigh: Did you see the view from the Arcade?
mission.properties|r.darkest_forces_1a: Yes, my next missions will have me facing fiends and undead.  Sounds fun.
helptips.properties|m.mission_trap_chamb: All drones can move in a few different ways.
mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_5b: Get energy and do amazing things- got it\!
item.properties|f.snarbolax_coat: A shadowy suit made from the hide of a sinister Snarbolax.  Even looking at it too closely is dangerous.
prologue.properties|m.preface2: We, the crew of the Skylark, fled to the stars seeking a source of incredible power, our last hope to save our homeworld.
item.properties|f.jelly_animal: A magnificent animalistic mask exemplifying ectoplasmic expropriation.
mission.properties|m.crossing_chasm_b_5a: Hey, {0}\! I see you've acquired a Proto Bomb\! They're very useful for when you need to deal with groups of enemies.
mission.properties|o.shadow_beast: Defeat the Snarbolax in the Gloaming Wildwoods and recover the recon module
pvp.properties|m.playagain_team.n: {0} more guildmates are needed for a {1} team.
support.properties|m.subheader_step2_gif: We have saved the offending gift box message already waiting to be added to the complaint, so there is no need to hurry from here. Please carefully choose the correct option matching what the player did\:
item.properties|f.holiday_present: A perfectly wrapped pile of presents that is sure to please anyone who opens it.
item.properties|f.spiral_scale_mail: Durable, light mail that provides protection from piercing attacks.
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2a:
Crimson Order Directives\: 

- It is the DUTY of every Gremlin to repel the metal intruders\! 

- Every Gremlin must work to destroy Haven. Cradle belongs us\! 

- Every Gremlin must remain LOYAL to King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. The Iron Law must be obeyed\!
helptips.properties|m.tg2_end: Great job\! With another successful run through the Training Grounds you should be getting the hang of things by now. It won't be long before you are exploring the depths of the Clockworks on your own.
item.properties|f.sacred_guerrilla_helm: A helm for those who want to bring down some beasts.
item.properties|f.polar_night_warden_coa: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of nighttime watch duty.
uplink.properties|m.login_event: Hail, {0}\! Thanks for playing Spiral Knights\! As part of a special event, please accept the attached rewards to aid you in your adventures\! \n\nAnd don't forget to check out the Supply Depot for more rare items and special offers\!
item.properties|f.grand_solstice_ring: A magnificent, enchanted ring that embodies the spirit of the solstice. Its surface seems to change color over time, sometimes hot and sometimes cold to the touch.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_4a: We need you to discover what happened to them.  You'll start by seeking out known locations of their recon modules and collecting them for analysis.  I will be in charge of locating their general whereabouts and directing you toward them.  It's your job to go into the wild to retrieve them. \n\nAdditionally, I'll provide you with a quick background of each of the four members of the Alpha Squad\: Squad Leader Euclid, Squad Guardian Grantz, Squad Recon Parma, and Squad Technician Rulen.
item.properties|f.gold_dragon_helm: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Gold Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_1c: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
item.properties|f.owlite_robe: A costume recreation of the fine robes worn by Owlites, based on the most recent archaeological findings.
mission.properties|o.shocking_sentient_s: Battle your way to the secret weapons facility
item.properties|f.justifier_hat: A finely-made hat for handgun experts who think nothing of spending a few crowns more on a high-quality piece of gear.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_2a: Oh {0}, I'm just doing my job.  And speaking of which, I have a job for you\!
item.properties|f.brute_jelly_helm: A hardy helm crafted from overly oppressive ooze.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_gobble_: A festive fall snipe that will stay where it's placed.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_10: Congratulations {0}.  The Geo Knights owe a great deal to your efforts.
mission.properties|b.delved_too_deep: The truth has been revealed. It's time to update Intel Agent Kora and Spiral HQ about what you and Lieutenant Vaelyn have learned.
helptips.properties|m.atg_button: Standing on a BUTTON can open locked doors.
item.properties|f.furni_counter_spiral: A modular piece of counter that can be combined in infinite ways. Always be careful when working with infinity.
item.properties|f.cyclops_cap: A strange helm with a single, focused eye favored by junior gunners.
exchange.properties|m.billing_steam_erro: Steam Error\: User account is unable to make purchases at this time.
chat.properties|m.fail_format: {0} is appalled at that display of failure.
item.properties|f.freezing_pulsar: A pulsar modified with a freezing agent that grows colder over time. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_weap_2: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
exchange.properties|m.tradefooter: Current offers are set by the players. If a suitable offer for you is not available, click the market tab to post your own.
item.properties|f.warmaster_helm_2: A remake of a mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus of the Crimson Order.  Though it very much resembles the original, it is still missing pieces.
item.properties|f.storm_champion_helm: The helm of one who defied the gods and stormed the gates of a heavenly kingdom. Some say that thunderclaps are the eternal echoes of her siege.
dungeon.properties|m.aurora_isles_desc: From atop mysterious floating islands, sun bleached ruins crumble under a false sky. Though the green grass and cool air feels real enough, the ever present grinding of the machine just below the surface is a constant reminder of this world's mechanical skeleton.
item.properties|d.furni_lay: USE\: Have a quick lie down.
mission.properties|m.elemental_my_dear_1: Hello again, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you are ready to learn about monsters that inflict elemental damage correct?
item.properties|f.graviton_bomb: Capable of dragging enemies toward its location before exploding, this bomb utilizes technology that the Spiral Order does not fully understand.
mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_4: When you interact with an Alchemy Station you will open the alchemy interface where you can see your known recipe...
helptips.properties|m.plan_o_attack: The monitor shows readouts coming from a prototype of a massive war machine labeled "Project R".
item.properties|f.nog_blaster: One highly volatile chamber full of creamy, high-cholesterol cheer that when fired really packs a punch.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_9a: Rulen was recruited as the technical genius that Captain Ozlo believed would be required for navigating the vast, mechanized world of the Clockworks.  His primary responsibilities included everything from disabling locks to repairing armor to wrecking sentient constructs.  He was additionally the lead on analyzing the Core once the squad reached it.
projectx.properties|m.start_tooltip: Confirm this knight and begin your adventure \u25BA
projectx.properties|e.no_lead_node: Service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
item.properties|m.no_activate: You must wait for other upgrades to expire before activating.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6c: No thanks, I'll explore on my own.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_4a: Sorry, yes of course.  Good luck to you, {0}.  Assemble the best squad you can and lead them well.  We're all counting on you.
item.properties|f.rock_jelly_helm: A tough topper tailored from jagged jelly.
chat.properties|m.usage_summon: Usage\: /{0} player name\nSummons a player to your current location.
item.properties|f.combuster: Combining the principles of the Skylark's engines with the technology powering the Blast Furnace produced this brutal blade, which can ignite even the most flame-retardant materials at a distance.
chat.properties|m.no_last_teller: Nobody has sent you a /tell to respond to.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_4: At any given time a sprite has a 'favored item', a special material that it enjoys eating the most. Feeding one of these to your sprite is a great treat and grants the sprite a lot of heat.
conversation.properties|m.npc_techknight: Good data is like a good pudding, you can never have too much of it.
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendnoti: Due to continual under-performance, there will be no paid holidays or free coffee in the break room.
item.properties|f.divine_mantle: A heavenly cloak thought to be once worn by celestial sages.
item.properties|f.raiders_hammer: An ornate hammer infused with the power of a great storm, it's as cutting-edge as a blunt weapon can be.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_ebcd68: Defeat the Royal Jelly squatting in the Royal Jelly Palace.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_6a: I'd like to see the shops again. (Follow Tylen)
item.properties|f.pile_o_pillows: A freshly laundered basket of pillows, ready for throwing at your friends\!
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Right.  Spiral HQ has informed me you'll likely be facing hordes of gremlins and constructs on this next go around.  Keep in mind that in Tier 3, these monsters can inflict pure elemental damage.  Do be sure to gear up appropriately.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_2b: I don't understand, the distress signal came from here... but that can't be, right?
guild.properties|i.officer_storage: Community item storage for officers and above.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_helm: A loose fitting helm that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
conversation.properties|m.mission_apocre: If you're going further, be on your guard. I smell a trap.
dungeon.properties|m.candlestick_keep.de: All that remains of the Owlite Academy, the Candlestick Keep is now a grim shadow of the once great school of magical arts.  Knights who have made it out of this cursed keep have only this advice to offer- 'stay in the light.'
mission.properties|r.pumping_up_2b: No thanks, I'll wander around on my own.
chat.properties|m.usage_cheer: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nCheer for your fellow players\!
item.properties|f.supply_pack_compact: A package of useful supplies valued by Spiral Knight research teams working deep within the Clockworks.  This compact pack has enough supplies to last a single Knight one week.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Very good, {0}. You will find a new set of missions for you under Operations. These new missions will be grouped according to their overall objective and can be tackled in parallel to each other. This should allow you maximum flexibility in order to respond to each new threat as they come up. Farewell, {0}, 'Guardian of Cradle'.
mission.properties|b.faith_armor:
An apprentice named Wilks who had just arrived from a Rescue Camp has found himself in what Spiral HQ calls a 'Trap Chamber.'  These levels of most likely gremlin design seem to be specifically built to trap and ultimately eliminate those attempting to explore the Clockworks. 

Wilks probably didn't know what he had got himself into until it was too late.  Now he's stuck somewhere in the chamber and needs your help. 

Some traps can be avoided and sometimes you may find that you just have to take the hit. In saving Wilks, you will no doubt learn the true value of strong armor.
item.properties|f.mercurial_helm: A sublime silver helmet that'll let you move as swiftly as water, though perhaps not quite so swiftly *through* it.
conversation.properties|r.atg_greeter_1b: No thanks, I'll explore the place myself.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on direct assault\: firebolt creates an explosive projectile, flame barrier surrounds its knight with protective fireballs, and firestorm creates a massive wave of flames. \n\nThe drakon is best suited for fearless knights who prefer frontline, destructive combat.
mission.properties|r.time_enough_at_last: Yes, you must be Edger.  Your squadmates requested that I come find you.
item.properties|f.furious_flamberge: Great fencers can carve their name into their opponents. Legendary ones brand it there.
item.properties|m.prize_box_rose_regalia: Rose Regalia Returns Again Prize Box
item.properties|f.shining_ward: A sacred shield that protects the user from evil.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Grantz he...he fell while protecting us from The Swarm. He stood his ground even when the rest of us were forced to flee. I'll never forget how brave he was.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_2a: It should, there're plenty of new recruits that chatter about them constantly. They're like heroes to some knights. \n\nThe Alpha Squad was an elite squad of knights that Ozlo personally selected to first enter the Clockworks in an effort to locate the source of the massive energy signal below.  Because all systems on the Skylark were offline for several weeks, radio communication was not possible.  Instead, they left a series of recon modules throughout their travels, sort of like a breadcrumb trail.
item.properties|f.lockbox: A special lockbox that contains one of hundreds of unique items\!  It can only be opened with a Silver Key.  Silver Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot.
item.properties|f.prize_box_disguise: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Disguise style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
mission.properties|r.first_contact_b_4a: I'd like to help however I can.  Where is Spiral HQ now located?
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_card: Please check that card number is correct and try again. Your card has not been charged.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_3_3b: I'm sorry {0}, but you currently do not meet the necessary requirements. Please speak to me again when you are currently equipped with a 4 star or greater armor, helmet, shield and weapon.
board.properties|i.formparty: Create a party that anyone can join.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: The seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies protection and restoration. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat\: ray of light creates a steady beam of holy light, heart attack increases the chance of hearts dropping from monsters, and angelic aura creates a light shield that protects its knight and party members within. \n\nThe seraphynx is best suited for knights who wish to protect their party and provide them aid.
item.properties|f.ticktocktop: Enough complications to make your head spin.
helptips.properties|m.tut_switches: Doors can often be opened by finding the right switch nearby. Have a look around. They are sometimes hidden under blocks.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_zombie_bellh: A bellhop with unusual dedication in charge of carrying luggage to a guest's quarters. Most just offer to carry the bags themselves.
item.properties|f.valiance: This high-performance handgun is a symbol of the Spiral Order, and is proudly worn by veteran members. As it is often said, a knight need not have courage\: just Valiance.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_spooky: A dark and foreboding theme perfect for a Guild Hall whose members are among the recently departed.
chat.properties|m.usage_trade: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message on the trade channel.
item.properties|f.flawed_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. Though flawed, this orb is still useful in crafting low-powered items.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Hail, Vanguard. It will be a rough road ahead of us but I am confident that we are up to the challenge.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_6: Our geological research is ongoing, so there may yet be other fascinating uses for these strange and powerful minerals.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
item.properties|f.blast_powder: A dangerous by-product produced by fire-based organic creatures. Gremlins like to use it to blow stuff up.
helptips.properties|m.party_button: The party button will activate when all living party members are standing on it.
mission.properties|m.another_trace_2a: The place is as strange as it sounds.  Apparently, monsters within the slime family actually have a ruling aristocracy of elite slimes.  These 'Royal Jellies' are enormous, selfish and ill-tempered slimes that live in opulent palaces that we can only guess have been squatted in as we do not believe slimes are capable of building structures.
dungeon.properties|m.battle_arena_1: Battle Arena|Fight for Glory, Fight for Treasure
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_4a: If what Parma said is true then we're the last line of defense against The Swarm. {0}, I won't lie but this might change everything. We'll need to pass this on to Spiral HQ immediately. I'll round everyone up and send you a mission to accept when you're ready.
item.properties|f.spiral_cloak: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: That's fine, just talk to me again when you are ready to choose.
guildhelp.properties|l.emporium_console: The Birdsong Emporium and Design Mode can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|m.forge_locked: The Forge can only be used in town or at Arsenal Stations.
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
chat.properties|m.unspecific_flag: Flag not specific enough, did you mean "{0}?"
uplink.properties|d.battle_pack: A Battle Pack is the ultimate resource for facing the challenges of King Krogmo's Coliseum.  Gift it to a friend who is brave enough to enter the arena with you\!
item.properties|f.furni_pet_companion_cu: A sociable slime with uncontainable curiosity. (Limit 1 per hall).
chat.properties|m.usage_helpme: Usage\: /{0}\nTell your comrades that you need help\!
item.properties|f.grim_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. Shadows seem to lengthen and cling to it whenever it is brought to bear.
conversation.properties|r.fc_greeter_1: I've come this far, I need to move forward.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2d: Battle sprites gain perks at certain levels that you can equip within the battle sprite interface. Perks provide bonuses to your stats.
global.properties|m.internal_error: An unexpected error occurred on the server.
projectx.properties|m.save_continue: In order to access this feature, you must create an account to use when logging into the game.
conversation.properties|m.mission_camefr: Everyone's gone. It... It came from below.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We'll hold the line\!
guild.properties|log.mist_added: Deposited {0} energy to the energy well (new total\: {1}).
item.properties|f.almirian_crusader_armo: Armor once worn by the elite royal guard of the kingdom of Almire. Its ivory color was a symbol of Almire's purity, both in the land and in the hearts of its people.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_3: Do you have any more questions about feeding and caring for your sprite?
projectx.properties|d.achievement_7542da: Forge an item up to level 10.
mission.properties|o.securing_camp_b: Help Rhendon destroy the monsters that invaded the Rescue Camp\!
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft2_r7: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.stoic_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you sense the quiet passing of the wind and can call upon the rumbling storm that follows.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_12: I admire your courage but if initial reports of this construct monster are accurate, you'll need some additional help. I'll prepare a selection of battle sprites to be ready for bonding to you, {0}. We'll talk again once I've made the proper preparations.
item.properties|f.wicked_whisker: A whisker won from the great Kat Tribe hero, Margrel. They were traditionally worn as a ward against Owlite magics but now represent the triumph of goodly magical arts over evil.
mission.properties|m.pioneers_8a: Parma was the youngest of the bunch, a very talented Recon, but with little combat experience.  She and I went to academy together and I can remember the day when the simulator technicians had thought their program was busted due to Parma's performance.  She actually apologized\! \n\nBut still, I'm worried about her.  From the reports that I've read, the Clockworks are unlike anything we've ever encountered.  I only hope that as she keeps them informed of what's ahead, that they will watch her back.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Preowa, whose artillery silenced the Grey Feather Tower Sages.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_11a: Oh my\!  What is the connection between these gremlins and that Artifact anyway?
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r7: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
mission.properties|r.search_continues_4a: What will you do now, Lieutenant?
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_123: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
support.properties|m.subheader_step200: Offensive chat is usually swearing, sexual language, violent language or racist language. We do allow some use of offensive chat when it's just considered harmless smack talk, but when it's directed at players and getting personal then it's no longer acceptable.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_expans: Select a mission card to receive a mission briefing, see the available rewards and enable options for starting the mission\! Expansion Missions must be unlocked via purchase in order to access.
item.properties|f.token_primal: A small wisp of the essential spirit of nature. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
item.properties|f.static_diskgun: A shockingly powerful handgun that creates a storm of electrified disks. Diskgun shots return once reaching their apogee.
conversation.properties|r.emberlight_vis: I have enough info, thanks. (End conversation)
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc1: You may only rename your knight every 30 days.
mission.properties|r.darkest_depths_4a: I'll make it.  Just you wait.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_2a: The recon module you collected is very strange.  I have no reason to believe what Parma was saying isn't true, but how it happened I just can't say.  Everything about the Core suggests there are no 'doors' into it.  It's not a structure built to enter from the outside.  Rather, it seems just the opposite.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of moonstone.
item.properties|f.kat_tribe_fetish: A tattered fetish from the now-extinct Kat Tribe, the ferocious feline warriors responsible for the destruction of the Owlites and their prestigious High Academy of Magicks. The fetishes were carried into battle by Kat warriors and are said to bring good luck despite the ill fate of the Kat Tribe itself.
item.properties|f.vial_fire_super: An ornate glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
item.properties|f.hail_driver: Once you've seen the splitting bolts of unnaturally cold ice it produces, you'll understand why this Driver is hailed.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Smashing\! Good luck to you, {0}. You'll need it- black kats are an unlucky bunch...
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_3: Once again you talked pretty fast, can you go over it-
item.properties|f.gremlin_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a gremlin.  It's so convincing, you just might receive an invitation to the Colony\!
sprites.properties|d.disintegration_ray: The ray of light also reduces the defense of its targets.
item.properties|f.adv_evo_catalyst: A contained charge of highly unstable energy that can be synthesized by battle sprites. In doing so, sprites can evolve into even more advanced forms with even more powerful skills.
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_suit: An advanced demolitions suit capable of resisting the strongest sleep mists. The soft glow is strangely stimulating.
item.properties|f.snarbostuffing: A dense, fluffy stuffing made from a special polymer that doesn't break down when exposed to the cursed fur of the Snarbolax. It's perfect for creating trophies or adorable, cursed, stuffed toys.
item.properties|f.blight_needle: It's a proven fact that even the most virulent of toxins is a lot more contagious if it's fired indiscriminately over a large area.
conversation.properties|m.npc_recruit_g: Have you seen a danger room yet? I hear they are really tough.
item.properties|f.prize_box_gremlin: Contains various unique costumes and items crafted by Gremlins. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
conversation.properties|m.forge_knight_5: Each item will require a specific type of Fire Crystal.  Fire Crystals can be obtained from the Supply Depot, earned by completing certain missions, and found in treasure blocks in the Clockworks\!
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_7a: It's unclear, {0}. Given Rhendon's report, I'd say they learned something from the old arcane tomes you discovered near these sprites. Fascinating that they appear to have adapted their combat abilities because of this.
item.properties|f.vial_freeze_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
dungeon.properties|m.spirits_graveyard: Shroud of the Apocrea|The Grasping Plateau
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We're in\!  This is it\!
helptips.properties|m.tg1_partypad_2: This is a party pad. It's a big floor button that only activates when all members of the party are standing on it. They often open doors, but sometimes there is a little more to it than that...
item.properties|f.shadowsun_stetson: A dashing hat for duelists who prefer to get their work done at midnight, rather than high noon.
mission.properties|b.p_anniversary_r9: Head Chef of the Skylark, Biscotti, has been tasked with baking cakes to celebrate the anniversary of Spiral Knights.  Something has apparently gone awry in her kitchen and she is requesting reinforcements to provide 'baking assistance.'
item.properties|f.blackhawk: A shadow-aligned handgun of incredible power, it's said to contain the soul of a knight who was only two days from retirement.
item.properties|f.cloak: An extraordinary cloak favored by the students of the arcane.
conversation.properties|m.emberlight_vis: Emberlight founded by gremlin outcasts from Great Colony. Gremlins of Emberlight not obey the Iron Law, so flee or die. We start over with Emberlight. New colony home to few of us\: most ex-schemers, some merchants, some fighters, all traitors in eyes of Great Colony gremlins.
auction.properties|m.search_ready: Press 'Search' to execute your current search query.
conversation.properties|m.core_resting_2: Can't wait to get back to Haven...
conversation.properties|m.tier_2_require: Well met, {0}.  In order to proceed and explore deeper depths of the Clockworks you must first achieve Rank 7-1. \n\nReturn here once you have completed the requisite Rank Missions.
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_5a: Handy, I'll keep it in mind.  What else you got?
conversation.properties|m.och_leader_2_2: Those heavy cogs are in our way, and from intel reports, the only way to open them up is from inside two adjacent gatehouses.  I will not waste needless lives battering at the gatehouse from the front.  I'll need you to find a way around.  Flank the defenses, get inside the gatehouse, and open up the gates\!
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_4a: Piercing damage is produced by slime and beast family monsters. Additionally, slime monsters tend to be weak to shadow damage and beasts themselves to piercing damage. Keep this in mind. \n\nNow then, is there anything else you require?
helptips.properties|m.tg1_crowns: Crowns are the currency of the Clockworks. You can use them to purchase all kinds of things like new weapons and armor. While playing with others, every party member gets crowns whenever anyone picks some up.
helptips.properties|m.tut_lever_alt: Switches can open doors. Try throwing a pot or shooting this one with your handgun\!
sprites.properties|d.shadow_cloak: Grants you partial invisibility and a defensive boost for a limited time. Shadow Cloak is cancelled if you take damage, attack, or perform any other action.
sprites.properties|d.heart_attack: Enchants a group of targets. If enchanted target is destroyed, it has a chance of dropping extra restorative hearts.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_mewkat: An adorable little spectral kitten that enjoys wandering around and mewing at just about everything it sees.
sprites.properties|d.iron_harness_eli: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal normal damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 10% \nCan be used by\: All battle sprites
mission.properties|b.p_r4_mat_012: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.blue_shard: A shard of Moonstone that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
item.properties|f.token_snarbolax: A long, razor-sharp tooth plucked from the mouth of a Snarbolax; a memento representing a Knight's triumph over the monstrous stalker of the Gloaming Wildwoods.
item.properties|f.haze_bomb: An alchemical bomb that creates a noxious cloud capable of stunning those caught inside.
guild.properties|log.upkeep_paid: Upkeep paid\! {0} crowns removed from the guild treasury.
item.properties|f.volt_breaker_armor: Upgraded Circuit Breaker Armor further hacked to resist shock.
logon.properties|m.steam_error: We experienced a problem authenticating with Steam. Please ensure that the Steam client is running and that you are not logged in elsewhere.
projectx.properties|m.return_to_wegner: Return to Wegner for more info about minerals.
item.properties|f.confetti_summer: When thrown, this summer confetti makes you feel all warm inside.
craft.properties|e.wrong_item_group: Variant cannot be applied to this item type.
conversation.properties|m.tut_warden_2a: You and me both. Now let's get- \n\nHold on, something's not right. Brace yourself, I think we've got company\!
item.properties|f.owlite_shield: A wooden ward carved with the crude image of a long-lost Owlite.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Devilites \nDevilites are the workhorse of the underworld. If a Pit Boss catches an idle Devilite he may promote them to an angry Overtimer or a docile Yesman.
item.properties|m.unlock_box_prompt: A Silver Key is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_wasd_move_: Keyboard used for movement, advanced commands, quickslots and chat
mission.properties|m.new_threat_4a: (Kora pauses) \n\nSpeak of the devil, Rhendon is calling now; says it's urgent. Patching him through...
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_1a: Hello {0}, I've been meaning to talk to you for some time, but it seems Spiral HQ is keeping you very busy.
prologue.properties|m.ozlo_evac: All hands\: Evacuate the ship immediately\!
mission.properties|o.the_gauntlet: Battle your way to the Firestorm Citadel through a bulwark of monstrous might
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of moonstone.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_3b: Energy is used for all sorts of things\! It's the primary currency for buying goods from the Supply Depot, it allows you to purchase upgrades for yourself, revive yourself in the Clockworks when you run out of Sparks of Life, and it's required to form a guild. \n\nYou'll also find all sorts of devices in the world that are powered up by using energy. Just look for the blue energy symbol on the device.
item.properties|f.elemental_hood: A mystical mask for sorcerous scrappers that provides significant shielding from the elements.
item.properties|f.daring_rigadoon: A savage skewer that will slow even the most salubrious of foes to a crawl.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We won't be able to move further into the base until you destroy those artillery cannons\!
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_4a: Yes, I can think of no greater tragedy.  Good luck then, {0}.
item.properties|f.surge_breaker_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at weathering the most shocking of revelations. It's not bad at resisting electric attacks, either.
mission.properties|o.another_trace: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
item.properties|f.antigua: A mysterious relic from a forgotten time. It uses explosive powder to fire its rounds.
projectx.properties|m.shutdown_warning: This server will be refreshed in {0} minutes. {1}
shop.properties|m.accessoryUseRecover: Want to recover your accessory? Use your recover ticket\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_2: Thank you for defeating the Snarbolax. Too many of our squires met an early end because of that beast. I can rest easier knowing that threat is now behind us. \n\nI look forward to hearing about your future exploits, Soldier\!
item.properties|f.wild_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
item.properties|f.frayed_fabric: The worn remains of a Clockworks denizen's duds. It could probably be recycled.
conversation.properties|r.bazaar_tour_2a: Do Strangers sell anything else besides weapons and gear?
item.properties|f.love_puppy_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a love puppy.  It's so convincing, your friends just might want a kiss\!
social.properties|m.autofriend_multiple_: Some of your {0} friends already have a full friend list\:\n{1}\n{2}
item.properties|f.artillery_beacon: A portable beacon that when deployed, summons a barrage of powerful rockets
item.properties|f.eternal_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. This orb is prized by the most powerful knights and is used to craft items of extraordinary power.
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_1a: Welcome to the Bazaar, {0}\! Would you like a tour of the shops or services?
pvp.properties|m.hazardous: Hazardous mode\! Control points will have hazards.
mission.properties|m.shadow_knows_3a: Very well, then let's begin.  Shadow damage is generally caused by concentrations of negative energy.  Attacks that inflict shadow damage include anything from the psychic manipulation of the aforementioned negative energy to physical attacks using weapons forged from dark matter.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_pier: Hi there {0}, I'm Walkon, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high piercing damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the piercing attacks of slimes and beasts. \n\nOne of the best parts about choosing piercing defense is that the armor is often made of soft, squishy jelly materials.  You could just about fall asleep in it\!
guild.properties|i.console_publish: Publish design changes to the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|o.p_fast_advancement: Quickly power up your Knight's gear\!
item.properties|f.graviton_vortex: A Graviton Bomb fortified with potentially dangerous amounts of shadow steel. Its blast should draw your foes toward it... if it doesn't rip the entire universe in two, that is.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I would like to hear about the battle sprites again.
mission.properties|o.welcome_to_haven_b: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r3: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
exchange.properties|m.billing_declined: Your card has been declined. Please check that the information you have entered is correct.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_773357: Defeat the Roarmulus Twins in the dangerous depths of the Ironclaw Munitions Factory.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_2a: Lord Vanaduke rules over the citadel now.  His soul bound to some horrific armored prison. \n\nHe has the citadel ready for battle at all times, believing that his kingdom is still under siege.  He doesn't even realize that what he is trying to protect was lost a thousand years ago.
mission.properties|o.abandoned_depot: Learn the basics of survival in the Abandoned Depot
mission.properties|m.search_continues_5a: I haven't given up the search for Euclid, Parma, Grantz and Rulen.  They're out there somewhere and I will find them, even if it means entering the Core myself.
uplink.properties|m.gift_received: Please accept this token of friendship.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_3de017: Pay a visit to Emberlight, the town of gremlin outcasts.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
mission.properties|b.ancient_generator: The Rescue Camp has no power and with it, no means of defending itself from the onslaught of monsters that attack it in the night.  With the sun setting fast, it's up to you to enter the dark depths below the camp and locate an Ancient Generator. \n\nIf you can restore power to the camp, the Spiral Knights can power their turrets and create a defensive perimeter. Once secure, it may be possible to reconnect with Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.spiral_plate_mail: Heavyweight armor made of iron plates that can withstand a great deal of standard attacks.
board.properties|m.auto_create_party: Sorry, we could not find you an available party. Do you want to start your own party?
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft3_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
item.properties|f.scrap_metal: A discarded piece of metal that could be easily repurposed.
mission.properties|r.arc_mintut_1: I'm here to learn about the minerals found within the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.personal_height: Once used, this item will permanently change your Knight's height to the specified height.
item.properties|f.blighted_bone: A peculiar patella that's seen better days, after having seen a few better knights.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_resear: We're cut off\!  Please help us defeat those lichens\!
item.properties|f.defender: A durable, high quality shield of the Spiral Order that is suitable for any adventure.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_freeze: A frosty theme that turns Guild Halls into a popular retreat during the warm, summer months on Cradle.
helptips.properties|m.tut_victory: You've made it\! Walk on ahead to enter the Rescue Camp.
item.properties|f.indestructible_giftwra: Presents wrapped with this Grinchlin gag can never be opened again. Leave it to Grinchlins to ruin complimentary gift wrapping services for everyone.
helptips.properties|m.loading12: If you experience a problem of any kind, press F2 to send a bug report.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Biotech Hahn is attempting to further his research of construct and gremlin family monsters and is requesting samples from your recent missions.  He has once again specifically requested that you be reminded of his 'other very informative lecture' that was given to you 'free of charge for the second time' when making your decision as to whether or not to comply.
item.properties|f.wizard_box: Contains one of various unique weird and wonderful wizardly items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.chroma_mask: A mask crafted from the hide of a chromalisk, offering the wearer its distinguished look.
item.properties|f.brandish: A reliable blade whose lack of ornamentation belies its strength.
help.properties|m.support_3: If you're having problems with another player, click on them and choose the Complain option for assistance.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_mail: Superior plate mail forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It's restrictive, but incredibly strong.
guild.properties|m.formation:
You may form a new guild for {0} crowns and {1} energy. The crowns will be seeded into the guild's treasury. By creating a guild you will become the Guild Master and will have the ability to invite new members into your guild. Guild features include\:
Personal Guild Hall for Guild Members only
Guild Member chat channel

mission.properties|b.alien_ooze: One of our field research teams is under siege from a large colony of lichens. Lichens are an alien species of the slime family thought to have come to the Clockworks via a meteor that crashed on to the surface of Cradle.  This particular species of slime is formed from innumerable smaller slimes that form mobile, sentient 'colonies.' \n\nLichen colonies can further combine to form larger and larger versions of themselves, rapidly evolving a range of deadly claws and barbs.  Prevent them from combining at all costs and save the research team\!

mission.properties|b.shadowplay: Even after Lord Vanaduke's defeat at your hands, Firestorm Citadel continues to burn with accursed flames. Though the nature sprites have been steadily making progress in fighting the flames, something or someone has recently caused a violent resurgence in its destructive power. Spiral HQ requests that you gather together a crack squad of knights and return to the collapsing ruins of Firestorm Citadel in order to discover the source of the disturbance.

mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_1a: There you are, {0}\!  I was beginning to think you wouldn't show up\! \n\nOk, let's get to work securing this place.  But first, you'll need to equip that Proto Bomb I gave you.  Head over to the Arsenal Station behind me and equip it.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: {0}, you've already done so much for all of us but I must now ask you to make one final sacrifice. We might never have a chance to return home to Isora, but right now Cradle needs us. I would like you to spearhead our Operations on Cradle.
mission.properties|b.rotting_metropolis: It would seem as though those slime generators have been around much longer than we thought, seeping their vile toxins into any levels that should be near them. \n\nA modern city, much like those that the devilites inhabit seems to be overrun with these toxins, and was probably left behind by both the devilites and gremlins as a result.  Now a legion of slime and undead creatures haunt the place, festering in the poisons that linger in the air.  A squad that was attempting to pass through the city has gone missing.  Given that the very air is toxic, it is urgent that an experienced team enter this city and rescue the squad.  There is little hope left for them otherwise.

item.properties|f.cobalt_armor: High-performance armor of the Spiral Order suitable for any adventure.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_1: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a prototype version.

mission.properties|r.go_shopping_6b: I think I've got it Bechamel, thanks\!
helptips.properties|m.scenario_roarmulus: The monitor shows readouts coming from a prototype of a massive war machine labeled "Project R".
guild.properties|log.expansion_added: Added the {0} expansion for {1} crowns, plus {2} crowns for pro-rated upkeep.
item.properties|f.chaos_cloak: A forbidden mantle said to grant the wearer protection within the nameless realm where all elements are said to converge into one and divide into all.
item.properties|f.flourish: A stylish saber well-appointed to foiling your enemies.
item.properties|f.furni_clutter_bone_bon: Some people would call using a jumbled pile of bones as a decorative item "daring". Everyone else? "Creepy".
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_2c: On second thought, I'm going to head out.
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_4a: Energy is essential in order to acquire powerful gear and items from the Supply Depot. \n\nYou will find all sorts of uses for it in your travels, just look for the energy symbol\!
pvp.properties|m.blast_network-info: A bombastic game of explosive action where players attempt to blow away their competition\!  Blast Network provides all participants with the gear to play, so no preparation is required to get in on the action.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r4:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
item.properties|f.blazebreak_shield: A reliable shield that'll keep you from getting too fired up in battle.
mission.properties|m.elig_unlock: You must unlock this Expansion Mission.
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_3: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
dungeon.properties|m.training_1_desc: Explore this derelict portion of the Clockworks and learn the basics required for survival.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_battlesta: A fine display commemorating a knight's full acceptance into the Spiral Order.
item.properties|f.toxic_needle: An Autogun modified to fire piercing bolts dosed with a wicked poison.
social.properties|m.trader_left: Oops\! That player is no longer here.
helptips.properties|m.tg_heat: Collecting Heat Embers will level up your gear when you reach an elevator.
item.properties|f.proto_shield: A small shield issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
conversation.properties|m.barracks_boost: Want to earn even more Krogmo Coins with every match?
sprites.properties|d.enduring_light: Increases the duration of the ray of light.
logon.properties|m.peer_redirect: You are logged into a different peer. Redirecting...

item.properties|f.circuit_breaker_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting shock. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
conversation.properties|m.almire_histori: We've recovered what little remains from Owlite Keep concerning the Kingdom of Almire. Combined with the snippets we've gotten from the nature sprites within Firestorm Citadel itself, we are starting to get a clearer picture of Almire's history.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_3a: I won't be able to relax until we've linked up with Spiral HQ.
conversation.properties|m.npc_survivorkn: They... They got everyone except me. I just hid in the corner.
helptips.properties|m.tglobby_vitapod: Vitapods temporarily increase your maximum health until you return to town.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r9: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
mission.properties|m.great_escape_3a: One was clearly not enough last time... so now there are two\! TWO\! Brilliant\!
item.properties|f.battle_chef_coat: A coat worn by the knights who work in the Skylark's galley. Not to be trifled with, these chefs are blade masters on and off the battlefield.
mission.properties|o.time_enough_at_last: Discover the fate of the lost knight within the Scarlet Fortress
sprites.properties|d.deadly_shadow_cloak: Gain an attack power and attack speed bonus when shadow cloak activates. Bonus lasts for a short duration after shadow cloak expires.
conversation.properties|r.final_test_kni: Thank you, Lieutenant, I'll head on into Haven.
item.properties|f.airbraker_shield: A lightweight, compact, and pneumatically-activated shield that expands its surface area against enemy attacks.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_shield: A spiny buckler forged from beast chitin, providing ample resistance to both heat and venom.
helptips.properties|m.rescue_door_sk: I've almost got this door open. While I'm working at it, rescue the captive knights in the area\!
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_9a: Here we have... me\!  I'm the Accessorizor, adding accessories to your gear so long as you have a ticket.  With accessories, you can make your gear really stand out in a crowd, I highly suggest giving it a try.  You'll soon become the apple of every one's eye\!
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: So, you have chosen the radiant seraphynx, battle sprite of those who wish to protect their party and provide them aid? \n\nOnce you choose there is no going back\!
item.properties|f.slumber_squall: A powerful alchemical bomb that creates a thick fog of sleepy mist.
dungeon.properties|m.graveyard_desc: A graveyard is a terrible place that simultaneously exists in the world of the living and the dead. Though they contain secret treasures in their dark corners, they are home to ancient horrors that wish to consume all who enter. Once inside, finding an exit as fast as possible is advised.
item.properties|f.divine_avenger: An upgraded Avenger forged from the purest sun steel. There are few foes remaining in this world that are worthy enough to be defeated by such a fine blade, and there are still fewer heroes worthy of wielding it.
mission.properties|r.creators_and_create: Let's talk about the hostile ones I'm likely to meet.
item.properties|f.mighty_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. While wielding it, you can feel the berserk energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
sprites.properties|d.ray_of_light: Fires a concentrated beam of light that damages anything passing through it.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_raiment: A reclaimed raiment said to resemble the Kat Tribe hero, Torair, who clung to the gates of the Owlite High Academy of Magicks as both it and his explosives burned.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_3a: Over here we have a collection of valuable items and objects you will likely find in the Clockworks.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_2: During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_8a: Yes, quite. These sprites have adapted the power to cloak, to use the very shadows around them for subterfuge. Between that and their newfound skills in toxins and debilitations, I'd say they could be quite handy on the battlefield.
item.properties|f.feral_cannon: A handgun alchemized from a hardened tortodrone shell. While wielding it, you can feel the penetrating energies within just waiting to be unleashed.
uplink.properties|m.rank_mig: Spiral Knights has recently undergone a change that has added new mission rewards to missions you have already completed. They are attached.\n\nEnjoy\!
item.properties|f.polar_day_warden_coat: An insulated coat that will keep a knight warm when facing bitter polar winds. The fur-lined armor plating makes it ideal for hours of daytime watch duty.
help.properties|m.monster_gremlin: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to SHADOW - Strong against ELEMENTAL
exchange.properties|m.crowns_tooltip: Go to the exchange where you can trade Crowns for Energy or Energy for Crowns.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_fire: A fiery theme that's sure to keep your Guild Hall warm and toasty... or sweaty.
conversation.properties|m.em_greeter_1a: Welcome to Emberlight, sanctuary for outcast gremlins.
item.properties|f.token_jelly: Typically only carried by jelly royalty, these squishy gems are the official currency of the jelly kingdoms. Though highly prized by slimes, most other creatures simply eat them as they are quite delicious.
conversation.properties|m.af_hungry: I could sure go for a snack\!
helptips.properties|m.atg_healpad: Stand on a HEART GENERATOR to restore your health\!
item.properties|f.grintovec: Your enemies will surely enjoy the cool, refreshing sensation of being hit by a glacier.
item.properties|f.salamander_suit: A suit crafted from the hide of a salamander. It grants the wearer the beast's natural resistance to fire.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: I'm not ready to choose yet.
chat.properties|m.usage_clear: Usage\: /{0}\nClears your chat display and history.
helptips.properties|m.lock_striker: Out-run anyone with the Striker Dash, hit'em hard and then leave them in the dust\! \n\nBe the ultimate damage-dealer with an increased overall attack damage and the fastest sword\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_2a: You stand within the Hall of Heroes, where the best of the Spiral Knights offer what they can to aspiring knights.  Knights like you yourself once were when you first emerged from your drop pod and found your way to Haven. \n\nAnd after so many successful missions, daring rescues and exemplary performance in battle, you now stand fit to join these heroes.
mission.properties|o.alchemy_mastery: Discover the potential of master level alchemy
item.properties|f.eye_pack_bedazzling: Contains three bedazzling eye shapes for your style kit\: Flower, Blooming, and Sparkle.
item.properties|f.horned_owlite_shield: A sturdy shield similar to the sort said to have been carried by Owlite youth.
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of crimsonite.
social.properties|m.play_pvp: Sign up for a game of {0} {1} in the Coliseum\!
item.properties|f.furni_statue: A commemorative statue that may be placed in a Guild Hall. Up to {0} statues may be placed per hall.
item.properties|f.super_blaster: A supercharged Blaster well-suited to longer expeditions down into the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.monster_spike: A shimmering accretion found during energy storms. Clockworks creatures go wild for it.
item.properties|f.battle_chef_hat: A hat worn by the knights who work in the Skylark's galley. Not to be trifled with, these chefs are blade masters on and off the battlefield.
projectx.properties|m.reboot_warning: The server will be rebooted in {0} minutes. {1}
conversation.properties|r.ritual_2c: No thanks, I'll hang on to this book for now.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_bystande: Careful in there.  Looks like they had a big one with them...
pvp.properties|m.name: Name
item.properties|f.kat_claw_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a cut-throat warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_0_1a: Well met, {0}. This is the Hall of Heroes, where veteran knights come to offer their services to members of our order who have attained the rank of Soldier or higher. \n\nBy undertaking more missions, I am confident that you will one day stand among us.
item.properties|f.token_grim: A small wisp of the essential spirit of darkness and decay. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
mission.properties|b.p_r7_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_1_1a: I was told I am to receive Star Certification here?
shop.properties|m.cart_recipe_learned: You have already learned this recipe\!
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_shad: Hello {0}, I am Sylvin, a knight who utilizes gear that offers high shadow damage defense.  The recipes I have for you produce armor and shields that protect you from the shadow attacks of fiends and the undead. \n\nShadow defense can be harnessed from the shadows themselves.  The armor and shields I specialize in are derived from the very fiendish and undead creatures that seek to use the power of the shadows against you.  Plus, it looks incredibly scary and cool.
item.properties|f.hololite_box: Contains one randomly-chosen Hololite costume or accessory.  No key is required to open.
conversation.properties|r.moorcroft_arch: I'll find those black kats and recover the Ancient Pages\!
item.properties|f.hexoskeleton: Protects the thorax, abdomen, and legs. No molting necessary.
dungeon.properties|m.training_grounds_de: This derelict portion of the Clockworks has been modified to train new recruits in the fine art of not dying when they have the rest of the world to explore.
mission.properties|b.p_ghost_machine_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 


Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has received a distress call from a derelict facility deep within the Clockworks. The distress call came in the form of a digital message saying only 'save us.' Believing it to be a potential trap, Spiral HQ has deployed Desna's Recon Rangers to investigate the facility and assist anyone who may have sent the message.
conversation.properties|m.npc_veteran_h: Stick with your squad - remember it's dangerous to go alone\!
item.properties|f.dangerous_hound_coat: A battle-ravaged coat worn by the squad leaders of the Recon Rangers, nicknamed 'hounds.' The name was likely coined due to their incredible tracking abilities or perhaps the fact that they fight like wild dogs in battle.
mission.properties|r.collector_prisoner_: Yes, but can you tell me what happened?
item.properties|f.sacred_hex_armor: A phantasmal suit of armor for those who are aiming for the infernal.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: Oh no\! Tell her the cakes will be ready. Erm, I'm just a little behind.  I'll make you a deal\: I'll give you some extra cake if we can keep this between you and me. I don't want to be kicked out of the party.
item.properties|f.ash_tail_cap: A warm hat made from hide tanned with blaze pepper. It smells faintly of curry.
item.properties|f.miracle_hood: A miraculous mask said to grant a single miracle to the wearer when they need it most.  In practice, it'll likely save your skin more often than that.
conversation.properties|t.af_chat_fiend_: And I was having such a nice nap.
item.properties|f.winged_helm: A helm whose design evokes an almost heavenly beauty.
item.properties|m.insufficient_crystals: Insufficient crystals to forge this item.
mission.properties|r.mission_sprite_3_11: I'll put an end to their scheme.
item.properties|f.shadow_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3d: Perks are unlocked at random. Some perks are much rarer than others and will require a sprite to level up very high to unlock them all. \n\nYou can even gain perks after reaching level 100\!
lottery.properties|m.lottery_announcemen: In {0}, a Birdsong Trading Co. giveaway drawing will be held amongst all online players for a prize of {1}\!
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_5a: Then I now authorize you to take on Arcade Missions.  You can access the Arcade via your Mission interface or approach the gates directly here in the Arcade itself. There is a massive world beneath your feet waiting to be explored.\n\nGood luck to you\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_jelly_c: One day I'll win enough to build my own palace\! Glorp glorp\!
mission.properties|m.rc_buddyknight_5a: It seemed like the world itself tried to trap you back there, what a close call\! \n\nKeep your wits about you when you go off exploring the Ancient Generator below.  If the surface of this world is crawling with monsters and rigged with traps, who knows what you'll find down there in the dark\!
helptips.properties|m.loading10: If you become shocked you will regularly spasm from the electricity coursing through your body. This will interrupt anything you are doing.
item.properties|f.bombastic_demo_helm: A finely-made helmet for the more discerning explosives expert. It won't tell you what kind of wine goes best with Nitronome, but it'll certainly keep your head looking good. And in one piece.
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_4a: Hail, {0}.  When you restored power to the camp, this elevator powered on as well.  I imagine it will take you down deep into the chasm below and what you will find there is anyone's guess. \n\nIf your aim is to travel down into those depths, ensure that you are ready to face whatever is waiting for you.
mission.properties|b.minerals_rock: Chief Geo Knight Wegner is responsible for researching the strange minerals that Knights have begun mining from within the Clockworks.  He believes that they may hold the answer to gaining entry into the Core and retrieving the energy needed to restore the Skylark. \n\nMeet with him in the Haven Arcade and gain an understanding of how you can help his research as well as harness the true power of the Haven Arcade\!
helptips.properties|m.tut_ghost: Ghost blocks will destroy any blocks connected to them, even unbreakable blocks\!
projectx.properties|m.love_opt_in_notice:
By enabling this option, you will gain access to knight-created arenas.
You can browse, test, and play community-made content, as well as upload your own.

All arenas are subject to approval by coliseum crew before becoming part of the playable pool.
Please review the information and terms before continuing.
sprites.properties|d.dark_harness_adv: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal shadow damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 5% \nCan be used by\: Drakon, Maskeraith
sprites.properties|d.iron_heart_attack: Targets destroyed while enchanted may also drop defense orbs.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_gre: A tall torch filled with ghastly green fire.
dungeon.properties|m.terminal_return_des: A level where travelers can safely return to the town above.
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_helm: A hardened helm made to protect intrepid explorers while they explore the unknown.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_311da7: Hit the Whammie playing the Golden Prize Wheel.
item.properties|f.guild_members_100: Allows your guild to recruit up to 100 members\!
item.properties|f.ultra_fire_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
helptips.properties|m.tg2_pickups: Pickups are items that are slotted into your belt seen at the top of the screen. They cannot leave the Clockworks and will turn to dust as soon as you return to town. Think of them as powerups and bonus items to use as you please.
item.properties|f.voltech_alchemer_mkii: An upgraded Alchemer that fires bolts of electricity at an increased rate.
item.properties|m.item_lockable: This item will bind to you when equipped.\n
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: 5 Ways to Appease Your Pit Boss
item.properties|f.furni_chess: A statuesque figurine, ideal for use in a board game.
item.properties|f.volcanic_plated_pathfi: A hardened set of armor, reinforced with volcanic alloys, made to protect against the toastiest of monsters while exploring the unknown.
helptips.properties|m.loading0: The basic play controls can be viewed at any time by pressing [[TOGGLE_HELP]].
item.properties|f.buckled_coat: A verdant coat fastened with shiny golden buckles.
mission.properties|b.true_champion: Having come out of the Firestorm Citadel alive, Intel Agent Kora eagerly awaits to hear from you.
trade.properties|e.cart_removed.n: NOTE\: a stack (of {0}) of {1} was removed from the cart.
social.properties|m.friend_request_pendi: You have already sent a friend request to {0}.
mission.properties|m.darkest_forces_2a: You have a strange definition of recreation if that's the case.  Tier 3 fiends and undead are nothing to sneeze at, in fact they're among the worst creatures you'll find so close to the Core. \n\nDevilite management seems to be the worst at these depths and that results in some very violent devilites.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_final: Just one more room lies between you and the elevator out of here. Remember what you have learned so far and you'll do just fine... at least that's the theory. Try not to die, ok?
helptips.properties|m.tg3_welcome: Welcome back to the Training Grounds. This last level will teach you the last few important things you will need to know as an explorer of the Clockworks. Head up the ramp and let's begin\!
item.properties|f.firebreak_shield: An Emberbreak Shield modified for increased protection against fire.
helptips.properties|m.unlock_gold: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use the Gold Key.
item.properties|f.gh_env_rain_torrent: A environment with almost too much rain.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_lift_2: The door ahead is locked, but you can open it with the hit switch to your left. Try throwing a clay pot at the switch. They're quite useful in this way if you don't have a gun handy.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight2_1a: Emanations from this world's core have had strange effects on our battle sprites.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_6a: Once again these sprites seem to have adapted their form to suit their surrounding environment.
exchange.properties|m.offertosell_toolti: Submit your offer to the market. If a buyer is found while you are online, you will receive a chat notification.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_3a:
Re\: Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

Thank you for your prompt response.  Unfortunately your resource allocation has been denied. 

Reason\: 
Provided summary of need for requested resources\: 'All hail the great and terrifying Maulos, true lord of the Blinding Abyss.'
invite.properties|m.description_invitati: Invite a friend to come join you in\nSpiral Knights\!\nFill in their e-mail address and we'll send them an invitation to join.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_3d4b16: Amass an Arsenal that includes a 5 star helmet, armor, shield, gun and bomb.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_undead: The ruins of Owlite castles are dark and cursed places that are swarming with legions of undead spookats.  The worst of these, the seemingly invincible grimalkins, constantly lurk in the shadows, awaiting the moment your life-saving light is finally snuffed out. \n\nSome knights succumb to the darkness and become paralyzed with fear in these shadowy realms. The only thing that can save them are brave knights who have long lost their childhood fears of the dark and all the terrible creatures that lurk within.
conversation.properties|r.rc_instruct_1b: No questions, just actions. I'm off now.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_1a: Be on your guard here, {0}, whatever the gremlins were up to here has made for a very treacherous environment. \n\nLet's hurry to the sprite cache before any more are lost\!
conversation.properties|m.monsterboost_h: It's hard to tell, but it seems to correlate to Constructs. \n\nThese Mecha Knights went wild\! Faster, stronger -- I think one was trying to climb the elevator\!
exchange.properties|m.opening_mobile: Opening mobile phone checkout in your browser...
item.properties|f.officer_door: Installs a force barrier at the entrance of the room that can only be passed by guild members of Officer rank and up.
item.properties|f.prize_box_rage: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_blu: A Spiral-issued light source typically used to illuminate special areas, or indicate the presence of a limited-time sale.
helptips.properties|m.loading18: Check out wiki.spiralknights.com, where brave adventurers document what they discover in the depths of the Clockworks\!
item.properties|f.pumpkin_bombhead_mask: A Bombhead Mask bearing a meancing grimace reminiscent of the great, gourdly Punkin King.
item.properties|e.not_use_snow_bucket: Can't use this item now. It can only be used in town or in a guild hall. There can only be 10 in use at once.
guild.properties|m.remove_expansion: Removing this expansion will lower upkeep but will also remove any installed rooms in the expansion. Any furnishings in the expansion will be returned to the Guild Treasury.\nYou will lose the following rooms\: {0}

mission.properties|o.terminal_meltdown: Destroy the fiery monsters in the fuel depot and prevent an explosive disaster
mission.properties|b.strength_unity: Something has riled up a pack of beasts in the Aurora Isles and they have descended upon a Geo Knight research team.  Cornered, the team has sent a distress signal and Spiral HQ has issued the task of saving them to you. \n\nBy standing together, the Geo Knights have made it this long but their time is running out. Assemble a team and confront the beasts that seek to devour your fellow knights\!
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight3_1a: We managed to pull the secondary generator from the Skylark mostly intact. Unfortunately it's barely powerful enough to keep this lab running, let alone power our ship.  We'll need to find another power source if we ever hope to return home.
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_5a:
Ok, back to business then. 

Punch can add Unique Variants, a kind of special bonus to your weapons and gear for a price. But his methods are, er... chaotic.  You never really know what you're going to get. 

Vise is a little more precise.  He can unbind your weapons and gear for a price, allowing you to sell or gift the item again\!
item.properties|f.freezing_vaporizer: An alchemical bomb that produces a cloud of ultra-low temperature mist.
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_1a: Too late again\! I have already collected the power I need to use the Artifact and nothing you can do now will stop what I have set in motion.
item.properties|f.empty_room_checker_lar: An empty Guild Hall room with mixed flooring and plenty of space for furniture\!
item.properties|f.steamvalve_mask: Though now outdated by more sophisticated devices, these special pressurized masks were once used by soldiers in environments with extreme atmospheres. The pressure valve on the back would have to be turned just so or the soldier's head would, well, implode.
item.properties|f.armor_back: An accessory that can be attached to the back of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.guild_members_200: Allows your guild to recruit up to 200 members\!
helptips.properties|m.scenario_torin: A fading inscription reads\: Here lies Torin, knight of Almire.

support.properties|m.option_203_0:
You have to be 13 years or older to play this game. If someone admits in chat that they are under 13 then please click here to file the complaint against them.

Do NOT use this option if you simply believe the player to be underage, as there has to be proof in the last few minutes of chat. If there is no proof, then you should drop the complaint.
