mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_1a:
(You see the lost soul of Almire standing before you.  In his face you see a profound sadness.  Staring beyond you he begins to speak without introduction.) 

Lord Vanaduke brought the fire from the mountains to our kingdom.  Everything burned.  His enemies.  Even his family. 

My family was lost too.  I fled the battle as soon as I saw the wave of flames in the distance.  I was able to reach my home just in time to see it burn.  I don't even remember how it ended.  I have no memory of my passing.
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of luminite.
item.properties|m.exp_upkeep: This expansion will increase your Guild Hall's upkeep by {0} crowns.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_mat_3: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.book_of_dark_rituals: An ancient grimoire filled with unspeakable eldritch rites. Just like any cursed tome, there is likely some twisted individual out there who wants it for extremely nefarious purposes. Trade with caution.
item.properties|f.draped_armor: A stylish suit of armor that adds a touch of class to battle.
item.properties|f.azure_guardian_armor: A grand set of armor commonly donned by the leaders of the Spiral Order. It's extraordinarily thick and protective, but as comfortable to wear as flowing miracloth.
item.properties|f.vial_sleep_super: An ornate glass vial containing a drowsy draught. It can be used to inflict enemies with Sleep.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and your foes will be snoring in seconds\!
item.properties|f.grim_buster: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. Shadows seem to seep from the barrel whenever it is brought to bear.
item.properties|f.fused_demo_helm: An upgraded Demo Helm fused dangerously with the unstable core from a powerful Blast Cube. It produces an unpleasant hum in your ears.
item.properties|f.starlit_demo_helm: An illuminated helm strengthened against soporific smogs. It's surprisingly soft inside.
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Everyjelly is welcome at the Golden Slime\!
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_3: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
projectx.properties|m.pvp_gear: Gear restricted due to Coliseum signups. (Click Here)
conversation.properties|r.rc_greet2_3a: I'll meet up with Rhendon before I investigate the generator.
mission.properties|b.time_enough_at_last: A knight named Edger has gone missing while exploring the Scarlet Fortress.  Given that this crumbling castle is swarming with spookats and jelly cubes, his squadmates fear for his safety and have asked a more experienced knight like yourself to investigate. \n\nLocate Edger within the fortress and bring him back to Haven\!
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
mission.properties|m.darkest_depths_3a: It's just a feeling really.  I hear it from some of the other knights as well\: a feeling like we... belong here, like maybe the crash occurred for a reason. \n\nBut that just can't be, right?  In any case, I'm rambling now.  Back to the mission\!
mission.properties|m.name: Name
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_stri: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_2a: Battle sprites level up by acquiring heat, just like your weapons and gear. They can acquire heat in two ways\: absorbing it as you battle in the Clockworks and by consuming materials and synthesizing them into heat.
support.properties|m.option_201_0: Instead you could simply click here to ignore {0} so you won't have to listen to them again.
mission.properties|m.collector_prisoner_: Ugh, I can barely see... did Spiral HQ send you to rescue us?
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_2:
Great\! There are two ways to help me out\: 

You can accept the new Prestige Mission 'Total Caketastrophe,' which is available daily. 

Or you can journey into the Clockworks and weed out infestations of these 'Creep Cakes' as much as you like.  Just look for the tell-tale frosting\!
item.properties|f.big_angry_bomb: An immensely powerful bomb with a terrible attitude.
item.properties|f.illuminating_ward: A personal candle for warding off the darkness, and that which lurks within it.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_2: Indeed\! A battle sprite can synthesize matter into useable energy. This machine can take certain materials and alchemize them into extra special sprite food... that is, when it's finally calibrated.
item.properties|f.boltbrand: A high-tech blade that fuses Spiral and Clockwork technology. It can produce a powerful electrical discharge that is harmless to knights.
item.properties|f.sharp_fang: A particularly pointy premolar. Or maybe it's a canine?
conversation.properties|m.bazaar_tour_15: Well, that about covers the basics of the Bazaar.  It's a really fantastic place to find just about anything you need. \n\nDo you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_5: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
mission.properties|o.from_below: Find and save the squad of Recon Rangers
item.properties|f.binding_essence: A strange, vile reagent thought to be harnessed by the Apocrea to build their structures. Once it gets on your skin it seems to never wash off. No, it must, you simply need to scrub harder. Harder, yes...
mission.properties|b.skies_under_cradle: The Clockworks are a fascinating underground complex that houses entire worlds within its colossal, iron geo-globes.  One of them that recon knights have discovered is known as the 'Aurora Isles,' a series of mysterious floating islands under a false sky. \n\nAs a newly ranked Apprentice, you now have clearance to explore the ruins within these islands and collect any useful materials you may discover.
mission.properties|m.elig_ok_replay: You are eligible to replay this mission.
item.properties|f.nightblade: A short slicer infused with the essence of the Underworld.
pvp.properties|m.bribe_description: Everyone can pitch in to bribe King Krogmo. Fill the meter with energy to reveal a BONUS PRIZE\!
item.properties|f.magnus: A large handgun with hard hitting rounds that can leave even the strongest of monsters dazed. A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
item.properties|f.gran_faust: An upgraded Faust forged from pristine-quality shadow steel. Its charge attacks are powerful enough to curse its wielder, but that hasn't stopped Devilites from treasuring these rare blades even more highly than their meager vacation time.
item.properties|f.mighty_cobalt_helm: An advanced Spiral Knight helm forged from a rare alloy of Moonstone and Luminite.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_gate_construct: Destroy the operational war machines within the ruined factory\!
mission.properties|o.beyond_axes_of_evil: Crush the new gremlin logging operation in the Jigsaw Valley
helptips.properties|m.need_key_grim_gate: The Grim Gate requires a Fiendish ID Card to activate.
design.properties|i.place_room: Install a room at this location.
sprites.properties|d.dazzling_light_ray: The ray of light deals extra damage to undead and fiend family monsters.
mission.properties|m.silent_legion_1a: Have they sent you for me?  To bring me back?  No, I am where I belong now. I no longer serve the Spiral Order and will remain here. \n\nLeave this place and never come back.  Leave me be.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_wandering_sn: A curious snipe that will explore its surroundings.
item.properties|f.woven_sentinel_armor: A suit of armor imbued with interwoven wolver hair to protect against even the harshest elements.
mission.properties|b.shocking_sentient_s:
Recon Knights have uncovered a secret weapons facility that according to the intel we have available, could belong to a high ranking gremlin of The Crimson Order.  It is heavily fortified by a small army of electrified constructs who have no doubt been programmed to defend the facility at all costs. 

While it is unclear if this weapons stash actually belongs to a gremlin of The Crimson Order, it is no less worth infiltrating and neutralizing the weapons stash. 

It is advised that you prepare yourself with elemental damage and shock resistant gear before deploying.
item.properties|f.deadly_virulisk_mask: A Virulisk Mask upgraded with an advanced toxin filter. It always smells like artificial pine needles on the inside.
item.properties|f.vial_curse_super: A glass vial containing concentrated fiend essence. It can be used to inflict enemies with Curse.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and give your foes 10 years of bad luck\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.
exchange.properties|m.offertobuy_tooltip: Submit your offer to the market. If a seller is found while you are online, you will receive a chat notification.
conversation.properties|m.tier_1_require: Well met, {0}.  In order to proceed and explore deeper depths of the Clockworks you must first achieve Rank 4-2. \n\nReturn here once you have completed the requisite Rank Missions.
monster.properties|m.overtime_3: Glad I caught you. I'm looking for someone to really rise to the challenge this weekend...
mission.properties|o.pumping_up: Visit the Advanced Training Hall and learn some helpful new techniques
item.properties|d.gsc_vip: C O M P L I M E N T A R Y\n\nBecause you are a key casino patron, we are pleased to offer you membership free of charge.
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_1a: This is it, recruit. This is the final gate that leads out of the Rescue Camp, through the chasm and into Haven. Once you pass through, you will never need to return here. You can buy everything found in the Rescue Camp and much more in Haven. \n\nAny questions?
conversation.properties|m.core_guard_1: You should go speak with Vaelyn.
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch:
Black kats are the darkest souls of the former Kat Tribe. They carry the heaviest curse of all and mindlessly seek to devour magical auras. This constant consuming of power makes them incredibly strong. 

They were likely attracted to the power radiating from the ancient grimoires here in the Archives. 

Please {0}, you must help us restore the Moorcroft Archives\!
guild.properties|m.published: The Guild Hall has been updated\!
mission.properties|b.p_r7_weap_3: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
projectx.properties|i.render_effects: Enables more detailed graphical effects, but\nmay reduce graphics performance with less powerful systems.
item.properties|f.clockblocker: A mechanical shield with machined wheels, pinions, and gears that mesh with exacting tolerances, making it a precision timekeeping instrument.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_2a:
Re\: Resource allocation request, Amu-Sol 

You are receiving this mail as a result of an incorrect/cryptic entry in your recent resource allocation request.  Please provide a detailed summary of your projected use of the following requested resources\: 
- 999 'Open minded' devilites 
- 50 barrels of 'whatever frostifurs eat' 
- A 'towering pillar' of everfrost and 'all the frozen souls it brings forth'
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_b_5a: Ok, practice a few bomb attacks and then head in there and destroy those monsters\!

mission.properties|b.best_of_beast: After a recent promotion, Biotech Hahn has earned the title of 'Chief Biotech.' He was informed of your recent accomplishments and would like to give you a quick briefing on what you can expect from the beast and slime family of monsters as you approach the Core.
uplink.properties|m.tx_failed: Something went horribly wrong, but we were able to recover the following item(s).\n\nPlease contact a support agent if anything is still wrong.
item.properties|f.punkin_sprout: A small sprig capable of growing into a grand gourd.

mission.properties|m.target_acquired_2a: Yes, Project R appears to be in fact two massive weapons known as the 'Roarmulus Twins.'  Designed by one of the Crimson Order itself, the Roarmulus Twins are some kind of construct cannon that the gremlins intend on moving up the Clockworks into the Haven Arcade\! \n\nBased on what the schematics suggest, their power far exceeds standard gremlin weaponry and could be truly devastating to Haven, Spiral HQ and the Strangers should it reach the Arcade.
item.properties|f.volcanic_salamander_su: A Salamander Suit reinforced with sturdy plates of volcanic iron. Extremely protective, and usable as a makeshift stove during long deployments.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_5a: In the mean time we'll run an analysis on that strange device you found in the Royal Jelly Palace. If it is related to the Artifact, we'll find out soon enough\! \n\nGood luck, {0}.
item.properties|f.obsidian_hood_of_sight: 'Through my eyes you will see the path to ages. Pure is my gaze, free from the lies of reality.'
projectx.properties|i.style_kit: Use cosmetic items to permanently add them.
social.properties|m.discord_join_req: A discord player is asking to join your party. Please check the discord client.
item.properties|f.teddy_bear_buckler: A high-tech energy shield disguised as a harmless teddy bear. The perfect companion to defend against minions of the night.
item.properties|f.kat_claw_hood: A crudely hewn hood made to resemble a cut-throat warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
item.properties|f.quilted_hunting_coat: A flexible coat lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. It smells musty.
exchange.properties|m.credit_card_toolti: Purchases the selected amount of Energy right now with your credit card.
guildhelp.properties|m.storage_info: The Guild Storage acts like a community item bank. Guild members of the appropriate rank can add or remove equipment or items to the Storage as they see fit. It's a great way to share resources between guildmates, or to help out newer members\!\n WARNING\: Items placed in Guild Storage can be removed and claimed by any guild member with access to Guild Storage. Do not put items into Guild Storage that you want to keep for yourself\!
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_5a: It would seem so.  And this place, it just radiates evil, it's almost indescribable.  It's even starting to affect the levels surrounding it- fires are breaking out everywhere. \n\nYou're one of the best we've got, {0} and if there's anyone that could lead a squad through the citadel it's you.  But even reaching it won't be easy.  We're going to need to take care of a few fires and gather a bit more intel before storming the gates.
mission.properties|o.shadow_knows: Learn about monsters that inflict shadow damage
mission.properties|m.ending_in_fire_2a: At the rate you're going you just might, {0}\!  Though based on new intel it would seem that's not going to be easy.
item.properties|f.dusker_cap: A hide helm for knights that prefer to take their opponents on toe-to-toe.
item.properties|f.magic_cloak: A wondrous robe worn by apprentices in the art of spells and sorcery.
mission.properties|b.vile_engine:
Somewhere below a level that lichens have taken to inhabiting lies a strange facility of unknown origin that seems to be used for the production of toxic slime monsters. The 'slime generators' are capable of rapidly producing slime monsters that then quickly populate nearby levels. 

Squads in neighboring levels have already reported overwhelming numbers of toxic slimes, making it impossible to lead expeditions beyond depth 23.  It is time a knight of your caliber form a squad to infiltrate this strange facility and shut down production of these vile creatures. 

Any data that you could collect as to their origin would be highly valuable to Spiral HQ.
projectx.properties|m.rename_too_soon: You have renamed your knight too recently.
item.properties|f.furni_shelf_manor_book: An unassuming shelf filled unworldly tomes of unspeakable power.
item.properties|f.no_door: Removes any door presently installed and leaves the room open for anyone to enter.
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: This place gives me the chills.
item.properties|f.deep_sea_cuirass: A suit of armor with iridescent scales that seem to move like shimmering waves. The armor is rather uncomfortable to wear as it is naturally cold and wet at all times.
item.properties|f.punkin_pie_pan: A hot steamy pie made from real gourdlings\! Not suitable for Knight consumption, please discard at nearest friend.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_6a: Indeed.  Let's start by putting out some fires and then we'll see about trying to get to the citadel.  Given the opposition, it's a one in a million shot. \n\nGood luck, {0}.
item.properties|f.industrial_hard_hat: Normally worn by construction workers, this hat doesn't offer much defense but grants the wearer high stun resistance.
social.properties|m.trade_request_pendin: You have already sent a trade request to {0}.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
mission.properties|m.apocrea_2_5a: Once freed you will collect an Apocrean Sigil as proof of your deed. Bring these to me and my friend here will reward you with special treasures I have collected during my time in this world. You can use these items to craft rare and powerful items using that obelisk of creation over there.
guild.properties|e.already_withdrew: You have already withdrawn from an energy well today and must wait 24 hours.
monster.properties|m.fired_3: Ahh, I'm gonna have to fire you. OK?
uplink.properties|m.newsletter_resub: If you had previously subscribed to the newsletter, just confirm your email address and resubscribe to claim your Proto Crest accessory\!
conversation.properties|m.fc_court_remin: Once you find a sprite, carry them back to the sacred circle you see before you. They are no doubt weakened from Vanaduke's curse and will require rejuvenation. Once we are all reunited we will form a focus link with the Spirit Mother and bring water to the wells.\n\nPlease hurry\!
mission.properties|b.time_to_crafty: Bosco would like you to alchemize a Hot Edge and Frost Gun for him to inspect. If it's good, he'll inform Spiral HQ that you've grasped the vital art of alchemy and even add a couple powerful Unique Variants to your new weapons.  What a generous guy\!
conversation.properties|m.biscotti_1: Hi there, I'm Biscotti, Head Chef of the Skylark\!  We've got a little situation on our hands that may or may not involve sentient, monstrous cakes that may or may not have completely overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks... \n\nAnyway, I've worked it out with the Strangers to provide rewards for turning in slices of cake that prove you've helped eradicate these horrible monsters that may or may not exist.
item.properties|f.vitasuit_plus: High-tech mail that provides the wearer with myriad medical boons, including bonus health, glossier hair, and fresher breath.
mission.properties|m.toxic_plant_2b: All traces of Compound 42 should be eliminated, along with the facility and any engineers not part of the inner fold. Remind the scorchers who find these orders uncomfortable that those who disobey shall soon hear my whisper in their ears. \n\nSeal the doors and burn everything to the ground.
mission.properties|r.new_threat_5a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
item.properties|f.great_defender_c: A well-crafted costume version of a classic shield.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_suit: An upgraded Skelly Suit infused with the elemental essence of fear. It comes standard with matching pants that cannot be scared off.
item.properties|f.gorgomega: A terrifying shield that combines the dual-crushing power of a gorgo and the mythical tortomega. Crushing enemies has never been more fiendishly fun.
projectx.properties|m.please_relaunch: Please quit and re-run the game to check your new options.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight7_1a: Initial readings are off the charts, {0}\!  We've never encountered anything like this before.  It will take some time to fully understand what this object is used for.
conversation.properties|m.rc_recruit_d: Between the warmth of the fire and the safety of the defensive turrets, I think I'll sleep well tonight.
item.properties|f.prisma_driver: A high-tech alchemical sidearm that fires powerful prisma bullets that split multiple times on impact.
item.properties|f.primal_ore: An extraordinary metal imbued with the savage spirit of the wild.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_hard: Elite difficulty features an exceptional challenge for fearless players who have mastered combat. Monsters and traps are very deadly. Heat, crown, loot payouts and chances for rarities are greatly increased.
item.properties|f.fiend_portal_key: Using this will allow you to open and pass through the Grim Gate in the Ancient Grove.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_weap_4: Deliver the requested item to squad in need.
chat.properties|m.usage_loadout: Usage\: /{0} [loadout]\nList loadouts, or equip a named loadout.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_1a:
Hello there my good Knight, I am Armero, great hunter of the wilds and curator of this prestigious lodge you see before you. 

On the walls are some of the many trophies claimed from many courageous expeditions, where life and limb were put on the line in order to experience the pure, untamed thrill of the hunt. 

Now I say, do you have the same spark within you? The same taste for the open air, for danger?
mission.properties|r.anniversary_gremlin: Biscotti asked me to come check on you.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A squishy gem highly prized by slimes. This one was liberated from the Royal Jelly Palace and painstakingly preserved as a conversation piece.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_3a: Our recent intel from Recon Knights suggest that gremlins are planning something big.  We believe they are developing some kind of weapon they're calling 'Project R' that will be targeting Haven itself.  Spiral HQ and the Strangers themselves are requesting that you investigate the matter given your performance in the Royal Jelly Palace.
item.properties|f.heavenly_iron_helm: A powerful helm said to be crafted from angelic shields.  It retains many divine properties celestial beings possess but lacks their weakness to fire.
item.properties|f.boosted_plate_shield: A beautifully refinished Plate Shield that's been given an internal power source to help keep the most battering of blows at bay.
item.properties|f.fowl_cowl_vol: A beaked mask shrouded in a scorched hood. Herald in the new year in this elemental gown.
item.properties|f.token_spirit: An otherworldly brand placed upon a soul claimed by the mysterious Apocrea. Removing it allows the captured soul to escape imprisonment within the terrible realm of the Apocrea.

uplink.properties|m.tf2_start:
G'Day, loyal customer\! 

You may have recently heard that I've become the fourth richest man in America, having surpassed the fifth richest man in wealth, and having killed the previously-fourth richest man in a harpoon duel. While this is, of course, entirely true (especially the part about the harpoon duel, which was long and bloody), it's not nearly enough. Fourth place might be fine for HIPPIES who wouldn't know victory if it wandered up and offered to braid their ponytails, but it's damn well not good enough for Saxton Hale\! 

Mister Reddy, my accountant, explained to me that the best way to light a fire under the backside of Mann Co.'s revenue would be to "open up new markets". I'd relate exactly how we plan on doing that to you, but as he was talking I immediately started doing military presses to keep from dying of boredom, and missed out on the intricate details. 

All you need to know, dear customer, is that I need a good man to find his way to a town called "Haven", bravely stride into one of the many gates there and then cut his way down to the first "Clockworks Terminal". Since we couldn't find a good man, you'll have to do it yourself. You'll be amply rewarded, of course\: there's NOTHING I wouldn't do for an employee who risked life and limb on a trivial task necessitated by my selfish whims. 

Don't bother directly contacting me once you're done, as I'll be too busy kickboxing giraffes to care. One of my other employees will handle things from there. Best of luck\: you'll need it\! 

Sincerely yours, 

SAXTON HALE 
Australian 
CEO, Mann Co.
guildhelp.properties|m.guild_hall_info:
The Guild Hall is the nerve center for any Spiral Knights guild. Here, guild members can relax, plan future missions, and take advantage of the various Guild Hall amenities at their disposal. The Guild Hall is extremely customizable, and can be expanded to fit guilds of all sizes. It can also contain a wide variety of unique furniture and room types, so coordinate with your friends to make your Guild Hall a true reflection of your guild\!
 When a Guild Hall is first opened, it consists of two rooms\: a lobby, and the Command Console room. Guilds wishing for more space to customize can purchase expansions to increase the base size of their guild hall. These are available from the Command Console while in Design Mode.
 Guilds that have expanded the usable space in their Hall can fill that space with a variety of different rooms, available for purchase from the Birdsong Emporium. These rooms can be as simple as an empty room for placing furniture, or they can contain one of a number of different guild amenities, such as alchemy terminals, shops and more\!
 Guild Halls require a large amount of resources to maintain, which is represented by a weekly upkeep cost in Crowns. As a Guild Hall gains more expansions, this cost increases, so make sure there's enough Crowns in your Guild Treasury to pay for everything\!

mission.properties|b.king_of_ashes:
Within the ever-burning depths of the Firestorm Citadel, Lord Vanaduke lies in wait for any living being to pass into his accursed kingdom.  Any squad that has ever attempted to infiltrate the citadel has perished or was simply lost, like the countless lost souls bound to this terrible realm. 

Lord Vanaduke is ready for war, believing in his twisted mind that any who dare enter the citadel to be an invading force bent on overtaking his kingdom.  He stands as the last obstacle before gaining access to the Core and the Spiral Knights having any chance of restoring the Skylark and returning home. 

As a Champion of the Spiral Knights, you alone have what it takes to lead a team into the very heart of this inferno and face the titanic might of Lord Vanaduke.

help.properties|m.support_4: To report a bug in the game, press F2. Keep in mind that bug reports are not answered, but they include non-personal debug information that helps track down the root of the problem. If you need assistance from a GM, please file an in-game support request.
item.properties|f.prize_box_dangerous: Contains various unique items used by Desna's elite Recon Rangers. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.perfect_snowball: An icy snowball of almost mythical perfection. Though it begs to be thrown squarely into the side of someone's head, it would be best to use in alchemy.
item.properties|f.fiery_pepperbox: When you've been attacked by a swarm of Ice Cubes, all Knights agree\: happiness is a Fiery Pepperbox.
item.properties|f.seraphic_helm: A beautiful mail coif that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
projectx.properties|i.limit_fps: Limit the frame rate to avoid overtaxing your video card, especially if offscreen.
mission.properties|m.once_only: This mission can only be played once per day.
mission.properties|m.breaking_in_recruit: Greetings, little. One. Don't step. On snipes.
conversation.properties|m.hav_guardian_1: Welcome to Haven, {0}, we've been expecting you.
item.properties|f.valkyrie_helm: A priceless helmet whose name denizens of the Underworld dare not mention.
item.properties|f.gm_helmet: An impressive indigo helmet that's the indisputable indication of one of the Spiral Order's incredible Game Masters.
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_short_gr: A short torch filled with ghastly green fire.
chat.properties|m.unspecific_command: Command not specific enough, did you mean "{0}?"
helptips.properties|m.tut_hearts: Break these blocks to receive hearts. Hearts restore your health. You cannot pick them up unless you need them.
item.properties|f.cooling_cell: A small device used in complex machines to keep them from overheating. Also handy to keep in your pockets on hot summer days.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_gremlin: A dash of Moonstone, a pinch of... H... How did you... Who are you\!? You're not supposed to be here\!
item.properties|f.crimsonite_deposit_3: A large lump of minerals that will generate a great many units of crimsonite.
item.properties|f.philoso_feather: A large, grey feather plucked from the greatest of the Owlite magicians.
conversation.properties|m.lab_biscotti_5: A sprite's appetite will increase naturally over time, though slowly. To increase appetite quickly, take it for a run in the Clockworks. Absorbing heat from monsters is a great way to burn calories\!
mission.properties|m.the_flickering_flam: Oh, {0}\! As if all these strange occurrences weren't bad enough, I have some shocking news for you.
mission.properties|b.honor_duty: Lieutenant Feron would like a brief word with you regarding your achievement in breaking through the Firestorm Citadel.
item.properties|f.armor_ankle: An accessory that can be attached to the ankle of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
pvp.properties|m.hardcore: Hardcore mode\! Hazards are on and autotarget is off.
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_5: It will take a little time to get all of our equipment fully working again.
conversation.properties|m.tut_intro3_3c: Remember, press [[?DEFEND]] to use your shield\!
item.properties|f.spine_cone: A ferocious device that is positively bursting with briars.
help.properties|m.clockworks_1: The Clockworks is your gateway to the planet's Core\! It's filled with a huge variety of worlds and populated with monsters and treasure beyond your imagination. Beware, however\: the deeper you go below the surface, the tougher and smarter your opponents will become\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_2a: And speaking of gremlins, we're starting to get an alarming number of reports of gremlins mobilizing in the Clockworks below Haven.  We don't have too many details yet, but given the relations we've had with them so far, our guess is they're preparing for an attack.
item.properties|f.chess_room: An empty room with an 8x8 chess board in the corner and a row for spectators.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Sneak around and see if you can get inside that gatehouse\!
item.properties|f.wild_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who are deeply connected to the natural order of the great wilderness.
mission.properties|r.best_of_beast_1a: Well thanks Hahn, it's almost as if-
item.properties|f.schemer_scrap: A fragment of a blueprint used by gremlin schemers to construct their mechanical monstrosities. With enough of them and a little tape, you could construct a metal death machine yourself\!
mission.properties|b.p_halloween_r4: Every year the Strangers of Haven pay tribute to a peculiar spirit known as the 'Punkin King' in order to ensure a healthy fall harvest.  This mischievous phantom delights in playing tricks on his audience but is quick to reward them with delicious candies for their troubles. \n\nCelebrate the Dark Harvest Festival and help the Strangers by seeking out the Punkin King and paying tribute.  You're sure to collect some candy along the way, so visit the Haven Town Square and turn it in for prizes\!
design.properties|e.regenerating: Design Mode is regenerating. Please try again in a moment.
mission.properties|m.alone_in_dark_4a: (The lost soul continues to stare beyond you, saying nothing.)
uplink.properties|m.love_accepted: Krogmo thanks you for your kindly contribution.
item.properties|f.buccaneer_bicorne: A trusty cap that offers tough protection from sun, wind, storms and spiteful seagulls.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_mat_012: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
conversation.properties|r.test_greeter_1: I shall do my best in this test\!
item.properties|f.driftwood: A peculiar piece of wood that just won't stay put.
item.properties|f.rocket_hammer_2: Designed by Warmaster Seerus himself, this nefarious gremlin weapon is equipped with a rocket engine that can launch the wielder forward with a powerful hammer smash.  This particular model is a more stable version that blew up gremlin test subjects far fewer times than the prototype.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
item.properties|l.inspect_pack: This pack contains all of the following items.
social.properties|m.empty_feed: No recent event activity. Check back later.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I just put in another bulk order for office supplies. We keep running out.
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_shield: A huge reinforced shield perfect for brushing off blows and fending off foes.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: C.U.B.E. Club Members may spin up to 50 times at once.\nRequires Golden Slime Coins.
item.properties|f.ignition_helm: A lightweight helmet augmented to keep a knight's head cool under pressure.
item.properties|f.ironmight_plate_helm: A superior plate helmet forged from an alloy of several rare metals. It'll restrict your peripheral vision a bit, but it's virtually impregnable.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_1a: Whew, I'm glad you came along when you did. Those pesky gremlins were going to wreck everything\! The bazaar would have been ruined\!\n\nOh right, where are my manners? My name is Tylen, it's a pleasure to meet you, {0}.
mission.properties|m.choose_your_sprite_: There are three distinct battle sprites available. Each has responded to the power emanating from this world differently and each offers a unique combat experience. \n\nThese sprites include the fiery drakon, the radiant seraphynx, and the shadowy maskeraith.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2c: What should I do once I reach Haven?
item.properties|f.spiral_hood: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.flak_jacket: A lightweight armored jacket that keeps you looking and feeling cool.
item.properties|f.swordstone: A fine chunk of natural rock perfect for honing the edge of a deadly blade.
item.properties|f.obsidian_obstacle: A baleful shield of obelisk fragments bound by Apocrean ritual. Every time the fragments align, dark memories echo in your mind.
item.properties|f.super_slime_slasher: A shovel with a wicked edge that's especially well-suited to fighting slimes in the trenches.
mission.properties|b.p_fast_advancement: Use this Test Server exclusive mission to quickly power up your weapons and gear.  Each level of this mission is exactly the same, allowing you to change your equipped weapons and gear at each depth. \n\nOnly a few heat embers are needed to max out any item\! 'Return to Haven' before you reach the end so you can come back to this mission.
mission.properties|m.winterfest_danger_4: Mount Grinchlin is an oppressive environment and few knights likely have the fortitude to reach its summit. If you feel things getting too rough, take the exit\! Otherwise you risk losing everything\!
mission.properties|b.in_cold_blood: Something has really riled up the chromalisks in the levels below the town of Emberlight.  Spiral HQ sent a squad in to investigate and they quickly fell off the radar. Now they've sent out a distress signal stating that they're cornered at depth 21 by chromalisks of all varieties. \n\nBiotechs speculate these chromalisks are agitated due to their proximity to the Core. Others believe it may be mating season.  Regardless of the reason, the squad needs saving before they meet their end to the likes of these lizards\!
mission.properties|b.eye_of_needle: After compiling the data you collected from the Owlite keep and additional intel from Recon Knights, Intel Agent Kora has prepared a debriefing for you with regard to the mass of negative energy blocking access to the Core.
dungeon.properties|m.royal_jelly_desc: The Royal Jelly Palace is an ancient castle overtaken by a legion of slime monsters. It is unclear what purpose the castle serves, though it is rumored to house a Royal Jelly, said to be nobility within the slime kingdoms. If true then the purpose of the castle is likely to serve the Royal Jelly, and nothing more.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_1a: What's this? Another poor soul ripe for harvest by the Apocrea?
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_bomb: Hello {0}, I'm Remi, a knight who specializes in bombs and explosives.  The recipes I have for you are pretty straightforward- producing weapons and gear that focus on blowing up your enemies to smithereens\! \n\nUsing bombs isn't a fire and forget kind of affair though.  Bombs require an understanding of timing, both before and after you drop one, in order to get the most bang for your buck.  The gear I specialize in will make you a knight that your squad sends in to take down many enemies at once.  Bombs are great for clearing out a mob of beasties in one swift KA-BOOM\!
item.properties|f.frost_gun: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity, alchemical freezing agent.
shop.properties|p.sell_costume: Are you sure you want to sell costume items for very little crowns? This is a bad deal.
mission.properties|b.first_mission: Are you a dev? Do you enjoy enjoying things? Can you read? Let this mission be an example to you.
helptips.properties|m.tut_breakable: Some blocks like these can be broken. Attack them to clear the path.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_4: Once you safely reach the elevator, the mineral you are carrying gets deposited in your arsenal for use later. Everyone in your party gets everyone else's minerals, so no need to fight over who gets the best one\!
conversation.properties|m.casino_yesman_: Welcome to the High Wobbler Lounge\!
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Zombies \nShambling Zombies will rise from the dead if killed near a Grim Totem. Draw them away so you can give them eternal rest.
helptips.properties|m.tg_end: Hey, you made it\! That's just great, really. You just saved me a whole lot of paperwork, so thanks. Hope those retrodes weren't too much of a surprise. Head on over to the elevator and we'll call this expedition complete.
mission.properties|m.elemental_my_dear_3: Magic?  What?  No, I'm talking about a psychic energy manipulation here, try and stay with me.  In any case,  elemental damage is produced by construct and gremlin family monsters.  Additionally, construct monsters tend to be weak to elemental damage themselves and gremlins to shadow damage. Keep this in mind. \n\nNow then, is there anything else you require?
item.properties|f.blizzbreaker_armor: A reliable set of armor adept at shrugging off the coldest of shoulders. It's not bad at resisting freeze attacks, either.
dungeon.properties|m.core_desc: The ultimate objective of the Spiral Knights, the Core is like a titanic heart, ever beating life through the world surrounding it.
mission.properties|o.p_tortodrone_r7: Investigate the Ancient Grove and put a stop to a Fiendish plot.
item.properties|f.mercurial_mail: A supreme set of silver armor that'll put a spring in your step while keeping shocks out of it.
item.properties|f.serene_helm: An ancient, resilient helmet covered in a soft layer of moss.  Within the cool, stony interior of this helmet you can hear a faint and soothing song formed by the rustle of winds traveling from distant lands.
item.properties|f.alchemy_room: A utilitarian room equipped with two Alchemy Machines and a General Goods Merchant.
item.properties|f.furni_spiralorder_fiel: A sturdy Spiral scanner that assembles in minutes, provides hours of intel, and lasts for years.
helptips.properties|m.tg3_charge_1: Spiral Knights are capable of unleashing the hidden powers locked from within the weapons they use called "charge attacks." Charge attacks are more powerful than a standard attack and can often produce special effects.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
mission.properties|o.p_moorcroft1_r4: Locate and destroy the black kat nest
mission.properties|m.shopping_again_b_1a: Hi there {0}\!  Wow, you've made Soldier already?  You're really moving up fast in the ranks. \n\nAnyway, I'm Bechamel, and I'm here to give you a tour of some of the Bazaar's more advanced services. To start, do you want to learn how to even further power up that gear of yours?
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_8a: Yes.  It would seem as though we have much to learn of this place. \n\nRhendon's report noted that many of the sprites were missing from the site. He suggested foul play.
item.properties|f.twisted_targe: A tulgey targe that will give your sword thrusts some teeth.
conversation.properties|m.casino_royalje: Three lichens slide into a room...
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_3: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.black_kat_mask: An impressive mask instilled with the might of Kat Nappers, the undercover sleeper cell of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
exchange.properties|e.disabled: Sorry, the exchange has been temporarily disabled.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_4a: Heh, don't look now, {0}, but there's a ghost over your shoulder\! Let's hope these sprites haven't invested all their power into good looks. \n\nUse that one to clear the path ahead so a rescue team can get through safely\!
mission.properties|o.prestigious_opportu: Contact Intel Agent Kora and receive Prestige Mission authorization
item.properties|f.spitfire: A modified Proto Gun augmented with a low intensity burst of flame.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_2_9a: Yes I know. Anyway I also understand that some of the sprite transport crates were empty again. Something is not right... \n\nNow then, secure that last cache of sprites before whatever is stealing sprites finds it\!
item.properties|f.furni_brazier_tall_pur: A tall torch filled with peculiar purple fire.
mission.properties|b.rescues_and_recycli: A 'Deconstruction Zone' is a gremlin work site where gremlins seem to tear apart existing levels and use the components to build new levels. Their ability to rapidly engineer levels and machines is incredible, surpassed only by their hostility to anyone who crosses their path. \n\nRecon Knights have discovered that a squad may have observed their engineering marvels a little too closely as they are now being held captive in one of the deconstruction sites near depth 10.  It is unclear what the gremlins have in store for these knights or if they simply plan on letting them perish along with the rest of the level they are dismantling.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_3: In any case it would seem that this new 'recipe' caused the cakes to turn into horrible monsters that have overtaken my kitchen and infested the Clockworks.  I'd like to have my kitchen back, so could you please assist me in destroying these horrible Creep Cakes?
item.properties|f.torchstone: A small rock that smolders constantly. Gremlins patrolling the Cooling Chambers occasionally use them as a hand warmer.
mission.properties|m.new_threat_12a: Hmm, most of our sensor equipment seems to have been damaged.  It might take some time to get things working to the point where I can track down the Artifact.  While we work on that, you should get in contact with one of our Biotechs, Hahn.  He's a little rough around the edges, but he can help you prepare for the challenges you'll likely face. \n\nI'll contact you later as soon as I have my tracking equipment back online\!
mission.properties|b.the_collector: There have been scattered reports of a large, mechanical entity we have named the 'Collector' who has been intercepting our knights and taking both them and the sprites they were tracking and imprisoning them in a well-guarded compound deep within the Clockworks.  Armed with your new sprite, your mission is to find this 'Collector' and rescue the knights and sprites it has taken captive.
conversation.properties|m.core_tech_1: Welcome to the Core on-site research camp.  Got any news from the surface?
item.properties|f.shadow_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who gain their powers using forbidden, dark arts.
item.properties|f.cosmic_dust: A portion of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
item.properties|f.gold_dragon_armor: Armor once worn by a member of the 'Gold Dragons,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
item.properties|f.emberbreak_shield: A Proto Shield modified to provide some protection against fire.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.magister_robe: A ceremonial robe worn by learned masters of the arcane arts, who often leave their keys in one of the many inner pockets.
item.properties|f.token_page: A crumbling page torn from a long-forgotten grimoire of the Moorcroft Manor archives. The indecipherable language written upon it glows faintly in the dark as if containing power in its very words.
item.properties|f.furni_crate_toughbox_w: It's filled with dangerous explosives and razor-sharp swords\! Keep out of reach of children.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_5_4a: Now then, greet those that have helped you become what you are today. When you are done, take the elevator back up to receive your commendation.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_elem: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
chat.properties|m.usage_force_bug_report: Usage\: /{0} <knight name> [description]\nForces a bug report to be submitted from the player's client.
item.properties|f.electron_charge: A small electro-explosive charge with mysterious origins. It is capable of generating a crippling vortex of electricity.
dungeon.properties|m.jigsaw_valley_desc: Appearing to be sky islands ripped apart and put back together again as if it were a puzzle this world can sometimes be confusing to navigate. Unfortunately it seems to also be home to a host of mindless slimes and constructs who do not seem to mind its erratic layout.
support.properties|m.subheader_step202: If the player you're complaining about is annoying then that does not qualify as complaint worthy.\n\nAnnoying are issues like calling you names or teasing you.
item.properties|f.emberbreak_armor: Armor with a hacked elemental core aimed at resisting fire. However, this non-standard modification creates other elemental weaknesses.
craft.properties|e.cant_use_accessory: This item is not compatible with this accessory type.
item.properties|f.gh_theme_poison: A very unique theme that gives your Guild Hall all the beauty and ambiance of a sewage system.
conversation.properties|m.hunter_4a: That's the spirit\! Give those monsters what for\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_slime: Deliver a shipment of rock salt to the research team stationed in the lichenous lair\!
mission.properties|o.p_r7_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
mission.properties|m.new_threat_8a: Pah\!  I am no mere gremlin.  I am the thousand eyes that watch you in the darkness.  I am the hissing blade that whispers your doom.  Tear down every wall and cog in this accursed place and you will find only shadows. \n\nI cannot be stopped by the likes of you\!  Hsst\!
chat.properties|m.usage_spawn: Usage\: /{0} name attr value attr value...\nSpawns an actor in the scene.
uplink.properties|m.bid_cancelled: Your bid money has been refunded and is included in this mail.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_vana: An artistic arrangement of Lord Vanaduke's mask, armor and scepter. It represents the folly of greed, the agony of despair, and how awesome fire and spikes look together.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_1a: Greetings, {0}. I imagine you have some questions about battle sprites. How can I assist you?
item.properties|f.prize_box_blazing: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Blazing style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
steam.properties|m.convert_to_steam: Would you like to move your knights, energy, achievements, etc., to your Steam account? \nThis will allow you to log on automatically at start up as well as to take advantage of \nSteam features such as achievements, voice chat, and invites.
item.properties|f.auto_turret_kit: Deploys an auto turret that fires at nearby hostiles
exchange.properties|m.could_not_fill: Unable to fill order as submitted, please check updated price and try again.
helptips.properties|m.atg_traps: Watch your step\!  Wait until TRAPS are down before walking over them.
social.properties|m.join_guild_mission: Join your guildmate {0} at depth {1} on the Mission\: {2} ({3})
mission.properties|m.new_threat_6a: There were sounds of shouting and explosions coming from the lab just now.  I think we may be under attack\!  Better gear up.  I've no idea what is going on in there but we'd better be prepared for anything\!
chat.properties|m.usage_haven: Go to your last Haven place.
projectx.properties|m.cs_desc_cj_wasd_mo: Keyboard used for movement, advanced commands, quickslots and chat
item.properties|f.voltaic_radical_mask: A mask said to be replicated by a sentient mechaknight. The internal gyros and shock crest are sure to obscure your identity.
chat.properties|m.usage_kick: Usage\: /{0} player name\nKicks a player offline.
item.properties|f.irontech_destroyer: The big brother of the Irontech Bomb, the Destroyer unleashes the full potential of irontech power.
item.properties|f.peppermint_repeater: This holiday hand cannon is the proper piece to pepper your opponents with hot lead of holiday cheer.
item.properties|f.furni_pet_lazy_rooster: A festive new years snipe that will stay where it's placed.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.callahan: A handgun of incredible power that can leave its target in a daze. It is said to make its targets feel far less lucky.  A charged shot can even pierce through multiple enemies.
sprites.properties|d.venom: Increases the potency of the poison inflicted.
item.properties|f.fuel_canister: A small receptacle once used to hold fuel for a complex machine.
item.properties|f.gremlin_gizmo: A strange device used in gremlin machinery. It is inscribed with a warning against exposing it to direct sunlight or submerging it in water.
item.properties|f.humbug_hat: A horrible hat worn by those who truly loathe the magic of Winterfest. The only possible explanation for this feeling is having a heart two sizes too small.
item.properties|f.obsidian_carbine: A deadly gun made from the obsidian obelisks found within the realm of the Apocrea. With every shot fired, a faint whisper is heard, believed to be the true name of its target.
mission.properties|o.spark_roar: Prove your valor against a legion of elite elemental monsters
item.properties|f.swiftstrike_buckler: A small, easy to use shield that enables the user to perform fast attacks.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_6a: Here we have an alchemy station that you'll no doubt become very familiar with as you upgrade your arsenal.  But no need to worry about that too much as Spiral HQ is likely to give you a mission later on that explains everything. \n\nWell, that about does it for your first tour.  Do you want me to go over it all again or do you think you've got it?
item.properties|f.fiery_atomizer: A powerful alchemical bomb that creates a dense cloud of highly combustible, searing dust.
chat.properties|m.complain_self: You can't file a complaint about yourself.
mission.properties|b.vicious_viscous: Spiral HQ would like you to investigate levels of the Clockworks where the most powerful slime and beast monsters reside.  By exploring these levels and transferring your combat data back to Spiral HQ, all knights would ultimately benefit from your dangerous experience. \n\nIt is highly recommended that you equip yourself with piercing resistant gear with piercing and shadow damage weapons\!
item.properties|f.capsule_remedy: A small capsule that refreshes its user. It can be used to remove all status conditions you're afflicted with.\n\nDon't panic\! Remedy capsules can be a life saver, if you remember to use them\!
mission.properties|m.legion_almire_3a: Now only death and smoke hang in the air, even from these great heights. And the fires; the unnatural fires that seem to burn eternal, the fires that turn even the most pious men into horrible nightmares, I know that these fires shall soon take me as well. \n\nI will not give my former Lord the gift of my own life.  It is not his to take, to twist. This shall be my final order.  This shall be my Justice.
item.properties|f.prize_box_slime: Contains various unique costumes and items that augment the Jelly series of gear. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
logon.properties|m.paying_customers_only: This server is only available to customers who have spent at least $4.95 on Energy in the last three months.
item.properties|f.hood: A mystical hood whose greatest power is concealing the wearer's identity.
conversation.properties|r.biscotti_1: This all sounds really strange, but I'm happy to help if I can.
uplink.properties|m.metal_sonic: Thank you for purchasing Sonic CD on Steam\!  Attached is your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.  These items are costumes that can be equipped over any armor allowing you to look like Metal Sonic whenever you like\! \n\nPlease note, gear can only be equipped in towns or at an Arsenal Station.  If you are a new recruit and have just emerged from your crash pod, make your way to the Rescue Camp.  Once you reach the Rescue Camp you can equip your Metal Sonic Suit and Mask.
item.properties|f.forbidden_fruit: A sinful snack favored by famished fiends.
mission.properties|m.true_champion_1a: {0}\! Oh, {0} you made it\! Haha\! \n\nI am so happy you came out of there alive\!  I was worried sick about you\!
item.properties|f.hazardous_draped_armor: Loose-fitting armor worn by more experienced Scarlet Scouts. It's rumored that gear like this is crafted from the remains of armor from Scouts who fell in combat, acting as a reminder that unless necessary Scouts never leave a man behind.
pvp.properties|m.idle_removed: You have been removed from {0} for non-participation.
auction.properties|m.start_recipe: Select a learned recipe to search for the ingredients.
help.properties|m.monster_1: Monsters in the Clockworks are divided into six distinct families, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Be sure to equip yourself accordingly before venturing below ground\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_survivorkn: They came from the darkness. There was no time to react.
item.properties|f.torpor_tantrum: The ultimate sleep bomb. It's like a bedtime story, only more explodey.
item.properties|f.spiral_sallet: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
mission.properties|o.alone_in_dark: Make contact with a lost soul of Almire in the soldier's graveyard
uplink.properties|m.newsletter: Subscribe now and get a free Proto Crest accessory\!
conversation.properties|r.tut_intro_1a: Roger that, I'm on my way\!
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_2a: Very well {0}, let's get right to it.  It seems the closer monsters get to the Core, the more their unique properties begin to surface.  In most cases this takes the form of their being able to inflict special damage types that require special defenses in order to withstand properly. \n\nIn Tier 2, a monster inflicting a special damage type will always produce a split normal/special damage output.  Thus, normal defense is still a somewhat valid defense choice.
item.properties|f.fire_barrier: Surrounds you with fiery orbs that can set hostiles ablaze
item.properties|f.mighty_great_cleaver: A custom made Sudaruska designed by Biscotti, head chef of the Skylark. Though she swears it's used just for cooking, one can't help but think more than a few monsters have met it at the chopping block as well.
item.properties|f.divine_stone: A concentrated lump of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
item.properties|f.token_forge: A small wisp of the essential spirit of technology and progress. It is of extreme value to the Spiral Order. Take it to the Token Trader in the Haven Bazaar\!
item.properties|f.harlequin_cowl: You can't clown the wearer of this colorful cowl or you'll find that you're the punchline.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_gate_fiend: Free the captured Knights from a fiendish corporate prison\!
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_2: A good-sized mineral deposit that will generate several units of luminite.
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_yel: A Spiral-issued light source typically used to recommend caution.
mission.properties|m.becoming_champion_1: Well met {0}, it has been some time since I first met you having just arrived from the Rescue Camp.  You've come along way since then, rising to the rank of Defender Elite no less. \n\nYou are a gifted soldier, {0}.  I have no doubt you will soon be a Champion amongst the Spiral Knights and instrumental in our solving the great mystery that is the Core, restoring the Skylark and returning home.  You have proven that you have what it takes to face the legions of dark forces that lurk below the surface.
item.properties|f.honor_blade_4: A ceremonial sword issued to Vanguards of the Spiral Order. Though intended for formal occasions, its fine edge makes it suitable for combat use.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_overgrown_2: Looks like you know how to handle yourself. That's good, because the final area is just ahead.
item.properties|f.ticket_variants_3: Use this ticket at the Variant Forge to reset an item's variants to 3 random variants.
mission.properties|m.new_chapter_1a: Congratulations on becoming a Soldier, {0}\!  I hear you really gave that Snarbolax a clobbering, well done\! \n\nWe've had an opportunity to analyze Euclid's recon module you discovered in the Snarbolax's lair.  Based on the recording, it seems that Euclid suspected something our Geo Knights discovered sometime after the crash- that the levels within the Clockworks are comprised of terrain from multiple alien worlds\!
pvp.properties|m.no_reward: You have dishonored my great Coliseum with your lack of fighting spirit\!  You shall receive no Krogmo Coins and no rank points\!
mission.properties|m.target_acquired_1a: Hello {0}, I hope you're ready for me to send you out into the lion's den once more.
item.properties|f.spiral_tailed_helm: A light helmet issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
sprites.properties|d.drakon: The drakon is a battle sprite that embodies fiery destruction. Its skills focus on raw, offensive power.
mission.properties|r.winterfest_danger_1: I have no time to talk.
conversation.properties|m.rc_technician_: According to these scans there should be some kind of power source in the depths below the camp, but it's being diverted somehow...
mission.properties|r.laboratory_visit_5a: Leave it to me, Morlin. I'll secure those sprites.
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_3c: See Riley here in the Lab to purchase new harnesses. Once purchased, a harness is automatically added to your harness list in the battle sprite interface. \n\nAdditionally, any time you purchase a direct upgrade to a harness you own, it will be replaced by the superior harness.
item.properties|f.fang_of_vog: A sword said to be created from the fang of the fire beast, Vog.
exchange.properties|m.billing_bad_cardho: Please enter your entire name as it appears on your credit card.
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_3a: You'll figure it out as you go along, trust me.  Take this Brandish for example.  It has within it the potential to become three different types of elemental blades that deliver powerful status conditions, or even a shadowy sword of darkness\! \n\nYou just need to discover the recipes that require a brandish and get crafting to find out. Here, you can even keep this Brandish I've got.  Transmute it into something amazing.
item.properties|f.night_cap_sallet: A comfortable cap for knights to wear at night. Sure to give the wearer lucid dreams to face their nightmares.
item.properties|f.snow_hat: A comfy winter hat, keeping you warm whether hunting frozen jellies or merely melting marshmallows in your hot chocolate.
item.properties|f.confetti_bubbles: Use this item to blow a cloud of bubbles into the air. See how long they last before they pop\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_surprise_4: Contains four randomly chosen Prize Boxes in celebration of the Spiral Order's anniversary on Cradle.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.wooly_pullover: A stylish sweater for the pre-snowy season. {0}
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_1: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
item.properties|f.heavenly_guardian_helm: A brilliant, white helm belonging to a heavenly warrior.
social.properties|m.friend_self: Sorry, you can't be your own friend.
dungeon.properties|m.treasure_vault_desc: Treasure Troves contain vast quantities of treasure blocks, yours for the taking should you have the proper means to get past the numerous locked doors. Some of them are heavily guarded, so always be on the look out for hidden traps and monsters.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Euclid volunteered to help The Sleeper. I'm sure he's in here somewhere battling The Swarm even as we speak. As for Rulen...Vaelyn I'm sorry. He disappeared shortly after Euclid made his decision. I haven't been able to find him ever since.
item.properties|f.lockdown_guardian_shie: A shield carried by a Spiral Guardian, a stalwart protector on the battlefield.
helptips.properties|m.unlock_shadow: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Shadow Key \n\nWARNING\: If this elevator is unlocked the party will become locked and stay locked for the duration of the Shadow Lair. Choose your party members wisely\!
helptips.properties|t.loading12: Press F2 to send a bug report
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Whatever that was, we're here now. Wherever here is. It looks like our only option is to see where this leads.
monster.properties|m.promotion_2: We could use a guy like you in management.
chat.properties|m.usage_admin: Usage\: /{0} message\nSends a message to all admins.
item.properties|f.aura: An accessory that can be attached to select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
conversation.properties|r.fc_court_4_acc: Free 6 Lost Sprites? I can do that\!
item.properties|f.nodeslime_shield: This weathered wobbling wall can withstand a walloping when wielded by unwaveringly willed warriors.
uplink.properties|m.returned: Your attachment was never accepted\n\nOriginal mail\: {0}
mission.properties|m.built_to_destroy_2b:
Transmission\: 

'They continue to advance and thwart our schemes\!  How could they have discovered Project R?  Why was there no advance warning of the attack?' 

'Herex and his minions were supposed to be spying on them but they have all vanished like cowards.' 

'To defy the Iron Law is to defy the Order\!  Track the traitor down.  Herex will answer for this setback.'
mission.properties|m.elig_ok: You are eligible for this mission.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a temperamental warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
conversation.properties|r.arc_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
auction.properties|m.no_mybids: You have not bid on any recent auctions.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_start_4: Great\!  I'll meet you near the exit once you've cleared them out.  Careful though, they seem to have adapted the use of birthday candles as weapons...
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_b_2a: It is now. I was just on my way to the bazaar to drop off some supplies when I was ambushed by these gremlins. I thought they were from Emberlight, a colony of gremlin outcasts, but it looks like I was mistaken. \n\nJust to be safe, would you mind helping me get these items to the bazaar?
sprites.properties|d.seraphynx: The seraphynx is a battle sprite that embodies divine light. Its skills focus on supporting knights in combat with protection and restoration.
guild.properties|m.invite_pending: {0} has already been invited to join your guild.
help.properties|m.clockworks_2: The depths below Haven can be classified into three progressively challenging Tiers. Be sure to equip Tier-appropriate gear when venturing forth, and remember\: the greatest treasures the Clockworks have to offer are far underground near the planet's Core, so delve deep\!
item.properties|f.frenzy_dragon_helm: An enchanted helm crafted into the visage of a beast who some believe shaped the world in its passing\: its frenzy started the mighty winds, its scales became the shadows.
mission.properties|r.new_chapter_3a: Thanks Kora, I'll do my best\!
pvp.properties|m.coins_earned.1: You have earned {0} Krogmo Coin playing {1}\!
item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_1: A fractured fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.
item.properties|f.sun_shards: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in solar-charged Luminite. Whatever you do, don't look directly at it.
conversation.properties|m.mission_crimso: That's just it {0}, nothing. We've been monitoring the base below for weeks then it went silent. Quite suddenly. We're not sure what you're going to find down there. Our sensors show no active life forms.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_2a: Yes, in order to access deeper stratums of the Clockworks you must first receive Star Certification.  This entails speaking to me when you have equipped armor, a helmet, a shield and at least one weapon of a specific star level or greater.
mission.properties|o.explosive_plot: Contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink
guildhelp.properties|l.design_console: Design Mode can be accessed from the Command Console. | action | console
item.properties|f.final_flourish: The premier armament of the serious fencer, it can riposte just as easily as it can rip up foes.
conversation.properties|m.monster_codex_: Royal Jelly \nThis massive gelatinous cube has a short fuse and loves to throw his weight around. When his royal tasters are absent a poisoned parfait would be a royal pain.
chat.properties|m.usage_hoh: Go to the Hall of Heroes
helptips.properties|m.unlock_grim_gate: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to use a Fiendish ID Card \n\nWARNING\: If this Grim Gate is unlocked the party will become locked and stay locked for the duration of the mission. Choose your party members wisely\!
item.properties|f.elemental_blaster: An enhanced blaster modified to fire elemental rounds.
helptips.properties|m.atg_blocks: Hit a breakable block to destroy it\!
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r6:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
item.properties|f.prize_box_blooming: Contains various unique costumes and accesories to celebrate the blooming nature of spring.  Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
item.properties|f.rugged_robo_wrecker: An upgraded robo wrecker that has assisted a great many constructs in becoming smoldering, scrap metal heaps.
chat.properties|m.usage_joinknight: Usage\: /{0} [player name]\nAttempts to join a player's instance or party.
item.properties|f.dusker_coat: A warm adventurer's coat that'll let you strike with the ferocity of an Alpha Dusker.
item.properties|f.moonstone_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of moonstone.
item.properties|m.box_variant: On the side, very small markings seem to read "{0}".
item.properties|f.prize_box_dazed: Contains various unique costumes and accessories in a Dazed style. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.hazardous_grim_mask: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of Death itself. Those that wear it have a saying, 'Death is at your heels, so keep facing forward.'
projectx.properties|e.name_vulgar: Sorry, that name contains an inappropriate word. Please try another.
item.properties|f.warmaster_bomb_1: A potent bomb brimming with dark energy that Warmaster Seerus engineered with the sole purpose of eliminating other gremlins that stood in his way.
item.properties|f.mercurial_demo_helm: A demo helm made from gremlin technology. It is for the bomber that wants a boost of speed, more power and a greatly reduced chance of dying by electrocution... which is probably every bomber out there.
conversation.properties|m.sl_guard_3: All Shadow Lairs are locked with a strange mechanism that can only be unlocked with a 'Shadow Key.'  Shadow Keys can be purchased from the Supply Depot. \n\nOnce a party member uses a Shadow Key, the party is locked and cannot be changed, so choose your party members wisely\!
item.properties|f.reaper_rib: A bone stained black by the wickedness of its former possessor.
item.properties|f.kat_eye_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Seekers, the skillful grenadiers of the Kat Tribe.
guild.properties|m.confirm_deposit_treas: Are you sure you want to deposit into the guild's treasury? This can never be undone, not even by a GM.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research_: Having fought the elite Darkfang Clan gremlins, evaded the crushing blows of lumbers and withstood the optic blasts of retrodes, you have no doubt collected samples from these encounters that would be of great use to Spiral HQ's research teams.
item.properties|f.perplexing_element: A rare metal recovered from a shattered mountain deep within the realm of the Apocrea. Under a microscope it reveals to have a kind of impossible geometry. Perhaps more dedicated study, free from the distractions of the world would reveal its secrets.
mission.properties|o.alchemy_beginners: Learn about the wonders of alchemy\!
item.properties|f.power_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who align themselves with forces that grant them brute strength on the battlefield.
mission.properties|b.explosive_plot: Recon Knights have discovered what they believe to be a gremlin-hatched plot to destroy Haven\!  As a Knight Elite, you have been selected by Spiral HQ to investigate this matter.  Contact Intel Agent Kora for details.
exchange.properties|m.coins_traded_poe: You have received {0} crowns as the result of an energy trade.
mission.properties|b.p_heart_of_ice_r7:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ has detected a sudden climate shift emanating from deep within the Clockworks. Freak snowstorms and blizzards have begun surging through the depths seeming to originate from an inhospitable, fiendish city known as 'Amu-Sol.'  The Recon Rangers have been dispatched to infiltrate Amu-Sol and discover the source of these freezing storms.
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: Enter the amount of energy you want to sell, in multiples of 100

uplink.properties|m.unclaimed: Accept to claim these items on this knight. Be aware that you will not be able to Steam Trade these items in the future, once claimed.
item.properties|f.heavy_plate_helm: A substantial helmet designed to take all kinds of abuse from conventional weaponry. The inside smells a little like sweat.
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_6a: From what I've heard, if anyone can do it, it's you, {0}\!  Good luck\!
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roar: A miniature model of one of the Roarmulus Twins. It is mercifully inactive.
dungeon.properties|m.gloaming_wildwoods_: Spiral Knight recruits are advised to avoid this dark and misty forest until they are experienced with the dangers of the Clockworks. The Gloaming Wildwoods is home to packs of vicious beasts, the worst of all being the mythical Snarbolax. Said to be 'a living shadow,' the Snarbolax prefers the taste of prey that had been a state of terror before death and will often mercilessly harass its victims before delivering the final blow.
mission.properties|b.p_r4_gate_beast: Our Geo Knights risk their lives working in the wilds of the Clockworks.  While their findings are invaluable, they are often stationed in the very heart of wolver territory.  These wild beasts relentlessly stalk our Geo Knights, snatching them in the night when unguarded.  Sometimes, wolvers will form a pack and assault an entire research team.  It is during these times that a talented squad must be called in to save them.

item.properties|f.seerus_fragment_3: A perfect fragment of the mask once worn by Warmaster Seerus, recovered from the siege of his Grand Arsenal.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: The Alpha Squad's sacrifice will not be in vain. I will immediately order our forces to undertake special Operations Missions all over Cradle. If there are forces trying to free The Swarm, we'll have to stop them.
item.properties|f.light_shard: A shard of Luminite that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|m.item_permanent: This item cannot be sold or traded.\n
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_3: they are waiting to ambush you ahead
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: We wouldn't have made it past that artillery without your help\!
item.properties|f.nether_shell: A shield alchemized from the shell of a corrupted tortodrone. A tormented howl of rage can be heard on the wind when this shield smashes through your foes.
mission.properties|m.intro_reward_arcade: Select a gate to view the gate map and enable options for starting your expedition\!
