mission.properties|m.alchemy_beginners_5: ...and the required materials, orbs of alchemy, and crowns needed to transmute the item.
item.properties|f.silent_nightblade: Crafted with some of the most devilish materials found on Cradle, this inky blade can explode with fiendish fury.
mission.properties|m.apocrea_1_3a: The Apocrea are stuff of nightmares\: a terrible legion of otherworldly phantasms whose only ambition seems to be trapping and devouring the souls of all life. \n\nThough you may venture beyond this nexus, you will undoubtedly fall into one of their traps along the way.
sprites.properties|d.angelic_aura: Creates protective aura around you that also protects any party members within it.
mission.properties|o.first_contact: Contact Intel Agent Kora via Comlink
mission.properties|m.new_threat_1a: Greetings, {0}\!  We have two missions of vital importance.  First, we've located an energy signature similar to the one emanating from that Artifact you found in the Clockworks.  We're homing in on that energy signature now.  Finding the source might help us understand what that gremlin schemer Razwog planned on doing with the Artifact or what the device is actually capable of.
item.properties|f.sacred_keeper_armor: A cerulean suit of armor for those who want to wreck some robos.
item.properties|f.token_winter_wishlist: This Winterfest wishlist was lost long ago. It lists warm linens that protect from the snow. Randolph will reward those knights with a stack. So bring them to him and earn a present back.
item.properties|f.royal_jelly_crown: Ruggedly royal regalia recently reproduced from regally resinous remains.
item.properties|f.kat_hiss_mail: An impressive mail instilled with the might of Kat Hissers, the unstable bombers of the Kat Tribe.
mission.properties|m.arc_mintut_5: Minerals are used to create sprite food in the Laboratory. Sprite food is very important to the development of your sprite, so grab those minerals when you see them\!
conversation.properties|m.mission_collec: It looks artificial, but it seems to have a sinister awareness...
chat.properties|m.user_disconnected: That user has been disconnected for {0}.
item.properties|f.raiders_axe: An ornate, fiery axe favored by raiders for its versatility.
helptips.properties|m.loading1: The Clockworks below the surface cycle levels in real time. You will never see all the levels a world has to offer in a single trip. Only a true adventurer will discover all the secrets\!
item.properties|f.cold_iron_carver: An enchanted sword crafted from cold iron whose blade wards off the creatures of the dark.
item.properties|f.gilded_griffin: A beautiful pistol named after a great, noble beast. Its golden frame was believed to provide light within the impenetrable darkness of the Underworld.
mission.properties|m.explosive_plot_1a: Congratulations {0}\!  Knight Elite huh?  Wow, you must be proud\!
mission.properties|r.shopping_again_12b: Thanks Bechamel, I'll be seeing you\!
conversation.properties|m.moorcroft_arch: Oh {0}, it's horrible, just horrible\! \n\nA terrifying swarm of black kats came out of some dark portal deep within the Clockworks and have raided the Moorcroft Archives\!

mission.properties|r.welcome_to_haven_2a: I'll be sure to say hello when I see a Stranger.

item.properties|f.gel_drop: A drop of goo collected from a jelly. It's still quivering.
prologue.properties|m.preface3: What we discovered was beyond imagination. We discovered Cradle.

item.properties|f.blaze_pepper: A delectable spice prized by Clockwork denizens of all sorts. In powdered form, it has a terrible habit of clinging to absolutely everything.
mission.properties|o.scarlet_fortress: Chart an expedition through the haunted halls of the Scarlet Fortress
item.properties|f.nodeslime_armor: A variegated veiling ward worn by vehemently venerated victors.
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires one Golden Slime Coin or crowns if none are available.
mission.properties|b.p_r3_gate_slime: The best way to keep slimes at bay is with copious amounts of rock salt. Slimes just hate the stuff as touching it makes them dissolve.  It's not pretty. \n\nResearch teams stationed in lichenous lairs will often surround their entire camp with rock salt so that they don't end up some slime's dinner.  As you can imagine, they go through the stuff fast.  When they run low, a squad is called in to battle their way to the camp and deliver the life saving seasoning.
item.properties|f.cautery_sword: A sword adapted from a medical tool, its heated blade reduces tissue damage. It is very formidable at destroying monsters of the slime family.
item.properties|f.amputator: The culmination of slime family research, the heated reciprocating blades cut through all slimes with surgical precision and prevent their gelatinous bodies from reforming.
projectx.properties|e.password_mismatch: The passwords you entered do not match.
mission.properties|b.another_trace: The technicians in the Haven Laboratory report that their tracking system has finally been repaired and brought back online. Intel Agent Kora would like to bring you up to speed on the challenges ahead. Contact her via comlink for the details.
mission.properties|b.alone_in_dark: The spookats of Moorcroft Manor have another valuable piece of intel for us that is worth investigating.  They say that a lost soul of the former Kingdom of Almire resides in a soldier's graveyard near the Firestorm Citadel.  This soul is willing to provide us with the information on the nature of the citadel as well as how we can get through it and reach the Core. \n\nReaching him will not be easy given his location.  Graveyards are terrible places, especially at this depth.  It is highly advisable that you move through the graveyard as quickly as possible in your search for this lost soul.
helptips.properties|m.loading17: Check out forums.spiralknights.com. Be a part of the conversation\!
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_gremlin: Steal the gremlin schematics from the gremlin construction site\!
item.properties|f.arctic_acolyte_hood: A hood said to be worn by wandering arctic acolytes. 'we saw them heading straight towards the mountains, off into the interior of the vast frozen continent, but why?'
mission.properties|m.time_enough_at_last:
Yes, it is isn't it?  I should not have come here alone.  I should have stayed with my squad. 

(Edger looks off into the distance) 

I don't even remember how it happened.... maybe I never will.  But it didn't hurt.
item.properties|f.hive_box: Contains one unique hive-themed item. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
item.properties|f.vog_cub_coat: This hide garment is so flame retardant that you won't even mind that it reeks of wood smoke.
projectx.properties|e.need_higher_rank: Must be Rank {0} to level up\!
helptips.properties|m.confirm_energy: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to confirm spending energy.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Be careful confronting the Warmaster\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_3a: Thank you, {0}.  I hope you succeed.  As you know, we believe the Alpha Squad made it this far, but it is unclear what became of them... Euclid, Parma, Grantz.... Rulen. \n\n(Lieutenant Vaelyn seems to almost drift off)
item.properties|f.simple_orb: A rare, encapsulated element used in alchemical transmutation. While unrefined, this orb can be used to craft more powerful items.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_2: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_2a: What do you mean? Who are the Apocrea?
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of moonstone.
item.properties|f.budding_coat: A ripped clean suit can mean death, but fortunately this one was colonized by an unusual symbiotic plant. Wear this and you'll be guaranteed to have a green thumb\!
item.properties|f.heavy_pulsar: A Pulsar upgraded with Spiral technology to pack a greater punch. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_4_3a: Congratulations {0}, you meet the necessary requirements and have received your 5 Star Certification.  Take the elevator behind me in order to complete your mission.
conversation.properties|m.rc_virgil_3a: It seems to lead to some kind of elevator, but with no power, the whole thing is just dead.
item.properties|f.valestone: A fabled mineral of a vibrant, green color said to contain the essence of all natural life.
helptips.properties|m.tut_buttons: Not all buttons are in plain sight. Have a look around\! They are sometimes hidden under blocks.
mission.properties|m.chasm_b_rhendon_1a: Looks like we've got no choice, {0}.  This gizmo isn't worth dying over.
item.properties|f.cold_snap: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of frost upon detonation.
item.properties|f.polar_night_wolf_coat: A warm coat, favored by those knights stationed in the polar regions. The thick fur is needed during their never ending night patrols.
item.properties|f.swimsuit_trunks: A pair of spiral issue trunks intended for coastal expeditions and fun in the sun.
mission.properties|m.delved_too_deep_2a: I bet. I guess you'll have to fill me in for once\!
conversation.properties|m.arc_mintut_2: During your travels in the Clockworks you will encounter five special minerals\: crimsonite, moonstone, valestone, luminite and dark matter.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_3a: I'm glad you asked, they certainly do\!  Let's head over to Vatel.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_roya: A jolly piece of jewelry formerly borne by the Royal Jelly himself. It is jauntily perched on a gelatinous pillow.
item.properties|f.furni_trophy_boss_snar: A long, razor-sharp tooth, proof that you encountered the fabled Snarbolax and survived to galumph back.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_shock: Check on Groat the Gremlin Chef.
item.properties|f.armor_front: An accessory that can be attached to the front of select armors.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|m.pierce_of_cake_1a: Hello there, {0}.  Spiral HQ has informed me that you will be needing a quick lesson in the species of monsters within the Clockworks that inflict piercing damage, yes?
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_3_3a: Once again the sprites have changed and this time they're really creeping me out\!
mission.properties|b.p_r6_mat_2: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
board.properties|i.joinparty: Join a party already in progress.
item.properties|f.quilted_demo_helm: A helm snugly lined with luxurious stay-alert quilting. Sounds are a bit muffled from inside.
social.properties|m.earned_crowns: become the new Crown King, having earned {0} crowns in the past 7 days\!
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft1:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into the depths of a moldering sewer where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
mission.properties|b.first_contact_b: With the power restored to the Rescue Camp, you can now use your comlink to contact Spiral HQ and find out where they have located after the crash of the Skylark.  Once you have made contact with Spiral HQ you will hopefully find out what caused the crash and the nature of this alien world you now inhabit.
item.properties|f.divine_orb: A lustrous sphere of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
sprites.properties|d.magnify: Increases the reach and power of the ray of light.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_2a: Welcome to the Advanced Training Hall, {0}.  Here you will find useful survival tips to help you on your journey through the Clockworks. \n\nWould you like a tour of the facilities?
item.properties|f.luminite_deposit_4: A mother lode of metalliferous minerals that will generate a jackpot of luminite.
item.properties|f.static_flash: A Proto Bomb modified to generate small bursts of electricity upon detonation.
mission.properties|m.securing_camp_4a: Remember to accept that mission and be careful down there\!
item.properties|f.charged_quicksilver_ma: An enhanced set of Quicksilver Mail that'll get you all charged up for battle.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_gate_fiend: A fiendish city is a strange place that Spiral HQ still does not fully understand.  Devilites are everywhere, and if they see one of their Pit Bosses nearby, they will do anything to look like they're being productive.  Unfortunately, productivity is often defined by attacking or imprisoning intruders, like a squad of knights passing through. \n\nIt is unclear what purpose imprisoned knights would ultimately serve in a devilite agenda. Those that have survived captivity have reported that conditions were poor, but the worst of it was the copious amounts of paperwork they had to fill out daily.  This is a fate no knight deserves\!
item.properties|f.training_room: A simple room providing access to a private guild training hall, perfect for learning new skills or keeping old ones current.
conversation.properties|r.rc_end_2a: Once I make it to Haven I really can't come back?
helptips.properties|m.scenario_fiendbook: Four Ways to Bring About the End of the World
chat.properties|m.unspecific_item: Equipment not specific enough, did you mean "{0}?"
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.arcana: An exceptional handgun that fires powerful, elemental shots that many Spiral Knights refer to as 'magic missiles.'
exchange.properties|m.trade4crowns_toolt: The best current market price. A response of ??? indicates that there is no current market offer for the amount you've entered.
mission.properties|b.monstrous_research: By now you have likely collected a few material samples from your early expeditions into the Clockworks.  Spiral HQ is requesting some of those materials for their ongoing research of the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.prize_box_construct: Contains various unique Construct-themed costumes and items. Items are randomly chosen.  No key required to open.
support.properties|m.subheader_step205: You should not be sending a complaint against someone just because they sent a complaint against you.\n\nGame Masters will read through all complaints, and if you didn't break any rules in the complaint that was filed against you, then you don't need to worry.
item.properties|f.barrier_cannon: A handgun alchemized from the shell of a tortodrone. The elemental offense of a tortodrone on the Long Migration should aid you on your own expeditions.
item.properties|m.expires_remaining: Expires in {0} day(s), {1} hour(s), and {2} minute(s).
mission.properties|m.shadowplay_2a: Go. I will allow you to have one last moment before I destroy your meddling kind. However, should you choose to turn down my generous offer then you are welcome to come and face me in the Core where I will hasten your demise.
item.properties|f.spur: A mechanized sword with a built in motor that generates energy bursts when used.
item.properties|f.punkin_pie_slice: A hot steamy slice of pie.
support.properties|m.option_208_0: If a player is trying to get your account name or password from you right now, or already did and is admitting to this in chat, you should click here to file a complaint.
item.properties|f.confetti: Use this item to throw it into the air and celebrate good times. Come on\!
item.properties|f.icebreaker_helm: A Frostbreaker Helm modified to provide further protection against freeze.
helptips.properties|m.tg2_vials_3: Now that you have a grasp of using pickups, let's apply what you've learned in a combat environment.
social.properties|m.earned_prestige: become the Most Prestigious, having earned {0} prestige in the past 7 days\!
item.properties|f.stone_tortoise: A large, powerful shield made to resemble a creature's shell. Its formidable weight can make attacking more difficult.
conversation.properties|r.hav_grem_1a: Tell me what you know about the gremlins.
helptips.properties|m.loading15: To add a friend to your friends list, simply click on that friend and choose "Add as Friend." To see the list of friends and what they are up to, click on the Social button.
item.properties|f.splinter_bomb: A shard bomb formed from a small explosive encased in a synthetic mineral. Prone to shattering, the otherwise useless material in this bomb is perfect for giving foes a nasty splinter.
auction.properties|e.please_wait: The auction house is busy, please wait a moment and try again.
item.properties|m.equip_locked: Equipping {0} will bind it to you. You will not be able to trade this item once bound. Are you sure?
mission.properties|b.p_r3_kit_2: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
social.properties|m.friend_party_booted: You have been banned from {0}'s party.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_mat_123: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
dungeon.properties|m.lobby_desc: A lobby before entering a gate where knights can strategize and gear up for the adventure to come.
mission.properties|b.p_r6_gate_construct: Gremlins are not very good about cleaning up their messes.  Our Recon Knights will often stumble across what they believe to be decommissioned gremlin weapons factories that are still actively bustling with hostile constructs, and in some cases are even stocked with operational, active war machines\! \n\nSpiral HQ has ordered that whenever possible, these factories and their war machines are to be shut down for good to avoid any future casualties.
item.properties|f.sallet: A streamlined helm favored by front line fighters.
helptips.properties|m.atg_retraps: Some switches can reverse the direction of a trap wave. Now you can cross traps in both directions\!
conversation.properties|m.af_chat_07: Uh-oh\! The truck have started to move\!
item.properties|f.firebreak_armor: Upgraded Emberbreak armor further hacked to resist fire.
item.properties|f.stranger_cap: A hat once worn by one of the enigmatic Strangers.  Local Snipes seem to be drawn to the wearer.
item.properties|f.nameless_hat: A nameless hat worn by a nameless hero of legend.
item.properties|f.furni_spiralorder_sund: Supply canisters containing everything a Spiral Knight needs to get going in the morning.
guild.properties|i.buy_environments: Change the environment for the Guild Hall.
mission.properties|o.oilers_in_boilers: Discover and destroy the source of the fiery slimes invasion
conversation.properties|m.sprite_tut_4a: Your sprite will evolve as you level it up. At certain key levels your sprite will require an Evo Catalyst be fed to it in order to level up further. Once fed, your sprite will physically change its appearance\! \n\nIt will be interesting to see how these strange, new forms of battle sprites evolve in time.
projectx.properties|m.antialiasing_note: This setting will take effect when the game is restarted.
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_5a: That's right, you can acquire recipes and materials in order to alchemize weapons and gear at alchemy stations.  Come on, I'll show you one.
mission.properties|m.heart_of_ice_2b:
Additionally, HR has requested an updated org chart as soon as possible. It is our understanding that all Pit Boss duties, administrative and otherwise, have been turned over to a 'Maulos of the Eternal Frost,' is that correct? 

Cheers, 
Morgral'm 
Assistant Supervisor of Resource Allocations, Undercorp
pvp.properties|m.reregion: Your coliseum signup has been moved to {0}...
mission.properties|r.elemental_my_dear_1: Yes, but this time you need to let me-
exchange.properties|m.confirm_low_sell:
Your sell offer has a lower price than the current best buy offer.
Probably you made a mistake.
Your sell price\: {0} crowns.
Best buy offer price\: {1} crowns.
Are you sure this is what you want?
item.properties|f.iron_buckler: A beaten little buckler made of iron that can withstand a bit more abuse than a Proto Shield.
conversation.properties|m.npc_spikeresea: Thanks for your help collecting spikes\!
item.properties|f.punkin_cinnamug: A frothy blend of punkins and cinnamon that is sure to burn those that don't wait for this mug to cool.
craft.properties|e.existing_accessory: This item already has an accessory of this type. Remove it first.
item.properties|f.token_roarmulus: A special circuit board developed by gremlin engineers designed to enhance both the bark and bite of the Roarmulus Twins.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_weap_4: Knights that are rescued from gremlin captivity are often left with nothing to show for it other than bad memories of being locked up in a cage and abused by their snarling captors.  Their weapons are always stolen and their gear often damaged by gremlin engineers to prevent any notion of surviving an escape attempt. \n\nIn order to get these knights back into their squad ready for battle, Spiral HQ needs other knights with access to ample resources to pitch in and provide them with the necessary weapons and gear.
mission.properties|b.terminal_meltdown: Drawn to the Firestorm Citadel, a horde of fiery slime and beast monsters have swarmed a nearby fuel depot putting the depot and our access to the citadel at risk. Should these monsters spread the fires into the fuel drums, the whole place will go up in flames. \n\nSpiral HQ needs you to enter the depot and put out the fire before time runs out and an explosive disaster is triggered\!
mission.properties|o.p_r4_kit_2: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
item.properties|f.decon_rig: An exosuit of structural iron and comfortable conduit crafted from the very bones of Cradle.
pvp.properties|m.cancelled: All pending coliseum games were cancelled. Please sign up again.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_1a: Tell me what you know about the Clockworks.
item.properties|f.furni_table_manor_1: An exquisite end table, meticulously manufactured for monumental magnificence.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I worked my employees hard to get where I am today.
conversation.properties|m.mission_cogkni: Can't...go on...
sprites.properties|d.hexing_haze: Creates a miasma around you that hexes any target within. Each hex has a timer that deals damage to its target upon termination. For every target acquired by hexing haze, the duration of the miasma increases.
mission.properties|b.p_r9_mat_5: Spiral HQ is always seeking to further understand the creatures inhabiting the Clockworks through the examination of materials.  If you have some materials to spare, you can further increase your prestige by donating materials to Spiral HQ.
logon.properties|m.failed_to_connect: Failed to connect to the server.
item.properties|f.volcanic_demo_suit: Highly protective gear for the cutting-edge demolition man. The internal cooling system makes you feel a little like you've been cryogenically frozen.
projectx.properties|d.achievement_baa4bd: Become a premiere elite select platinum plus priority member in the Golden Slime Casino C.U.B.E. Club.
item.properties|f.honor_shield_1: A ceremonial shield issued to Spiral Knight recruits. Though intended for formal occasions, its solid construction makes it suitable for combat use.
mission.properties|m.anniversary_end_1:
{0}\! You did it\!  I've got my kitchen back\! 

Remember, you can exchange the Cake Slices you receive for awesome cake helms from Maskwell in the Haven Town Square. It's just like that old baker's saying, 'Wear the hide of your fallen foes to prove your might as a warrior\!' 

Ok, maybe I just say that.
guild.properties|e.statue_deploy_limit: Sorry, only {0} knight statues may be placed in a hall at once. To add this statue, please remove another one.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_3b: Thanks for the info tall guy, see you around town.
item.properties|f.luck_potion: A syrupy secretion said by some to strengthen serendipity. (Spiral HQ is unable to determine any actual effect.)
helptips.properties|m.battle_arena_3: Truly you are among the greatest of all warriors who have ever lived\! The bounties of the Arena King are yours for the taking\!
mission.properties|m.heart_of_matter_2a: As you know I am attempting to assemble a research team to work on-site in the Core terminal.  In order to successfully utilize it to restore the Skylark, it is imperative that we reach it and set up this research station. \n\nAll evidence seems to point towards you having the potential to finally reach the Core.  By breaking through the Firestorm Citadel and establishing a link to the Core, my team could set up the necessary supply lines and get to work immediately.  But we can't do that while that infernal citadel and its horrible ruler stand in our way.
mission.properties|b.whipping_mishandlin: After Recon Knights discovered a fiendish city known as Sol' Fork, Spiral HQ deployed a research team to station itself in the heart of the city and study the devilites within.  Their findings have become the basis for our understanding of devilite culture and their motives for working with gremlins. \n\nThis research team is in desperate need of supplies in order to maintain working on-site.  It would be of great help to Spiral HQ's continued research to have a squad enter the city and deliver the necessary supplies.
mission.properties|m.mission_sprite_1_1a: Alright, {0}, let's get started. Looks like you and I get to go on a little sprite hunt, eh? \n\nI've aligned my tracker with the recon knight intel but something's not right. The energy signature I'm detecting is erratic, but still definitely a battle sprite. They may be in trouble, so let's hurry\!
mission.properties|m.prestigious_opportu: Prestige Missions are entirely optional and cannot be repeated in a single day.  And don't forget to keep an eye out for special missions that offer large prestige rewards\!
steam.properties|m.invite_friends:
Invite your friends to join your adventure\! 

For each friend you invite that plays you will receive a free Spark of Life\! 

Invite 5 friends and get an exclusive costume helm, The Steam Knight Helm\! 
This fancy steampunk-inspired knight helm is only obtainable as an invitation reward.
item.properties|f.dark_briar_barrage: A mythical object that can explode with the fury of the Snarbolax itself. The unearthly howl it produces is said to be more crippling than its blast.
redeem.properties|m.instruct: If you have a special code to redeem a reward, you can enter it here\:
item.properties|f.slime_lockbox: A slippery, slimy lockbox won at the Golden Slime Casino.  It contains one of many special items.  It can be opened with a Slime Key or a Silver Key.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_barrier: If you start feeling overwhelmed, use the force barriers like the one to your right to take a breather. Monsters and projectiles cannot pass through them.
item.properties|f.sweet_dreams: Don't be fooled by this weapon's fluffy exterior. It hits much harder than it looks. The perfect weapon for fighting things that go bump in the night.
mission.properties|m.eye_of_needle_1a: {0}, I'm glad you called, I have something big here for you.
conversation.properties|m.hav_mecha_1a: I got a great deal on this broken mecha knight. If I can just figure out how to get it working properly I'll have myself a personal bodyguard for my expeditions into the Clockworks.
mission.properties|o.sovereign_slime: Infiltrate the Royal Jelly Palace and find the mysterious energy source
item.properties|f.blazing_pulsar: A highly advanced pulsar capable of launching compact infernos from afar. Pulsar shots become more powerful the further they travel.
item.properties|f.iron_wolf_hood: A helm once worn by a member of the 'Iron Wolves,' a squad of fearless knights that specialized in the elimination of high-profile Morai targets. After disbanding, their surviving members were united with other squads by Desna to form the Recon Rangers.
mission.properties|o.p_heart_of_ice_r6: Discover the source of the terrible blizzards emanating from Amu-Sol
mission.properties|b.shopping_again: Bechamel has already given you a tour of the Haven Bazaar that included where to acquire new weapons, armor and recipes.  Now it's time to pay him another visit and learn about some of the more advanced services the Bazaar offers. \n\nYou will pay a visit to Punch and Vise, Brinks and even visit Bechamel's own shop\!
mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm: In order to reach Spiral HQ's base of operations in Haven you will need to descend into the Clockworks and cross a massive chasm.  The journey will be a dangerous one and it is recommended that you have everything you need before departing. \n\nCompleting this mission will leave the Rescue Camp behind you.
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc3: The renaming item will be consumed.
item.properties|f.fearless_rigadoon: The ultimate in paralyzing piercers, it's unclear whether its elegance or its wicked bite is what leaves opponents stupefied.
mission.properties|m.guardians_of_cradle: Quite the scarab nest we've stirred up this time eh, {0}? Reminds me of the time we engaged the Morai siege fleets over Isora. That was quite an all or nothing gamble. Doesn't surprise me in the least that we're the only thing standing between us and utter annihilation again.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_1_1a: Well met, {0}. I'm Lieutenant Barrus, Warden of the Hall of Heroes. \n\nYou are here because Spiral HQ has marked you as having potential to become a Vanguard of the Spiral Knights.  The Hall of Heroes is now at your disposal.  As you move up in rank, you will receive new missions to visit and have access to more recipes from the veteran knights in this hall.
mission.properties|o.minerals_rock: Report to Chief Geo Knight Wegner in the Haven Arcade
mission.properties|m.first_contact_b_3a: Wow, it sounds like you've already had quite the adventure, {0}\!  Spiral HQ will most certainly be interested in that artifact you recovered.  It's remarkable that you were able to face off against a gremlin in the Clockworks and survive.
item.properties|f.mechaknight_disguise: A very convincing costume that makes the wearer look like a mecha knight.  It's so convincing, your friends just might try to deconstruct you\!
conversation.properties|m.rc_end_3c: Once you reach Haven I would advise you explore the town and familiarize yourself with all the sights and services the town has to offer. You will gain access to more powerful gear than we offer here as well and be surrounded with many more experienced knights. Be sure to ask them for assistance if you get lost.
item.properties|f.wrapping_paper: Wrap an item in this decorative gift box and add a personalized message.
item.properties|f.rocky_core: A delicious gummy treat with an impenetrable rocky shell. More than a few teeth have been lost by knights attempting to get at the gooey interior.
item.properties|f.scary_skelly_shield: A small, spooky shield to safeguard you from shadow.
conversation.properties|r.sprite_tut_3a: And how does my sprite evolve?
uplink.properties|m.bid_complete: Thank you for using the Haven Auction House, your shinies are always appreciated.
item.properties|f.token_core: A fragment of strange material found within the core of the Clockworks. Each fragment seems to have an entirely unique composition, like snowflakes. These fragments are highly prized by Spiral HQ as they hope to learn the nature of the core through their study.
mission.properties|r.another_trace_3a: You can count on me, Kora.
conversation.properties|m.rc_vet_2a: Always be on your guard. Who knows what other dangers await us on this world?
projectx.properties|m.downloading: Please wait while we install the rest of the game.
conversation.properties|r.hav_clock_2c: What lies at the core of the Clockworks?
guild.properties|i.buy_themes: Change the theme for the Guild Hall.
item.properties|f.aerohelm: A light, aerodynamic helmet sure to lift your attitude. It won't let you fly, so you'll just have to wing it.
mission.properties|o.p_r9_gate_undead: Save the lost Knight from joining the ranks of the dead in the haunted manor\!
projectx.properties|x.rename_desc2: On success, you will be briefly disconnected.
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_suit: The most fearsome Skelly Suit known to exist. There is nothing humerus about these dreadful duds.
item.properties|f.arcane_salamander_suit: A Salamander Suit imbued with magical power.  It is thought to be made from the familiars of powerful witches.
projectx.properties|e.name_invalid_dash: Sorry, there must be two letters surrounding any dash, and two dashes maximum.
help.properties|m.tier_3_monster: Monsters can utilize attacks that deal pure special damage (PIERCING, ELEMENTAL or SHADOW). Equip yourself appropriately\!
sprites.properties|d.golden_harness_eli: Aligns your battle sprite's skills to deal piercing damage. \nReduces cooldown of all skills by 10% \nCan be used by\: Seraphynx, Maskeraith
mission.properties|d.supply_depot_explan: The Supply Depot is full of items for sale. As you complete missions, more items will become available.
item.properties|f.potocrowns: An unlucky thing for your foes to find, it explodes in a painful blow.
conversation.properties|m.casino_bouncer: Welcome to the High Wobbler Lounge\!
item.properties|f.storm_chaser: A rare elemental found hovering in storm clouds. Their electric hum creates an almost melodic choir that can be faintly heard between thunderclaps.
item.properties|f.holiday_hat: A festive cap that carries with it the warm spirit of the holidays. It smells faintly of gingerbread.
dungeon.properties|i.difficulty_easy: Normal difficulty features challenges suitable for any player.
mission.properties|b.p_legion_almire_r9:
Warning\: This is a Dangerous Mission\! 

Desna and her Recon Rangers are an elite team tasked with recovering intel from some of the most dangerous levels of the Clockworks.  Joining them could lead to great rewards, but it is guaranteed to be a perilous journey\! 

Spiral HQ believes that an ancient codex originating from the cursed kingdom of Almire is located somewhere in a dark and terrifying necropolis.  This necropolis is believed to be teeming with all manners of undead monstrosities and only the Recon Rangers have what it takes to get in, acquire the intel and get out alive\!
dungeon.properties|m.golden_slime_prize_: Each spin of the wheel rewards you with a random prize, sometimes including very special items\! Requires 50 Golden Slime Coins or equivalent crowns.
item.properties|f.troika: A low-tech sword that makes up for its lack of high internal power with sheer weight and size. It is capable of delivering crushing blows for those that can handle it.
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_coba: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
item.properties|f.helm_top: An accessory that can be attached to the top of select helmets.  Accessories can be attached at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
item.properties|f.dangerous_brigandine: Padded armor that seems to emphasize the high mortality rate of the elite Recon Rangers. Recon Rangers need to travel light and fast, often headlong into situations that would terrify other knights.
mission.properties|r.alchemy_beginners_9: I think I've got it, thanks\!
item.properties|f.coliseum_room: A lively room featuring a Coliseum ticket booth, a Coliseum Rewards Supervisor, and a Krogmo Alchemy Machine.
item.properties|f.vial_freeze_super: An ornate glass vial containing glacial wind. It can be used to inflict enemies with Freeze.\n\nThis particular vial looks much more dangerous than the standard. Throw it like a grenade and chill your foes right in place\!
helptips.properties|m.branch_battle_warn: Two paths lie before you. Which one will you take?
mission.properties|o.strength_unity: Defend the Geo Knights from a monstrous assault
exchange.properties|m.coins_cancelled_po: You have been refunded {0} crowns for your cancelled energy offer.
mission.properties|o.p_anniversary_r7: Meet with Biscotti in her kitchen and provide 'baking assistance.'
mission.properties|o.axes_of_evil: Stop the gremlin logging operation in the Jigsaw Valley
chat.properties|m.emote_self: You can't do that to yourself.
item.properties|f.hazardous_diablo_helm: A helm worn by members of the Scarlet Scouts. Designed to frighten their enemies, this helm is in the visage of a demon said to have broken off its own horn to use as a weapon when it faced its end.
item.properties|f.firetail_mail: A scorching simian mail typically worn by commanders in combat. It will ward off many wounds made to the wearer.
projectx.properties|m.instance_shutdown: There has been a server error. You will be transferred to another instance.
mission.properties|m.search_continues_4a: I don't know, but it is certainly a terrifying picture she has painted. Something stirs within the heart of this world, {0}, something terrible.  I've felt it since we first set foot on this world; invisible eyes watching our every move, shapes that form just out of view... something greater than gremlins calls this world home.
mission.properties|b.p_r7_kit: Some knights are part of special research teams that rarely get the chance to stay above ground for very long.  These knights often use the subtowns of the Clockworks as base camps.  While the monsters that run these towns are friendly, often the amenities are not exactly well suited for knights. \n\nThese knights could always use supplies to make their stay a little more comfortable. A happy researcher is a productive researcher\!
item.properties|f.furni_beacon_floor_gre: A Spiral-issued light source typically used at checkpoints.
item.properties|f.ancient_shell: A fragment of resilient Tortodrone shell. It is rumored that by sleeping on a Tortodrone shell, one can feel the subtle vibrations that call these mighty beings towards the Long Migration's mysterious final destination.
item.properties|f.spark_plug: A small, mechanical component that really gets a construct's motor running.
helptips.properties|m.dead: Press ATTACK [[ACTION]] to cycle to Spectator View.
mission.properties|m.ghost_machine_mon_1: SITUATION RESOLVED. PLEASE EXIT THE FACILITY.
item.properties|f.vial_fire_ultra: An ornate glass vial containing a molten mixture. It can be used to inflict enemies with Fire.\n\nThis particular vial is the most dangerous of them all. Throw it like a grenade and turn 'em into toast\!
item.properties|f.pollinator_plate: Styled after the unsung heroes of the hive. Fashionable, functional, and a little fuzzy.
conversation.properties|m.lab_knight4_1a: Recon teams have recovered some strange and remarkable things from within the Clockworks.
mission.properties|b.welcome_to_haven_b: Having survived the journey to Haven you must contact Intel Agent Kora via comlink and give her your report.  She has information as to what to do next.
support.properties|m.option_1_0: 1. Remember you can click on players and choose "Ignore" to block any chat and mail from them. Click here to ignore {0} and skip the complaint.
item.properties|f.force_dynamo: A beguiling gadget that can seemingly generate energy from nowhere.
mission.properties|r.cwt_mintut_6: Sounds great\! Thanks for the info\!
item.properties|f.gorgofist: A terrifying handgun that combines the dual-crushing power of a gorgo and the mythical tortomega. Suppressing enemies has never been more fiendishly fun.
item.properties|f.woven_shade_armor: A loose fitting suit of armor that enables its wearer to slink through the shadows and assault unaware enemies.
mission.properties|m.creators_and_create: Hello {0}, it seems you had few problems with the oozing hordes and their like which can no doubt be chalked up to a good education on their behaviors prior to the mission.
item.properties|f.grey_feather_cowl: A downy hood made for scholars who like to get out into the field. It's softer than the most luxurious of pillows, yet extraordinarily protective.
projectx.properties|m.queue_position: You are at position {0} in the logon queue.
item.properties|f.arthro_pod: A streamlined helmet fashioned after the tough chitin of a beetle's carapace.
item.properties|f.sorcerer_robe: A fine robe known to be worn by powerful sorcerers, and this one guy Bob.
chat.properties|m.usage_revoke_gift: Usage\: /{0} <account name> name attr value attr value...\nRevokes a gift from the identified account.
item.properties|f.vial_shock: A glass vial containing hyper-charged electric fluids. It can be used to inflict enemies with Shock.\n\nThrow it like a grenade and give your foes a real ZAP\!
helptips.properties|m.controls: Press [[TOGGLE_HELP]] at any time to view the controls.
conversation.properties|r.energy_info_2d: Your lessons have energized me\! I'm off to adventure, bye\!
item.properties|f.solid_cobalt_armor: A sturdy set of Cobalt Armor reforged for additional comfort and protection.
item.properties|f.ash_tail_coat: This well-made hide coat is self-heating, protecting the wearer from freeze attacks. The secret? A tiny pinch of blaze pepper.
item.properties|f.heavy_splinter_bomb: A solid chunk of synthetic mineral with an explosive surprise inside. Wolvers hate surprises.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_6a: Hold fast, traveler. You stand in the court of the Kingdom of Almire. Do you not hear the trumpets sound the return of our mighty legions? Are you not in awe of the prestigious heraldry of our great houses and statesmen?
helptips.properties|m.mineral_tut: Attack to break down minerals and pick them up\! Carry one at a time.
mission.properties|m.hall_of_heroes_coba: Well met, {0}.  I'm Jorin, a knight who has mastered the standard issue Spiral Knight gear.  The recipes I have for you produce very reliable weapons and gear. \n\nJust because your weapons don't output fancy special damage types or your armor defends from status conditions doesn't mean you can't shake it in the Clockworks.  The gear I specialize in is good for just about any situation.  It will keep you alive and packs a punch on almost any monster that comes your way.
mission.properties|o.p_r6_gate_beast: Rescue the Geo Knights from the clutches of wild beasts\!
item.properties|f.nefarious_raiment: A raiment said to be crafted by a nefarious imp. The ethereal plates will defend against heinous harassment while they shroud you in darkness.
mission.properties|o.p_r3_min: Gather minerals for Chief Geo Knight Wegner's research.
helptips.properties|m.loading7: If you are on fire you will take damage regularly until the fire wears off. That can't stop you from spreading it to monsters though. Get close and share the love\!
item.properties|f.tundrus: A modified magnus that ensures that if somehow your target survived the first shot, they will still be frozen in their tracks. A charged shot can even plow through multiple enemies.
item.properties|f.trojan_armor: The armor of the stalwart Spiral Wardens is said to give great comfort to other knights. Nothing says 'here comes the cavalry' like the sight of these iron giants taking to the battlefield.
item.properties|f.miracle_cloak: A miraculous mantle said to grant a single miracle to the wearer when they need it most.
item.properties|f.divine_mote: A small morsel of special food favored by battle sprites who forever bask in the light of the heavens.
mission.properties|o.p_r4_kit: Gather supplies for delivery to Knights stationed in Emberlight.
social.properties|m.party_dissolved: Oops\! That party no longer exists.
item.properties|f.wyvern_scale_helm: Made from the scales of rare Clockworks beasts, this sturdy helmet is resistant to even the highest of temperatures.
item.properties|f.recover_accessory: Accessory tickets can be redeemed at the Accessorizor in the Haven Bazaar.
mission.properties|b.p_tortodrone_r6: Pieces of fallen tortodrones and clusters of dark matter have been showing up in the Clockworks, leading Spiral HQ to believe that the Fiends are somehow linked to the disappearance of those once-mythical beings. In order to discover what the Fiends are up to, you will need to find a way to unlock one of their Grim Gates and travel through it. Spiral HQ suspects that the glyphs that the Fiends carry with them might be the keys to opening the gate yourself.
item.properties|f.firetail_mask: A simmering simian mask made to celebrate the new year. The searing silhouette will display your dominant demeanor.
mission.properties|o.mission_sprite_2: Secure a cache of battle sprites and return them to the Lab
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_4: We've doubled the amount of patrols around Haven in case there is another attack, but I have a feeling that those gremlins already got what they came for...
item.properties|f.plated_pathfinder_armo: A hardened set of armor made to protect against even the most voracious monsters while exploring the unknown.
help.properties|m.monster_construct: Deal ELEMENTAL - Weak to ELEMENTAL - Strong against PIERCING
item.properties|f.ultra_shock_barrier: Surrounds you with deadly orbs of lightning that can give hostiles a jolt
item.properties|f.kat_eye_cloak: A crudely crafted cloak made to resemble a crack shot warrior of the ill-fated Kat Tribe.
uplink.properties|m.newsletter_sub: Congratulations\! You subscribed to the Spiral Knights Newsletter\!
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_mask: The ultimate in haunted headgear, certain to protect your cranium from even the most hellish of shadow attacks.
item.properties|m.trinket_tip_locked: Trinket Slot (Buy Trinket Slot Upgrade to Unlock)
conversation.properties|m.lab_progress_8: This gremlin comes from the colony of Emberlight, deep within the Clockworks. They're a group of outcasts that have defied King Tinkinzar and the Crimson Order. We're hoping we can make a treaty with them that will allow us to use their colony as a base of operations for our missions deeper underground.
mission.properties|r.apocrea_1_4a: I won't let them take me so easily.
helptips.properties|m.tg1_button: If a door won't open, search under blocks for a hidden floor button to open it.
mission.properties|m.reporting_duty_1a: Well met soldier, and good work on reaching our base camp here in Haven. I'm Lieutenant Feron. I have been assigned by Captain Ozlo to oversee our Clockworks mining operation. \n\nBefore you lies "the Arcade," a fascinating complex that serves as our link into the heart of the Clockworks. Since you're new here, I'll give you a quick run-down of what Spiral HQ has us doing here.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_5a: Along the north wall here we have all sorts of blocks, switches, doors, and buttons from the Clockworks. If you want to overcome the devious and deadly mechanisms down there I suggest you become familiar with how these work\!
mission.properties|r.hall_of_heroes_shad: Ok, let's see what you have to offer.  (Browse recipes)
item.properties|f.sun_silver: An extraordinary metal imbued with the radiant light of the sky.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_3: That's exactly right\! The Core of the Clockworks could very well contain the energy source we need to create a new power source for the Skylark and restore it to operational condition. There's only one problem- the Clockworks themselves seem to be built like some kind of crazy death trap.\n\nReaching the Core is not going to be easy...
mission.properties|m.welcome_to_haven_1a: You made it, {0}\!  I'm happy to see you arrive here in Haven safe and sound.  I'll confirm with Spiral HQ that you will now be undertaking missions in Haven.  To start, I've issued you a few missions that will help get you acclimated with all that Haven has to offer.  Be sure to say hello to the Strangers as you begin exploring.
sprites.properties|d.protection: Increases the defensive powers of the angelic aura.
mission.properties|o.p_r7_mat_234: Turn in the requested materials to Spiral HQ for research.
item.properties|f.spiral_cuirass: Light armor issued to all Spiral Knight recruits.
item.properties|f.valestone_deposit_1: A small mineral deposit that will generate a single unit of moonstone.
conversation.properties|m.casino_pitboss: I promoted myself to Senior Manager of Ghastly Implements of Destruction.
item.properties|f.hazardous_hedge_coat: A battle-ravaged coat worn by the squad leaders of the Scarlet Scouts, nicknamed 'hedges.' The name was likely coined due to their incredible flanking abilities or perhaps it is a reference to the spikes that adorn their armor.
item.properties|f.thwacker_shield: A shield repurposed by gremlins and worn by Darkfang Thwackers. Similar to the gremlins themselves, it is resistant to fire and shock attacks. Knights who use these shields report that is impossible to completely remove all the fur stuck to it.
mission.properties|o.p_winterfest_r4: Help Impostoclaus deliver presents to the orphans of Emberlight.
dungeon.properties|m.cogmaster_castle_de: Calling all knights\!  Spiral HQ has launched a full-scale assault on the heavily fortified castle of Warmaster Seerus, a devious gremlin of the Crimson Order. All attacks against the sturdy walls and destructive artillery have failed - Spiral HQ needs YOU to turn the tide of the battle and take the fight to the Warmaster himself\!
mission.properties|b.p_moorcroft2:
Someone or something has summoned a horde of cursed black kats into the Clockworks. These shadowy beasts hunger for arcane power and raided the Moorcroft Manor Archives' precious collection of magical grimoires. 

In the wrong hands these ancient tomes could be catastrophic, but it turns out that black kats can't read, so they instead decided to just eat them.

The residents of Moorcroft Manor would like you to retrieve the Ancient Pages of the magical grimoires that quite likely reside in the stomachs of black kats. We'll leave you to figure out just how to recover them... 

For this mission, journey into a fiery furnace where intel has located a black kat nest. Recover those Ancient Pages and return them to Moorcroft Manor\!
mission.properties|b.crossing_chasm_b: Having restored power to the Rescue Camp and established contact with Spiral HQ, it's time you attempted to cross the chasm north of the Rescue Camp and reach Haven where the rest of the Spiral Knights have taken refuge. \n\nIn order to cross the chasm you will need to take an elevator down into the Clockworks and find another to bring you up on the other side.  There's no telling what dangers lurk in the dark depths below so Rhendon will be accompanying you on your journey.
mission.properties|o.p_halloween_r3: Seek an audience with the Punkin King.
helptips.properties|m.sl_elevator_active: Shadow Key required to open.\nShadow Keys can be acquired randomly in lockboxes or purchased from the Supply Depot.
item.properties|f.dread_skelly_shield: A large, bony bulwark bathed in blackish brume. It occasionally issues a quiet, forlorn whisper, usually about remembering to block.
guild.properties|m.not_in_guild: Sorry, you're not presently in a guild.
item.properties|f.frenzy_rider_mantle: A legendary suit of armor thought to be worn by a god who used frenzy to carve whole worlds from stone.
pvp.properties|m.coins_awarded_subject: Krogmo Coins earned in The Coliseum\!
item.properties|m.unlock_slime_prompt: A Slime Key (or Silver Key) is required to open this Lockbox. Lockboxes contain random prizes inside.
mission.properties|m.dreams_and_nightmar: Herex slipped away\! I lost sight of him as things went black. It felt like a thousand hands were pulling us away. As if something didn't want us to follow.
conversation.properties|m.arc_leader_5: You have proven that you are combat ready and I have faith that you will serve the Spiral Order courageously. The gates into the Clockworks are just up ahead. \n\nGood luck to you\!
mission.properties|m.go_shopping_2a: Strangers like Quillion here sell you weapons and armor.  Each one specializes in a particular kind of item, so talk to them and find out what they carry. They're not very chatty, but they always have a fresh stock of items every day\! \n\nJust be sure that you've reached the appropriate rank to equip an item\!
conversation.properties|m.fc_bridge_1: Few make it across the bridge traveler. Perhaps you stand a chance of surviving, or perhaps... no, even the good sprites below will be swallowed by Vanaduke's flames. It is hopeless.
uplink.properties|m.confirm_att_del: You haven't accepted the attachment. Are you sure you want to delete it?
mission.properties|m.advanced_alchemy_2a: Basically it comes down to 'branching.'  You see, most of the alchemy you have likely seen up to this point follows a linear evolution path.  It simply improves over time and each upgrade is better than the last. \n\nBut not all items are like that.  Many of them can become multiple, completely different types of items than their original\!
item.properties|f.miracloth: A marvelous bolt of sublimely supple fabric.
helptips.properties|t.tg1_overgrown_1: See you on the other side
guild.properties|m.storage_warning: WARNING\: Items left here can be taken by any guild member of the appropriate rank.
global.properties|e.must_complete_tutori: You must complete The Crash Site before joining friends.
prologue.properties|m.helmsman_arrive: Captain Ozlo, the Skylark has identified the source of the powerful energy signature.
mission.properties|m.pumping_up_7a: Lastly, we have the trap and hazard rooms. You can come here to see how you can sometimes affect traps and also learn about traps that deal different kinds of damage.
conversation.properties|r.och_leader_1_2: I won't let you down, Lieutenant.
item.properties|f.prize_box_frenzy: Contains various unique costumes and accessories crafted from thunder and lightning. Items are randomly chosen.  No key is required to open.
mission.properties|o.best_of_beast: Learn about the most powerful beast and slime monsters
item.properties|f.quicksilver_helm: A fine helmet made out of what was once a Quicksilver.
projectx.properties|e.name_too_short: Sorry, valid names must be at least 4 letters long.
sprites.properties|d.chaotic_haze: Targets damaged by hexing haze have a chance of receiving a random status condition.
item.properties|f.furious_fork: A good chef knows when to flip burgers. A great chef cooks burgers while they flip them.
helptips.properties|m.new_sprite: You've got a battle sprite\! Press [[SPRITE_ACTION_1]] to use your sprite's battle skill\!
conversation.properties|m.npc_minerknigh: They say these minerals power every gate in the Arcade.
mission.properties|b.dreams_and_nightmar: Respond to the distress signal from the Core Terminal. We have no intel on what to expect. \nThis is a dangerous mission. Prepare for anything.
item.properties|f.seraphic_mail: A beautiful mail coat that causes its wearer to strike out at evil with righteous fury.
conversation.properties|m.energy_info_2a: Awesome\! I'll break it down for you in three easy lessons\: what it is, how it's used, and how you can get more.
mission.properties|b.target_acquired: After analyzing the schematics you recovered from the gremlin test lab, Spiral HQ now knows the nature of Project R as well as its location within a gremlin munitions facility.  Spiral HQ is requesting that you enter this facility and destroy Project R before it can be used on Haven.  Speak with Intel Agent Kora for full details.
mission.properties|r.choose_your_sprite_: Thank you, Morlin. I will do my best to raise this sprite well.
conversation.properties|m.rfc_court_5a: We all sensed the moment you defeated Vanaduke. The entire citadel shook as he fell and for a moment we thought that this realm would be destroyed along with its ruler. You must be careful wandering these halls with the place coming apart like this\!
item.properties|f.toy_soldier_crown: A gleaming crown worn by elite Toyland units and those who smell faintly of varnish.
conversation.properties|m.fountain_1: Greetings and welcome to Haven\!  If you head north, you'll reach the Arcade where you can get up to speed on the details of our mission.  If you head west, you'll reach the Bazaar, where the Strangers have a selection of gear and weapons for sale.  Be sure to check their stock daily, it changes\!
mission.properties|o.shopping_again: Follow Bechamel on a tour of the Bazaar's more advanced offerings
mission.properties|o.rescues_and_recycli: Shut down the gremlin deconstruction site and rescue the captive knights
item.properties|f.dark_shard: A shard of Dark Matter that is too small to be used in powering gates but highly useful in alchemy.
item.properties|f.cosmic_star: A perfect crystalization of special food favored by battle sprites who hail from space deep beyond the furthest of stars.
